A creative Swiss army knife who prioritises. You can do a bit of everything and you find channels and angles nobody has thought of yet. You know the job is to pick the right one, execute it, measure it and move to the next. Lifecycle and CRM at scale. Customer.io , Braze or equivalent: segmentation, behavioural triggers, in-app moments. Analytical rigour. You read a funnel, build a cohort, set up a holdout and call a result. You build with AI every day: assets, copy variants, segments, analyses and even building your own tools. You use it to go faster, and you keep your judgment on what ships. Driven by health, and rigorous about it. Health matters to you, and when something blocks, you find a way. You make people want to act with messages that hold up in front of a physician. Nice to haves Experience with regulated health communication (claims, health data, medical services). B2B2C, employee benefits or HR tech. Paid acquisition and influencer marketing in B2C. Pricing and packaging of subscription offers. You will work at the intersection of consumer experience, merchant needs, business performance and regulatory requirements.

This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris with a hybrid working model.

  • Make checkout simpler and more effective: Own and improve Alma’s checkout experience across e-commerce and in-store journeys, reducing friction and supporting conversion.

  • Have worked on in-store, POS or omnichannel experiences.
  • Have experience with European markets or an interest in emerging purchase journeys, including agentic commerce and AI-assisted transactions.

title: Stage Chef.fe de projet migration applicative en santé
description: Dans le cadre de la migration de notre application desktop, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire pour piloter le suivi de l’adoption et accompagner nos clients tout au long de leur transition vers la nouvelle solution. Strong cross-functional communication : able to gather context from business teams and translate security stakes into plain language. Rigor, autonomy, and a taste for building clear, durable processes . Open and eager to learn on emerging topics — notably AI agents and their security — and excited to help build this area from the ground up. ✨ What would make the difference (nice to have) Experience with an enterprise EDR / anti-malware . Awareness of security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001…). Hands-on experience deploying an IdP (Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID…) and/or an MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Intune…). 💎 Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. title: Senior IT Engineer
description: About Morpho Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.   Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

  • Embedded Linux performance and system tuning
  • Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines
  • C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development
  • Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization
  • Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.
  • Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.

  • Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.
  • Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.
  • Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.

  • Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.
  • Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.

You will own campaigns across our channels, with Meta, Google and organic social as the main ones today: you plan them, make the content and build the AI workflows behind them. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next. High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video. Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social. Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel. Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round. Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful. AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters. Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale. Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change. Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site Experience 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through. Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus. Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful. Why Benetics AI A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan. Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work. Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns. Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work. How we hire Introduction with hiring manager, 15-minute video call A practical case with the team. Conversation with Ferdinand, our founder, 30 minutes, about the company, growth and the role Final decision. We decide quickly and tell you why. You don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about a campaign, a piece of content or an AI workflow you built, what you changed and what happened. You don't need a cover letter. title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, GPU Compute
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Systems Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We offer competitive salaries ranging from $170k-$300k + equity based on your experience.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

 

#LI-LH2

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience. The role We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on. This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes. Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric. Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark. Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations. Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you. Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company. Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use. Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached. Why join Stream? We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia). title: Senior ML Engineer
description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! What you will do Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing. Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar). Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle. Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously. Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation. Support and mentor team members. Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc. Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team. Your profile 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. Skills Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan. Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data. Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring. Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment. Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions. Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences. Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines. Experience with mentoring and leading team members. What we offer you A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam An enthusiastic, professional, and international team Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities Unlimited skin checks for you Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.


You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.


The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.


You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.
  • Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.
  • Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.
  • Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.
  • Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.
  • Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.
  • Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.
  • Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

  • Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable services and frameworks.
  • Demonstrate a track record of driving cross-team technical alignment and leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering groups.
  • Possess expert knowledge in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Understand trade-offs in platform design and know how to build golden paths that engineers love to use.
  • Communicate technical vision and architectural choices clearly to both technical leads and engineering leadership.
  • Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€93.500—€126.500 EUR

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. title: Senior contractmanager (domein IT)
description: Wil jij ervoor zorgen dat belangrijke contracten niet alleen goed zijn afgesloten, maar gedurende de hele looptijd ook daadwerkelijk waarde leveren? En krijg jij energie van leveranciers uitdagen, risico’s beheersen en samen met de business sturen op prestaties en verbetering? Kies dan voor Univé! Wie zijn wij? Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is. Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. Coöperatie Univé bestaat uit zeven verschillende Regionale Univé’s, zodat we op landelijk én lokaal niveau altijd dichtbij onze leden zijn. Dat is het mooie van Univé. Waar kom je te werken? Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Inkoop & Facilitaire Zaken, in het team Inkoop & Contractmanagement. Dit team voert binnen Univé de regie op inkoop-, contract- en leveranciersmanagement. Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business. We zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Inkoop & Contractmanagement groeit verder naar een professionele, businessgerichte en datagedreven regiepartner. Dat betekent dat we niet alleen kijken naar wat er contractueel is afgesproken, maar vooral ook naar de waarde die contracten en leveranciers gedurende de looptijd daadwerkelijk voor Univé realiseren. Als contractmanager speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt intensief samen met contracteigenaren, management, inkopers, Risk, Compliance en Juridische Zaken. En natuurlijk met onze leveranciers. Jouw uitdaging Als contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren en bewaken van contractwaarde gedurende de volledige looptijd van onze contracten. Je voert regie op het contract- en leveranciersmanagement van de aan jou toegewezen contracten en leveranciers. Daarbij stuur je op naleving van afspraken, kosten, kwaliteit, risico’s, performance, compliance en duurzaamheid. Je zorgt ervoor dat Univé grip houdt op de ingekochte dienstverlening en dat afspraken niet alleen op papier goed geregeld zijn, maar in de praktijk ook worden nagekomen. Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel de business als leveranciers. Je organiseert en leidt leveranciersoverleggen, maakt prestaties en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt dat acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd. Zie je afwijkingen, kansen of risico’s? Dan wacht je niet af, maar kom je in actie. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten; sturen op contractnaleving, kosten, kwaliteit, performance, risico’s, compliance en duurzaamheid; organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen; bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen; begeleiden van wijzigingen, indexaties, evaluaties, verlengingen en beëindigingen; signaleren en beheersen van contractuele, leveranciers- en continuïteitsrisico’s; initiëren en begeleiden van verbeterplannen, disputen en escalaties; ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers; opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten; tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is; bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé. De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze prestaties periodiek worden beoordeeld en voert regie op de contractuele borging, opvolging en eventuele escalatie. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één overleg of één contractmoment. Wie ben jij? Je bent een contractmanager die regie pakt. Je brengt structuur, houdt overzicht en weet wanneer je moet verbinden, adviseren, onderhandelen of juist escaleren. Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin verschillende belangen samenkomen. Je kunt schakelen tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en tactisch-strategische vraagstukken en bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor contracteigenaren, management en leveranciers. Je bent analytisch en risicobewust, maar vooral ook gericht op resultaat. Een contract is voor jou geen statisch document: je gebruikt het als instrument om prestaties te verbeteren, risico’s te beheersen en waarde voor Univé te realiseren. Je bouwt aan professionele leveranciersrelaties waarin transparantie, voorspelbaarheid, continue verbetering en wederzijdse aanspreekbaarheid centraal staan. Je durft leveranciers uit te dagen en weet tegelijkertijd hoe je een constructieve langetermijnrelatie onderhoudt. Verder breng je mee: HBO/HBO+ werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in bedrijfskunde, rechten, economie of een vergelijkbare richting; minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen contractmanagement, bij voorkeur domein IT; aantoonbare ervaring met complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten en leveranciers, binnen het domein IT; kennis van contract lifecycle management, leveranciersrelatiemanagement, prestatiesturing en contractgovernance; ervaring met leveranciersoverleggen, prestatiebeoordelingen, contractevaluaties en escalatiemanagement; kennis van risicomanagement, compliance-eisen en interne beheersing; kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en uitbestedingskaders; bij voorkeur een aanvullende opleiding op het gebied van contractmanagement, zoals CATS, NEVI 2 of vergelijkbaar. Daarnaast herkennen we in jou initiatief, regievoering, risicobewustzijn en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent communicatief sterk, kwaliteitsgericht en analytisch, kunt goed samenwerken en beschikt over overtuigingskracht en onderhandelingsvaardigheden op tactisch-strategisch niveau. Wat bieden wij? We vragen veel van je, maar daar geven we je ook graag veel voor terug: een salaris passend bij jouw kennis, opleiding en ervaring op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand; een collectieve prestatiebeloning; een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd; 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek; een studiekostenregeling en volop ruimte om jezelf professioneel verder te ontwikkelen; een goede pensioenvoorziening; hybride werken: thuiswerken is bij ons heel normaal en je hebt de vrijheid om samen met je team je ideale werkplek te bepalen; een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding op de dagen dat je vanuit huis werkt; een laptop en telefoon; korting op schade- en zorgverzekeringen. Maar minstens zo belangrijk: je krijgt bij ons ruimte om impact te maken. Contract- en leveranciersmanagement is binnen Univé volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarmee de mogelijkheid om niet alleen contracten professioneel te managen, maar ook actief bij te dragen aan hoe we ons vakgebied verder vormgeven. Enthousiast? Wil jij samen met ons bouwen aan professioneel contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton. Je kunt tot en met 30 november 2026 reageren. title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris : We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen : Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen : Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken : Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. title: Senior Controls Engineer
description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. title: Security Architect
description: Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.   Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: Physical/embedded device security. OT (operational technology) network security. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines. What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. What you will be doing As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.  As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. Security standards, policies, and design patterns library Security architecture review process Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work. To succeed in this role: You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security " You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. In addition, you have the following technical expertise: Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries Zero trust architecture principles Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc)   The following competence is desired: OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Container and Kubernetes security Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) What we offer you   💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 🏦 Excellent pension contribution . 🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. ⏰ Flexible working hours . 🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 🏋️ Free onsite gym . 🎉 Vibrant, open culture . title: Senior AI Engineer (all genders)
description: About GeneralMind GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics. Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows. About the role We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who treats LLMs as production software, not as magic. Someone who can own the agent layer of our platform end to end - from prompt and context design, through tool use and orchestration, to evals, reliability, and continuous improvement in live customer environments. This role sits at the intersection of two things that are rarely mastered together: shipping LLM-powered systems that actually work in messy enterprise reality, and the discipline of a real engineer - evals, observability, cost, latency, failure modes. Models get smarter every month. What stays scarce is the engineering judgment to make them reliably useful on top of SAP, Oracle, and the mess of real operational data. You will be a senior individual contributor working directly with the founders. The person in this role won’t be handed a roadmap - they’ll help define it, and build the AI practice around it. What you will do AI Ownership Own the agent layer end-to-end: prompt and context design, tool use, orchestration, evals, and long-term technical direction. Be the person who understands why an agent made the decision it made - and who other engineers come to when a model behaves in ways they can’t explain. Set the bar on how we build with LLMs: eval-driven development, context engineering, structured outputs, cost and latency discipline. Make foundational decisions with conviction - which model, which pattern, which guardrail - document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows. LLM Systems in Production Design agents that survive real enterprise environments: ambiguous inputs, flaky upstream systems, exception cases that weren’t in anyone’s spec. Build the eval harness that lets us ship confidently: offline evals, online evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review. Think in failure modes: hallucinations, silent drift, prompt injection, tool misuse. Build the detection before you need it. Own cost and latency as first-class product requirements, not afterthoughts. Agent & Context Engineering Design agent architectures that compose cleanly: tool selection, state, memory, planning, escalation. Build the context layer that makes agents actually useful on top of SAP and Oracle data - retrieval, grounding, schema awareness, auditability. Evolve agents without breaking live customer deployments; manage prompt and model versioning with intention. Know when the right answer is a bigger model, a better prompt, a fine-tune, a tool, or just classical code. Reliability & Systems Thinking Detect regressions in agent behavior before a customer does; build the evals and observability to catch them early. Own the operational posture of the AI systems you ship: alerting, runbooks, replay, on-call readiness. Identify structural debt in prompts, pipelines, and context before it compounds; refactor with thought. What we are looking for Experience: 6+ years building production software, with clear ownership of LLM-powered systems in real customer environments - not demos, not notebooks. LLM depth: Non-negotiable. You’ve shipped agents or LLM features that run on live traffic. You have strong opinions about prompting, context, tool use, structured outputs, and what breaks in production. Evals as a first instinct: You don’t ship LLM code without a way to measure it. You’ve built eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not just vibes. Python depth: You’re fluent in Python and comfortable in production service codebases. You make deliberate calls about async, framework choice, and performance. Reliability instinct: Hallucination containment, idempotency on tool calls, graceful degradation when a model is wrong - part of how you design, not patched in later. End-to-end ownership: You’re comfortable being the person who holds the full agent picture - from prompt to production incident. You identify what’s broken or missing before you’re asked. A real spike: We’re a strong team with broad coverage. What we’re hiring for is someone who brings a 10x improvement in an area we’re currently underinvested in. That might be agent evaluation, context engineering on enterprise data, agentic reliability, deep NLP/LLM internals, or domain-specific grounding. We don’t know exactly what shape it takes - but you should know what yours is, and be able to articulate why it matters. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Change.org, Germany - (snr Communications Manager)
description: Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Communications Manager to lead our team in Germany, as Head of Change.org , Germany. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. The job also involves being the public voice of Change.org in the German media. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through an exceptional network, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle. We'd welcome ambitious Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role. Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions. What you will achieve Create awareness spikes. Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Earn trust across the political spectrum. Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks into how the team works. Mobilise your network. Use and grow high-trust relationships with senior editors, producers, journalists, politicians, decision makers, civil society and creators to secure top-tier coverage and move decision makers. Be our voice. Act as Change.org 's external spokesperson in Germany on TV, radio, in print and on stage, representing a trusted, open platform for people across the democratic political spectrum, including in sensitive and crisis situations. Lead a high-performing team. Set clear goals, coach and develop people, give direct feedback, and build a culture of speed, ambition and ownership. At a Senior Manager level, set team objectives, coach and develop each person on the team. Lead with AI. Build AI and agentic workflows into how the team spots stories, plans campaigns, pitches media and reports results, so the team works faster and smarter. What you bring A track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. You think in moments, images and headlines, and you move from idea to execution in hours, not weeks. Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts. A strong network. You have trusted relationships with German journalists, editors and producers (ideally including key decision makers), and connections in politics and civil society across the whole democratic political spectrum, including conservative circles. You can use your contacts to place stories. Management. You have led and developed a team, or have mentored others and are ready to step into leading one. You set priorities, give direct feedback and bring out the best in people. At a Senior Manager level, you would move resources as the news and priorities shift. Leadership presence. You are confident, credible and calm under pressure. You are an experienced, media-trained spokesperson on live TV and radio and in front of senior stakeholders, and you handle tough interviews, crisis moments and politically sensitive questions with ease. AI First: You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. You know where AI adds speed and quality and where human judgement matters most, and you bring your team along. Target experience 5-8+ years in communications, campaigning, political communications, a newsroom or an agency. 3+ years leading people, at Senior Manager level. We're also open to candidates at Manager level who have experience mentoring others and the ambition to lead a team. A proven track record of national campaigns in Germany that created significant public attention and media coverage. Experience as an organisation's spokesperson in national broadcast and / or print media. Hands-on experience using AI in communications or campaigning work. Native-level German (C2) and professional English. Interested? Great! Here's what you should know This role is based in Berlin. It is a full-time hybrid role, and we expect you to be in the Berlin office 2-3 days per week, with flexibility to work remotely for the rest of the week. Our compensation philosophy is based on pay equity. All of our salaries are determined before we launch a role, based on a predetermined salary scale, the level on that scale and the cost of labour for that location. The annual salary for this role at Senior Manager level is € 95,500 in Berlin. We are also open to candidates at the Manager level and the annual salary in Berlin is € 83,500. We recognise that people assess their qualifications differently, and you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe you could be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply. Change.org is an open platform designed to serve people across the full range of viewpoints. Effectively supporting that mission requires teams with a wide variety of experiences, skills and perspectives, which we consider essential to our work. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other status protected by law. We're committed to protecting your data. To learn more, please review our Change.org Job Applicant Privacy Policy . We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know. Professional-level English proficiency is required for all roles. title: Senior Solution Architect
location: Berlin; Chemnitz, Sachsen; Dresden, Sachsen; Köln, Nordrhein-Westfalen; München, Bayern
description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

Senior Solutions Architect

Our biggest deals rarely end with the standard product. Prospects want Staffbase to fit into their system landscape, their processes, and their way of working, and that is where deals are won or lost. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you are the technical authority behind these deals in Europe. You validate what is feasible, design the architecture, and prove it with a working showcase. Then you hand it over to our Build team so it becomes a production solution. You'll work closely with Solutions Engineers, Account Executives, and Build, and you'll have a direct impact on how we win our most complex opportunities.

What you'll be doing

  • Joining strategic and technically complex opportunities in Europe early in the sales cycle, and support Solutions Engineers and Account Executives with solutioning, positioning, and technical credibility at executive and IT level
  • Analyzing and validating integration and customization requirements of prospects, from custom widgets and plugins to scripts, API integrations, SSO setups, and AI/agent use cases
  • Translating customer requirements into a clear solution architecture and a realistic scope, including effort, risks, and dependencies, so we only commit to what we can deliver
  • Building proofs of concept and demo mock-ups, including through vibe-coding, that show prospects what their customized Staffbase experience will look like
  • Working with our APIs, webhooks, extension points, and AI capabilities (including MCP and A2A) to show what's possible on the platform and where its boundaries are
  • Acting as the link between the field and our Staffbase Build team (our Forward Deployed Engineers and developers): prepare clean handovers with documented requirements, architecture, and working prototypes, and give early feedback on feasibility and effort
  • Advising on the technical parts of RFPs and security or architecture questionnaires for complex deals
  • Building and maintaining reusable assets, reference architectures, and best practices for customizations that make the European Solutions Engineering team faster, and coach Solutions Engineers on deeper technical topics
  • Bringing field learnings to Product and Build in a structured way, especially on recurring gaps in APIs, webhooks, and the plugin/widget framework, and help prioritize the improvements that directly win deals
  • Sharing successful solution patterns with Solutions Engineering colleagues in other regions and pick up proven approaches from them

What you need to be successful

  • Degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5-8 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, or technical consulting, ideally in a SaaS or enterprise software environment
  • Proven track record of supporting complex, high-value enterprise deals, from requirements validation and architecture to scoping and handover
  • Strong developer background: you can build working prototypes in JavaScript/TypeScript (React or similar), Node.js, or comparable languages, and you know HTML/CSS well
  • Deep understanding of integration architecture: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and identity concepts (OAuth, SAML, SSO, SCIM), and designing and debugging integrations in enterprise landscapes
  • Solid knowledge of cloud technologies and SaaS architecture, including security and data protection requirements of large European enterprises
  • Experience with AI-assisted development and vibe-coding tools, and the judgment to know when a prototype is good enough to show and what it takes to make it production-ready
  • Ability to turn vague customer asks into a concrete, scoped solution, and to explain trade-offs to developers, IT leaders, and business stakeholders alike
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the confidence to lead technical conversations with CIOs, enterprise architects, and communications leaders
  • Fluent German and English (C1 or higher), with the ability to hold customer conversations in both languages

Nice to have

  • Collaborative, proactive mindset: you work well with sales and engineering teams, take pride in a clean handover, and are comfortable traveling within Europe when needed
  • Experience with enterprise systems and integration landscapes is a plus: Microsoft 365, SharePoint, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Jira, Entra ID/Active Directory, etc.
  • Experience with AI agent architectures (MCP, A2A) 
  • Experience with employee communications, intranet platforms, or low-code/no-code platforms
  • Additional European languages, especially French or Spanish

What you'll get 

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support - we offer offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day - you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

title: (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte (w/m/d) bei Dezernat Zukunft – Institut für Makrofinanzen
description: Wer wir sind und was wir suchen Ob die Energiewende gelingt, entscheidet sich nicht allein an Technologien, sondern an Kosten, Märkten und politischen Weichenstellungen. Genau dazu arbeitet das Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft – und um unsere Arbeit weiter zu vertiefen, suchen wir Dich.  Das Dezernat  Zukunft  ist ein überparteilicher Berliner Think Tank an der Schnittstelle von Politik, Verwaltung und Forschung. Rund 30 Personen verfolgen gemeinsam das Ziel, Geld-, Finanz- und Wirtschaftspolitik neu zu denken und verständlich zu vermitteln. Geleitet von den Werten  Würde, Wohlstand, Demokratie und Nachhaltigkei t  suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – idealerweise ab dem 1. Januar – für unser Energy Lab eine Person als  (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte.  In dieser Position konzipierst Du Analysen und Studien zu Energiemärkten – insbesondere zum Strommarkt – und führst sie eigenständig durch. Dabei betrachtest Du Energiekosten, Investitionsbedarfe, Gesamtsystemkosten sowie die Wechselwirkungen politischer Instrumente mit diesen Größen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Fragen, wie sich Energiepolitik mit Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Bezahlbarkeit zusammendenken lässt, wie Energiekosten strategisch und gezielt gesenkt werden können, und wie das regulatorische Umfeld so ausgestaltet werden kann, dass es den Erfolg der „zweiten Hälfte der Energiewende“ und damit die Erreichung der Klimaneutralität ermöglicht. Deine Aufgaben Du analysierst Energiemärkte und -preise, einschließlich Systemkosten, und koordinierst dazu Forschungsprojekte . Dabei betrachtest Du auch fiskalpolitische Auswirkungen sowie Wechselwirkungen mit dem Stromnetzausbau.  Du entwickelst konkrete Politikvorschläge, Analysen und Positionen zu den oben genannten Themen , in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Kolleg:innen im Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft sowie den weiteren Teams der Organisation. Außerdem organisierst Du Expert:innen-Gespräche und andere inhaltliche Veranstaltungen.  Du interagierst aktiv mit Vertreter:innen von Parlamenten, Regierungen, Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Medien . Unsere Arbeit funktioniert nur dann, wenn wir mit diesen Gruppen im Austausch stehen, zuhören und zusammenarbeiten. Das bieten wir Eine Vergütung in Anlehnung an den Tarifvertrag des öffentlichen Dienstes (TVöD): Eingruppierung in Entgeltgruppe E 13 – abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung – inkl. Jahressonderzahlung und 30 Urlaubstagen. Aktive Unterstützung bei Deiner Weiterentwicklung – fachlich sowie in Bezug auf Kompetenzen, Netzwerke und Aufgaben.  Einen Arbeitsplatz in Berlin-Mitte mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten und gemeinsam vereinbarten Kernzeiten. Unbürokratische, verständnisvolle Regelungen bei kurzfristigen Care-Bedarfen; bezahlte Freistellung nach § 29 TVöD bei persönlichen Anlässen (z. B. kranke Kinder).  Einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder JobRad.  Und nicht zuletzt: Ein dynamisches,motiviertes Team, gemeinsame Events (z. B. Berg- oder Paddel-Ausflüge) und Arbeit, die zählt.  Dein Profil Du teilst unsere Werte und Ziele , begeisterst Dich für Energie- und Klimapolitik und brennst dafür, dass die Transformation gelingt.  Du hast einen Master-Abschluss in einem relevanten Fachgebiet sowie mindestens zwei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung. Du kennst Dich in Energiemärkten – insbesondere im Strommarkt – aus, verstehst politische Instrumente und erkennst, welche Zahlen für politische Entscheidungen und ökonomische Weichenstellungen wirklich zählen.  Du konzipierst und erstellst eigene Analysen – quantitativ wie textlich – selbstständig und gründlich. Du hast bereits erfolgreich Forschungsprojekte umgesetzt und Ergebnisse sowie politische Handlungsempfehlungen prägnant kommuniziert. Du bist Dir bewusst, dass unsere Analysen und Vorschläge in der Öffentlichkeit intensiv geprüft werden, und arbeitest entsprechend gewissenhaft und bist bereit, als Eigentümer:in für Deine Projekte einzustehen. Du kommunizierst sehr gut in deutscher und englischer Sprache und verfasst in beiden Sprachen anspruchsvolle, gut verständliche Texte. Du hast fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in der praktischen Anwendung gängiger KI-Programme.  Du willst den Dingen auf den Grund gehen und jeden Tag dazulernen. Noch wichtiger als mitgebrachtes Wissen ist für uns die Fähigkeit, es zu erweitern und Meinungen zu ändern.  Du arbeitest gern im Team, hörst zu und unterstützt und förderst Deine Kolleg:innen. Die perfekte Kandidat:in erfüllt nicht immer jede Anforderung. Wenn Du glaubst, dass Du zu uns passt – bewirb Dich gern trotzdem und sag uns, warum. Beschäftigungsbeginn & Vertragsbedingungen Beginn: Von uns aus so schnell wie möglich. Im Anschluss an das Bewerbungsverfahren rechnen wir mit einem Start im Januar 2027. Das genaue Startdatum ist verhandelbar.  Umfang: 32–39 Stunden/Woche (flexibel je nach Deiner Verfügbarkeit).  Befristung: zunächst 1 Jahr (Entfristung nach zwei Jahren angestrebt). Bewerbungsverfahren Bitte bewirb Dich online mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Anschreiben, das Deine Eignung entlang der oben genannten Kriterien zeigt. Bitte teile uns auch mit, wie Du auf die Stelle aufmerksam geworden bist und welche Wochenarbeitszeit Du bevorzugen würdest.  Bewerbungsfrist: 08. November 2026 Das Bewerbungsverfahren besteht aus drei Runden: im ersten Schritt einem Assessment-Test, der aus einer schriftlichen Aufgabe besteht und ca. 1-2 Stunden Arbeitszeit beansprucht; anschließend ein längeres Gespräch bei uns vor Ort im Büro und einem abschließenden Gespräch mit unserem Head of Energy Lab – Janek Steitz. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und möchten die Diversität unseres Teams fördern. Bewerbungen sind willkommen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, kultureller oder sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Kontakt / Rückfragen Du findest die Rolle spannend, weißt aber nicht, ob sie etwas für Dich ist oder ob Du gut ins Dezernat und zu den Anforderungen passen würdest? Sprich mit uns! Hierfür kannst Du Felix Heilmann – Programmleitung Energiepolitik – direkt per E-Mail kontaktieren  Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Compliance Manager – Quality & Regulatory Affairs / QMB ISO 13485 (m/f/d)
description: Intro Back problems are the most common reason for inability to work in Germany. Vivira has the solution: digital exercise therapy via app – always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Behind every application permanently listed in the DiGA directory stands a robust quality management system. That is exactly why we are looking for you: As Senior Compliance Manager, you will take on the role of Quality Management Representative (QMB) according to ISO 13485 and keep our medical devices MDR-compliant – from the next audit to the inclusion of further products in the DiGA directory. Your responsibilities include As Senior Compliance Manager (m/f/d), you will be responsible for our quality management system and take on the role of Quality Management Representative according to ISO 13485. You report directly to our Team Lead Compliance and work closely with Engineering and Product. QMS & Regulatory Affairs:  You monitor compliance with DiGAV, MDR, ISO 13485, and ISO 27001, contribute to our BSI certification topics, and develop processes, SOPs, and Work Instructions pragmatically and based on risk. Technical Documentation:  You create and maintain the Technical Documentation according to MDR (DHF/DMR) for our three medical devices – one app listed in the DiGA directory and two CE-marked products in DiGA studies. Audits:  You prepare and follow up on external audits with the notified body, and plan and conduct internal audits. Your first milestone: the ISO 13485 recertification audit in February 2027 – with a stable system, complete documentation, and a planned handover by your predecessor. Releases & Post-Market Surveillance:  You review and approve release documentation and are responsible for post-market surveillance of our products. Supplier Management:  You evaluate and monitor our software providers (e.g. Atlassian, HubSpot, Google) according to criticality. Regulatory Radar:  You evaluate regulatory changes monthly and derive concrete measures. Interface within the Company:  You are the primary contact for regulatory questions across all departments – from Doctor Success to Patient Success –, train colleagues, and proactively gather input. Whether the role of PRRC (Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance) becomes part of the function will be discussed together during the selection process – depending on your qualification and a clear agreement on responsibilities. The biggest challenge? Making regulatory requirements understandable across the company – explaining why something is necessary rather than just distributing guidelines – and actively engaging colleagues both in the office and remotely. What you should bring You have at least three years of relevant experience in the medical device field and know MDR and ISO 13485 from practical experience. You want to bring your QM/RA experience into a dedicated QMB role – or already bring it with you. You have prepared, accompanied, and followed up on audits. Having independently managed an audit is a plus – as is experience with internal audits. You bring genuine technical understanding: You know how software development works (frontend vs. backend, releases, tickets) without needing to code yourself. A background in hardware or implants is welcome if your tech affinity is right. You are ready to assume the QMB role according to ISO 13485. You work in a structured, thorough, and independent manner, actively approach colleagues, and follow up when input is missing. You can say "No, that won't work" – while simultaneously finding pragmatic, risk-based solutions that Engineering and Product can work with. You have very good German skills (at least C1) to reliably understand and communicate German DiGA regulations, and very good English skills for collaborating with our engineering team. A plus, but not a requirement: Experience with DiGA or Digital Health, SaMD (Software as a Medical Device), ISO 27001 / ISMS or BSI certifications, as well as knowledge of Confluence, Jira, or Matrix Requirements. What to expect at Vivira Ownership:  You independently design the QMS – your own processes, high freedom, short decision-making paths. Career Leap:  Your own QMB responsibility covering a broad spectrum including MDR, DiGA, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, and BSI – built on an established system with a planned handover. Workplace:  Hybrid in Berlin with 1–2 days per week in the office. Travel occurs only occasionally (under 10%). Working Abroad:  Up to one month per year, you can work from within the EU, EEA, Switzerland, Israel, or the UK. Recharge:  30 vacation days for true breaks. Health:  Our app for your own back health. Securing the Future: Increased employer contribution to the company pension scheme. Corporate Benefits:  Exclusive benefits for shopping, tech, and more. Referral Bonus:  Every successful recommendation from your network is rewarded. Highlights:  Multiple company and team events per year – and a dedicated team. B. durch Praktika) mit.   Tool- & Methodenkenntnisse: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office (insbesondere Word und Excel).
