title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
description: About Singular Photonics: Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution. About the Role: We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host. Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams. RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control. Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link. Bring-Up & Debug: Lead firmware bring-up on new boards and sensors, debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and in-system probes. Source Control & Build: Keep RTL under version control with a repeatable, automated build, and document designs to the standard our ISO 9001 design control process requires. Reviews & Support: Contribute to design reviews, and support the software team and customers during field integration. Experience & Skills: Essential: Strong proficiency in Verilog, and a solid grounding in RTL design, synthesis and timing closure. Hands-on experience with AMD-Xilinx Vivado and its toolchain. Experience writing your own testbenches and verifying a design in simulation before hardware. Experience bringing up firmware on real hardware and debugging it in the lab. Experience with at least one high-speed interface or bus at RTL level. Comfortable in a small company where priorities shift and everyone pitches in. Working with complex, existing codebases and seamlessly integrating new functionality with minimal disruption. Desirable: SystemVerilog, and verification practices beyond directed testbenches. Comfortable working in Linux operating systems. Exposure to any of PCIe, AXI interface, USB3, Ethernet, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS or Camera Link. C, C++ or Python for embedded software integration and test automation. Experience with image sensors, time-of-flight, TDCs or single-photon detection. Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, and reading schematics during debug. Educational Background: Degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2-5 years' experience in FPGA and digital design. Key Attributes & Behaviours: Rigour: Disciplined about verification - you would rather find it in simulation than on the bench. Debugging: Systematic when the fault could be in the RTL, the board or the sensor, and comfortable with the instruments that tell you which. Clarity: Writes documentation and code that colleagues can pick up without you in the room. Collaboration: Works well across the hardware, ASIC and software boundaries rather than only inside the FPGA. Ownership: Takes a problem from architecture through to a working system, and sees it through. Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the requirement can move. Success Indicators: Firmware that meets timing and functions correctly on first hardware more often than not, with issues found in simulation rather than on the bench. Effective bring-up and debugging support during prototype validation and customer deployment, with hardware and firmware issues resolved promptly. Design documentation, simulation coverage and design review contributions good enough for another engineer to maintain the work. Benefits of Joining Singular Photonics At Singular Photonics, we are committed to fostering a rewarding and supportive environment for our team. As an FPGA Firmware Engineer, you will benefit from: Pension: 5% company contribution. Share Options: Participation in the Company EMI Share Option Scheme, so you share in the growth you help build. Enhanced Annual Leave: 35 days paid annual leave per year, inclusive of UK public holidays. Hybrid Working: Primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week (full time worker). Career Growth: Work on silicon and systems few engineers get near, with the chance to shape how we do FPGA development as the team grows. Additional Benefits: [Cycle to work and private medical insurance (once implemented) Why Join Us This position offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of SPAD sensor technology, driving innovation and shaping future applications in photonics and imaging. At Singular Photonics you will be part of a passionate, close-knit team, where the work you do is visible in the product and in the hands of customers. Location & Work Environment Based at Orchard Brae House, Queensferry Road, Edinburgh. This is a full-time, permanent role. The work is hands-on with hardware in our lab, so it is primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week. Right to work in the UK is essential. We are unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Equal Opportunities Singular Photonics is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make appointments on merit, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. About the Role

As the Senior Influencer Executive, you will lead influencer strategy and campaign execution across social platforms to amplify brand awareness, drive engagement, and grow our community within the beauty space.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Senior Product Manager

Location: UK (remote)

Job Description

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.

We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Senior Product Manager to join us.

 

About the Role

As a Senior Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.

 

Responsibilities

  • Set product direction and priorities, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Define problems and experiences before solutions, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.
  • Lead product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.
  • Make sound product decisions and trade-offs, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.
  • Develop product opportunities with external partners, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.
  • Orchestrate successful launches and adoption, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.
  • Communicate with clarity throughout, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.

 

About you

  • You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.
  • You operate with independence and initiative: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.
  • You have strong business and commercial awareness and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.
  • You’re technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.
  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.
  • You’re comfortable operating externally as well as internally, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.
  • You have a strong sense of product and user experience, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.

 

The benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

 

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Account Executive, Influencer Marketing
description:
Position: Account Specialist
The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This position requires verbal and written fluency in German.

The Role:
As an Account Specialist, you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives.
The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence.

You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.

Top 5 Responsibilities:
  • INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING –Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes.
  • INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT – Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives.
  • AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients.
  • CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION- Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating.
  • PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT- Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve.

What Success Looks Like:
BY 3 MONTHS:
  • The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place.
  • You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation.
  • You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured.
By 6 MONTHS:
  • You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications.
  • Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively.
  • You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns.
  • Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns.
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance
By 1 YEAR:
  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.
Qualities of the Ideal Candidate
  • Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well
  • Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service
  • Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets
  • Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape
  • Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results
  • Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once
  • Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients
  • Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set
  • Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill
  • Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos
  • Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment
  • Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills
  • Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own
  • Works independently with minimal supervision
  • Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations
  • Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners
Qualifications & Skills:
  • Fluency in German
  • 2+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships
  • Solid understanding of omni-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies
  • Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives
  • Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together
  • Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required
  • Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • Ability to travel up to 15%
  • Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc.

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? 

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER 

  • 100% remote work for everyone 
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 
  • 401K with matching 
  • Open Paid Time Off 
  • Summer & Holiday company-wide shut-down weeks in July and December 
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off 
  • Focus Fridays 
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits 
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances 
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! 
  • Target Salary is £27–37K depending on location and experience.

 

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. 

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

title: Head of Product Design
description:
Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator.

Thoughtworks.com is one of our most important customer-facing products, helping clients discover our expertise, explore evidence of our impact and take the next step with us. It also helps job seekers explore opportunities and gives search engines and AI assistants an accurate, trusted understanding of who we are and what we do.

Today, fragmented ownership across Marketing limits our ability to deliver connected customer journeys, maintain consistent quality and continuously improve performance.

We’re looking for a Head of Product Design to change that. You’ll lead Thoughtworks.com as a digital product, translating our go-to-market and employer brand strategies into seamless experiences for customers, job seekers and AI agents. You’ll own the website strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, publishing model and content and design quality. You'll also shape experiences across connected channels, including email through Knak and events through Splash, while influencing the internal workflows that drive quality, consistency and speed.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically and deliver at every level, from defining roadmaps and improving customer journeys to refining copy, reviewing designs, interpreting performance data and making launch decisions.

Job responsibilities

  • Website product strategy

    • Set the product vision, principles and roadmap for Thoughtworks.com
    • Prioritize work around customer and business outcomes rather than requests for individual pages
    • Connect the website roadmap to Thoughtworks’ go-to-market priorities, propositions and major company launches.

    Customer journeys and experience

    • Build a deep understanding of our audiences, including enterprise buyers, technology leaders, practitioners, partners, prospective employees and alumni community
    • Design connected journeys that help people move from a question/problem/need to relevant services, expertise, evidence and action, where the site fuels journeys on AI platforms that might never have users interact with our site
    • Use customer research, website data and market insight to identify friction and opportunities
    • Ensure the core website, event pages and email experiences work together where they form part of the same journey.

    Narrative, copy and content quality

    • Own the quality and coherence of the website narrative, copy and information architecture
    • Translate complex technology services and Thoughtworks expertise into clear, credible experiences for different audiences
    • Challenge unclear propositions, duplicated content, unsupported claims and pages that do not serve a defined customer need
    • Work with the central Content team, service-line marketers and subject-matter experts, while keeping accountability for how content works within the overall experience
    • Work with content operations to establish reusable content patterns, editorial standards and clear ownership for maintaining important content.

    Experiences for people and agents

    • Ensure the website is useful and understandable to human visitors, search engines and AI assistants
    • Partner with the SEO and LLM Discoverability Lead to improve how Thoughtworks is found, interpreted and represented to support buyers in their decision making process
    • Shape requirements for structured content, metadata, evidence, content relationships and reusable information
    • Balance machine readability with strong human storytelling, accessibility and brand expression.

    Publishing model for the AI era

    • Own the spec for redesigning the publishing workflow from brief through design, production, approval, release and ongoing improvement
    • Work with the GTM tech and Global IT teams to replace manual, error-prone production with reusable patterns, clearer decision rights and proportionate automation
    • Identify where AI can improve research, prototyping, content preparation, metadata, accessibility checks, quality assurance and content maintenance
    • Turn good judgment into practical standards, templates, playbooks and automated checks
    • Build a model that allows teams to move faster without lowering the quality bar or creating uncontrolled publishing.

    Design quality and experimentation

    • Set the direction and quality bar for UX, UI, interaction design and the website design system
    • Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to improve journeys, messaging and conversion over time
    • Sign off on experience quality before major launches.

    Team and agency leadership

    • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product design, experience production, transformation and discoverability
    • Give people clear outcomes, decision rights, constructive feedback and room to do excellent work
    • Build an effective working model with the central Content team, GTM technology, Global IT and service-line marketers.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 10 - 15 years experience leading digital products, customer experiences, service design or product design
  • A strong record of turning customer insight and business strategy into coherent end-to-end experiences
  • Excellent judgment across product, UX, content and design, with the ability to recognize and explain what good looks like
  • Strong writing and editorial instincts, including the confidence to simplify complex ideas and challenge unclear copy
  • Experience working with marketing, product, design, engineering and senior business stakeholders
  • Commercial understanding and the ability to connect digital experience decisions to go-to-market outcomes
  • Systems thinking, including experience creating reusable patterns, design systems, operating models or publishing frameworks
  • Practical understanding of search, structured content and how AI assistants discover and interpret information
  • Experience using AI tools to improve how work is researched, designed, produced or assured
  • The ability to operate in ambiguity, make difficult prioritization decisions and move from strategy to delivery
  • Evidence of leading and coaching people or multidisciplinary teams.

Professional Skills

  • You have a natural ability to establish and nurture relationships with senior leaders across the organization
  • You have excellent context-switching capabilities
  • You thrive in situations where you are given little to no direction and have the ability to lead, organize and deliver commitments on time and within budget
  • You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives. You don’t shy away from risks, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them
  • You’re empathetic and use this ability to build solid working relationships and resolve issues quickly and thoughtfully

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

title: Senior Systems Engineer - Commissioning and Characterisation
description:
About the job

Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. 

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.

You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.

Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.

You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.

 

The team and culture

The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together.

We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.

You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other.

One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are.

 

What we're looking for

  • Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems.
  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence.
  • Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams.
  • Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. We actively welcome applications from engineers to the profession through a returnship or after a career break.

 

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
  • Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

 

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

 

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

If you want to explore how complex AI systems really behave, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join the Systems Engineering team.

Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast. This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company. You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. ABOUT THE ROLE

At Shift, we are building the next generation of AI-driven platform capabilities. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead AI Engineer in our Data & AI Platform Engineering team to drive our LLMOps roadmap and our most business-critical agentic use cases; someone who is deeply passionate about building, prototyping, and scaling modern AI/LLM systems, while leading a small team.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a senior builder who excels at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technologies (Agentic frameworks, LLM orchestration, MCP, GenAI, MLOps) and production-grade software engineering. You will lead a focused team of engineers and work directly with software engineers and product leaders to design, prototype, and ship state-of-the-art AI systems into production, while acting as the link with our Data Science team to align priorities with their needs and spread best practices.

If you are a senior AI engineer looking for the next step in your career, where you can lead people and shape a roadmap without giving up hands-on coding and building, this role is for you.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build agentic systems (hands-on): design and ship production-grade agentic workflows (LLM orchestration, tool calling, MCP, RAG, structured outputs), and define reference architectures that decide what a model handles and what deterministic code handles.
  • Own LLMOps standards: evaluation harnesses, prompt and agent versioning, tracing (OpenTelemetry), cost and token governance, and release gates, with tenant-aware patterns that respect client data isolation.
  • Evolve our ML platform: be the technical owner of our Databricks-based ML platform (Unity Catalog, MLflow, CI/CD to serving on AKS, monitoring), and extend it toward the agent and prompt lifecycle.
  • Run & Serve Open-Weight Models: Partner closely with our Cloud Ops team to design and deploy the architecture required to self-host open-weight foundation models internally. You will own the inference layer and model optimizations (latency, throughput), while collaborating seamlessly with Cloud Ops on GPU resource provisioning and cluster management.  
  • Push the frontier: run time-boxed POCs on emerging techniques, such as relational foundation models for claims fraud detection or agentic ingestion of medical billing sources to generate claim edits, with clear success criteria and a path to production.
  • Lead and grow the team: coach and develop 2 to 5 people, raise the technical bar through design and code reviews, and partner with product, SMEs, architecture, security and SRE.

 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Agentic AI expertise: proven experience building production agentic systems (Microsoft Agent Framework, OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI, LangGraph or custom), and strong command of tool calling, MCP, RAG and evaluation.
  • MLOps and engineering: high proficiency in Python; hands-on experience with experiment tracking, model registry, serving and monitoring (ideally Databricks and MLflow); backend services on Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform and event-driven patterns.
  • Applied ML curiosity: solid ML foundations, ability to judge new approaches critically; exposure to graph ML, fraud or claims data is a plus.
  • Software design: high proficiency in Python and strong experience with OOP; proven ability to design robust, maintainable software systems and write clean code, applying the right design patterns and software engineering best practices.
  • Leadership: experience leading technical initiatives across stakeholders, and coaching or managing technical contributors (or a clear motivation to do so).

  • Jump in and get things done: You are a proactive builder who loves turning ambitious ideas into working code. You don't wait for permission to solve hard problems.

title: Director, Product-Led Growth
description:
About Upsun

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It’s built for hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and people focus on the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale with confidence, without wrestling with backend infrastructure.

Upsun Dispatch, our newest offering, brings that same idea to the whole team. It’s the platform for governed collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional humans. Agents handle the volume in isolated sandboxes. People make the decisions that matter, with every approval and every cost on the record.

We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. “Up” stands for uptime, reliability, and acceleration. “Sun” reflects our follow-the-sun support: a 24x7, globally distributed team keeping the lights on while you rest. We believe software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global team, and we thrive in a multicultural one. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment, and our people span the whole experience spectrum. What ties us together is curiosity, a thirst for knowledge, and an eagerness for new ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together when the environment frees you to do your best work.

Our values:
🌿 We make a positive impact.
✨ We aim for the stars.
💚 We care for each other.

Impact of a Director, Product-Led Growth

As Director, PLG, you’ll lead the strategy, execution, and commercial success of Upsun’s product-led revenue engine. Upsun is expanding its portfolio with Upsun Dispatch, a strategic new offer that joins Upsun Cloud, and this role will turn that expansion into measurable growth. 

Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own the revenue target for product-led experiences, building a scalable engine across developer recruitment, freemium conversion, and customer retention. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering, you will bridge technical platform capabilities with market-driven execution to scale Upsun’s global footprint. 

What to expect

  • Own product-led revenue: Be accountable for ARR from self-serve experiences, from first signup through conversion, expansion, and retention. 

  • Drive growth goals: Build and execute PLG programs to achieve clear top-line ARR milestones and hit aggressive user acquisition targets with specific focus in Europe and North America.  

  • Connect growth and product: Partner closely with the Head of Growth (Marketing), Head of User Acquisition and Conversion (Marketing)  and Upsun Dispatch Product Managers (Product/Engineering) to translate product strategy into measurable customer and business outcomes.  

  • Optimize the funnel: Define in-product monetization levers, optimize self-service funnels, and partner with Sales to refine Product-Led Sales (PLS) handoffs for enterprise accounts.  

  • Build tight feedback loops: Analyze intent data, user behavior, and churn metrics to continuously iterate on user onboarding, NPS, and lifetime value.  

What you bring

  • PLG and growth leadership: A track record as a Senior Product Manager or Director with growth and commercial revenue responsibilities at a developer-focused, SaaS, or cloud platform company driven primarily by a PLG model.  

  • Strategic judgment: Ability to turn complex developer platform capabilities into intuitive self-service user experiences that drive clear, measurable business value.  

  • Cross-functional execution: A record of leading cross-functional growth initiatives across Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering.

  • Data-driven approach: Hands-on depth in growth analytics, conversion funnels, freemium-to-paid activation, and retention.

  • Developer and AI fluency: Practical understanding of modern developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and how AI-assisted development tools are reshaping user expectations.  

Bonus points

  • Dual-funnel experience: Running both self-serve funnels (PLG) and enterprise sales handoffs (PLS).

  • Platform background: Cloud infrastructure, PaaS, DevOps, or developer platforms.

  • Global scale: Scaling product-led revenue across remote-first, international teams.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. 

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.   

You can expect 5 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Chief Marketing Officer)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (IC)
  4. 60 Minutes with Team (Head of Growth)
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

title: Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer - Paris/Grenoble
description: Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer – Paris/Grenoble About Vinci We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows. Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy and determinism of traditional simulation and the speed and scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world's most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market, and integrated into complex systems. Role Overview As a pivotal leader within our European technical sales team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci's platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating the transformative value of our software. By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition, showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market. Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges, including both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware. You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci's capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement. This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team. Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe. Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers. Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci's technical and business value. Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline, and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting. Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, and partner directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features. Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations. Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci's differentiators effectively. Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications) Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions, either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software. Industry domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems. Customer engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships. Automation & scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data. Leadership impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams. Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives. Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) Multiphysics breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows. Commercial track record: Direct experience commercializing technical software, ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools, into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises. Go-to-market experience: Prior experience within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments. Emerging tech adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools. Why Join Us Don't just use AI; help redefine how next-generation hardware is designed. Work at the convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering. Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.     À propos de Vinci Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants. C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés et mis en production.   Présentation du poste En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment , vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l’adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d’ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d’accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel. En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients , vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d’améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché. Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la physique thermique et des stratégies de refroidissement, vous guiderez l’analyse de systèmes complexes de gestion thermique, notamment les phénomènes de transfert de chaleur, d’écoulement des fluides et de dissipation thermique, en régime permanent comme transitoire. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que les risques thermiques, la fiabilité des composants, la densité de puissance et l’efficacité des solutions de refroidissement, afin de concevoir des systèmes de gestion thermique performants pour les équipements de nouvelle génération. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d’usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d’interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering , en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la plateforme. Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail , avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l’équipe américaine   Responsabilités Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, en définissant l’orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l’équipe, et en pilotant l’exécution sur le terrain à travers l’Europe. Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels. Accompagner les équipes d’ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d’évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l’exécution de cas de test complexes et l’interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci. Piloter l’accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l’onboarding, le déploiement et l’expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes. Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés. Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d’événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme. Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci. Qualifications (Qualifications minimales) Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié. Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+ ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en gestion thermique et solutions de refroidissement — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique. Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies. Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client. Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations. Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie. Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes.   Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants) Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance du calcul de structures (FEA/contraintes) et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI). Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique. Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique. Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA.   Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus. Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux. Collaborez avec des équipes d'ingénierie et de recherche de renommée mondiale , dans un environnement de start-up en forte croissance. Lieu : Paris ou Grenoble, France Type d'emploi : Temps plein Mode de travail : Télétravail Département : Commercial Compensation: €120K – €130K • €120K – €130K Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Retail
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to retail organisations across France. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with retail, grocery, fashion, and e-commerce companies. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the retail sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to retail stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities in merchandising and supply chain, store operations, e-commerce and marketing, and customer service. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with retail decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the retail sector. Navigate complex retail organisations to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to retail procurement cycles, trading calendars and budgeting processes to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyse retail market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns
  • Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within merchandising and supply chain teams, store operations, e-commerce and marketing functions, and customer service. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for retail applications
  • Navigate complex retail stakeholder ecosystems including executives, business and operations leadership, IT departments, and procurement offices to build consensus
  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from retail users and conveying retail market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for retail
  • Continuously refine the retail sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimise sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies
  • A track record of managing complex sales cycles within retail organisations and securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and retail use cases
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate retail organisational structures and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, business and operations leadership, and IT departments
  • Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements within retail procurement frameworks and policies
  • Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various retail audiences, from operational and digital teams to senior executives
  • Deep understanding of retail buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points
  • A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the retail market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities
  • Fluent in French and English
  • A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for retail use

 

À propos du poste

En tant qu'Enterprise Account Executive chez Anthropic, vous rejoindrez l'équipe fondatrice chargée de faire découvrir notre API de productivité IA de pointe et nos solutions SaaS aux entreprises du secteur de la distribution et du commerce en France. Vous favoriserez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre en concluant des contrats stratégiques avec des entreprises de la distribution, de la grande distribution alimentaire, de la mode et de l'e-commerce. Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise de la vente consultative dans le secteur du retail pour accélérer la croissance du chiffre d'affaires. Vous nouerez aussi des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes du secteur et les aiderez à intégrer et à déployer l'IA, tout en leur faisant découvrir l'étendue de ses capacités dans le merchandising et la supply chain, l'exploitation des magasins, l'e-commerce et le marketing, et le service client. En collaboration avec les équipes GTM, Produit et Marketing, vous affinerez en continu notre proposition de valeur, notre méthodologie de vente et notre positionnement, afin qu'ils trouvent un écho auprès des instances décisionnelles du secteur du retail.

Le profil idéal a à cœur de développer de nouveaux segments de marché, de repérer les opportunités à fort potentiel et de mettre en œuvre les stratégies qui permettent de les saisir. En favorisant le déploiement des produits émergents d'Anthropic, vous aiderez les entreprises à acquérir de nouvelles capacités tout en contribuant au développement éthique de l'IA.

Responsabilités :

  • Remporter de nouveaux contrats et générer du chiffre d'affaires pour Anthropic dans le secteur du retail. Vous orienter au sein d'organisations complexes pour atteindre les personnes décisionnaires clés, leur présenter nos services et les aider à réussir avec Anthropic. Vous piloterez l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la première prise de contact à la signature.
  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies commerciales innovantes, adaptées aux cycles d'achat, aux calendriers commerciaux et aux processus budgétaires du retail, afin d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. Analyser le paysage, les tendances et les dynamiques du marché du retail pour traduire les plans stratégiques en actions et campagnes commerciales ciblées.
  • Piloter l'expansion sur le marché en identifiant de nouveaux cas d'usage au sein des équipes merchandising et supply chain, de l'exploitation des magasins, des fonctions e-commerce et marketing, et du service client. Collaborer de manière transverse pour différencier nos offres destinées aux applications du retail.
  • Naviguer dans des écosystèmes complexes de parties prenantes (direction générale, directions métiers et opérations, DSI et services achats) afin de construire un consensus.
  • Contribuer à la feuille de route et aux fonctionnalités produit en recueillant les retours des équipes utilisatrices du secteur et en relayant les besoins du marché. Apporter des éclairages qui renforcent notre proposition de valeur pour le retail.
  • Affiner en continu la méthodologie de vente dédiée au retail en intégrant les enseignements dans des playbooks, des modèles et des bonnes pratiques. Identifier des améliorations de processus qui optimisent la productivité et la cohérence commerciales.

Ce poste pourrait vous correspondre si vous avez :

  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience en vente B2B (SaaS, solutions API ou technologies émergentes)
  • Une solide expérience de la gestion de cycles de vente complexes au sein d'entreprises du retail et de la conclusion de contrats stratégiques, fondée sur une compréhension fine des exigences techniques comme des cas d'usage du secteur
  • Une capacité avérée à naviguer dans les organisations et les processus d'achat du retail, en construisant un consensus entre des parties prenantes variées, dont la direction, les directions métiers et opérations et les DSI
  • Une vaste expérience de la négociation d'accords complexes dans le cadre des politiques et procédures d'achat du retail
  • Une expérience confirmée du dépassement des objectifs de chiffre d'affaires, grâce à une gestion efficace d'un pipeline et d'un processus de vente en constante évolution
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication et l'aisance nécessaire pour présenter devant des publics variés du retail, des équipes opérationnelles et digitales jusqu'aux membres de la direction
  • Une connaissance approfondie des cycles d'achat, des processus de décision et des principales problématiques du secteur du retail
  • Une approche stratégique et analytique du marché du retail, alliée à une exécution tactique et créative pour saisir les opportunités
  • Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais
  • Un intérêt marqué pour les systèmes d'IA avancés et leurs applications, voire une expérience dans ce domaine. Le développement sûr et éthique des systèmes d'IA de pointe pour les usages du retail vous tient particulièrement à cœur.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
