title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
description:
About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

Job Summary

As SiTime’s Field Marketing Manager for EMEA, you are the regional marketing lead responsible for translating global campaigns and product launches into programs that build awareness, engagement, and qualified pipeline. Reporting to the Director, Growth Marketing and partnering with EMEA sales leadership, you are the voice of the region within corporate marketing; bringing local market intelligence, sales insights & priorities, and program performance data to inform marketing investments & programs across EMEA.

This is SiTime's first dedicated field marketing hire in EMEA, so you will help build the regional playbook, leveraging global campaigns and programs while bringing regional insight and recommendations back to the corporate team. You will establish an operating rhythm with sales, activate distribution and rep partners, and ensure global programs land effectively in local markets.

 Qualification and Requirements:

  • Demonstrated success building and executing regional marketing plans that generate qualified pipeline against the objectives of a named sales territory.
  • Working knowledge of EMEA country and regional dynamics; differences in buying behavior, design activity, media landscape, language, and business culture across Germany, the UK, France, the Nordics, Italy, Israel, and emerging markets in the region.
  • Ability to localize global campaigns and messaging for regional relevance — adapting content, channels, and offers to how the region actually buys, rather than translating them.
  • Proven experience owning regional events end to end: trade shows, seminars, webinars, customer roundtables, and partner activities, including objectives, booth strategy, logistics, staffing, budget, and lead follow-up.
  • Experience marketing through distribution and rep channels such as partner enablement, co-marketing programs, MDF planning, and joint demand generation.
  • Ability to work in direct partnership with regional sales leadership: joint account targeting, agreed pipeline objectives, lead follow-up SLAs, and regular pipeline reviews.
  • Ownership of a regional program budget, with clear reporting on spend, pipeline contribution, and ROMI by country, program, and account.
  • Hands-on fluency with marketing automation, CRM, and BI reporting to build regional campaign flows, track lead flow through to sales, and report performance without waiting on corporate.
  • Excellent communication and project management skills, with the ability to operate independently across time zones, cultures, and competing regional priorities.
  • It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. 
  • nglish proficiency is required, including the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and perform job responsibilities in a professional business environment.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Minimum 7+ years in field, regional, or channel marketing within the semiconductor, electronic components, or high-technology industry, including direct EMEA responsibility.
  • Based in EMEA, able to travel across the region approximately 30% of the time, and effective working with a US-headquartered marketing team.
  • Business-level English required; German, French, or an additional regional language strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with the EMEA electronics event calendar (embedded world, electronica, and the key regional and vertical conferences) and a point of view on where to invest and where not to.
  • Established relationships with, or strong working knowledge of, EMEA distribution and rep partners (Arrow, Avnet/EBV, Future, Mouser, Digi-Key, Farnell) and the regional trade media landscape.
  • Understanding of the region’s priority end markets — automotive, industrial and automation, aerospace and defense, telecom infrastructure, and datacenter — and how design-win cycles differ across them.
  • Practical command of GDPR and regional data privacy requirements as they govern event data capture, lead handling, and email programs.
  • Comfortable building process from scratch, prioritizing without a template, and asking for what the region needs.
  • Experience applying AI tools to accelerate localization, content adaptation, and regional reporting.
  • Known for building trust quickly with sales teams and partners, with superb verbal, presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s Degree required in marketing, communications, business, or related field; technical or engineering background a plus.

Compensation Range: 

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

SiTime is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Sr Agent Architect (France)
description:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).
  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.
  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.
  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.
  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.
  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.
  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.
  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.
  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.
  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).
  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).
  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.
  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance. 
  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.
  • Fluency in French and English is required

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

 

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: About the role Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast. We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier , and the rest of the tech team. Your core responsibilities will be to: Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers     Requirements You’re a great match if you: Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production. Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment   Example Projects Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine   Our Stack Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform Details The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day. We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here . Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!   About Linkup   Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.   Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.   Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.   Our Team We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents. A bit more about our 3 co-founders: Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen , an open source search engine. Denis Charrier - Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctorant en vision et apprentissage : Détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments
skills: LIRIS - Laboratoire d'Informatique en Image et Systèmes d'Information
description: Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions. Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos. Présentation de la thématique : Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments. Description de la mission La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable. Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée. Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments. Le planning envisagé est le suivant : Phase 1 – Acquisition et préparation des données (M1–M12) • Définition des protocoles de mesure avec CMDL (typologies de bâtiments, scénarios de défauts). • Réalisation de campagnes de mesures robotisées (IR + RGB) sur plusieurs sites pilotes. • Constitution d’un jeu de données annoté (défauts, zones saines, contexte BIM). Phase 2 – Contextualisation spatiale et fusion multimodale (M3–M5) • Alignement spatial des images IR et RGB, prise en compte de la géométrie des façades. • Développement de méthodes de fusion multimodale pour produire des représentations conjointes robustes. Phase 3 – Segmentation sémantique et filtrage des perturbations (M6–M9) • Développement de modèles de segmentation sémantique pour distinguer les zones pertinentes (parois, menuiseries, éléments techniques) des perturbations (mobilier, objets, reflets). • Intégration de connaissances expertes CMDL pour guider les classes et les règles de filtrage. Phase 4 – Détection d’anomalies et classification des défauts (M10–M16) • Mise en place de modèles de détection d’anomalies thermiques et de classification des défauts (ponts thermiques, défauts d’étanchéité à l’air, artefacts liés aux matériaux). • Apprentissage frugal à partir de jeux de données limités, complétés éventuellement par des données simulées. Phase 5 – Génération du diagnostic et validation en environnement pertinent (M16–M18) • Génération automatique de diagnostics structurés (liste de défauts, typologie, sévérité) et localisation dans le plan/BIM. • Campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux bâtiments, comparaison avec l’analyse d’experts humains (temps, précision, taux de faux positifs/faux négatifs). • Consolidation de la preuve de concept (TRL 5) et préparation des suites de valorisation. Profil recherché / Compétences attendues Diplômes : Doctorat en Informatique Connaissances requises : Vision par Ordinateurs, Apprentissage automatique, Apprentissage profond Compétences opérationnelles : Bonne maîtrise du langage Python et de librairies d’apprentissage profond telles que PyTorch, de l’anglais, et bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et de communication orale Compétences comportementales : Motivation, rigueur, autonomie, proactivité. description: Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences techniques au service de la Justice, contribuer à la résolution d’enquêtes et à la manifestation de la vérité ? Alors rejoignez notre équipe et mettez vos talents au service d’une mission qui a du sens ! Qui sommes-nous ? Nous intervenons en qualité d’experts judiciaires, principalement sur des affaires pénales complexes, pour le compte de juges d’instruction et de forces de l’ordre. title: Senior Specialist, QA
description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role: 

The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches. 

The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. The person will coordinate batch-release activities across Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and external manufacturing partners, ensuring that issues are identified, escalated and resolved in a timely manner. The position will also lead process improvements, support inspection readiness and promote high standards of data integrity and Good Documentation Practice across the batch-release process. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Batch Review and Release Readiness 
  • Coordinate the end-to-end QA review of executed batch manufacturing, packaging, testing and release documentation for IMP and Commercial biological batch records. 
  • Coordinate the preparation and collation of batch documentation required for final batch disposition or QP certification from internal and external sources. 
  • Verify that batch records are complete, accurate, and compliant with approved procedures, specifications and applicable GMP requirements. 
  • Confirm that relevant deviations, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and laboratory results have been appropriately assessed and approved before release. 
  • Identify documentation gaps, discrepancies and potential compliance risks, and coordinate their timely resolution. 
  • Maintain oversight of batch-release priorities, review status, outstanding actions, and planned release dates. 
  • Escalate critical issues or potential delays to Quality leadership and relevant stakeholders. 
  • Ensure that batch-release documentation is appropriately archived and readily retrievable electronically. 

 

  • Quality Systems and Compliance: 
  • Ensure batch-release activities are performed in accordance with current GMP, Good Documentation Practice, data-integrity principles, and internal procedures. 
  • Support the effective operation of quality systems associated with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, and training. 
  • Review and approve relevant quality documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, checklists, and batch-release procedures. 
  • Maintain controlled documentation and ensure that current approved versions are available to relevant personnel. 
  • Support periodic reviews of procedures and identify opportunities to strengthen compliance and operational effectiveness. 
  • Promote the appropriate use of electronic quality and document management systems. 
  • Act as a subject-matter expert for batch documentation, release-readiness and associated document-control processes for all batch release activities. 
  • Internal Team Coordination (EU QA) 
  • Provide day-to-day leadership and technical guidance to QA batch reviewers and supporting personnel. 
  • Plan and allocate batch-review activities according to business priorities, product demand, and release timelines. 
  • Monitor team workload, quality metrics, and completion of assigned activities. 
  • Develop and deliver training in Good Documentation Practice, batch-record review and relevant quality-system processes. 
  • Support onboarding and qualifications of new QA team members. 
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within the QA function. 

 

  • External Team Collaboration: 
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control / CMC, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Supply and other relevant functions to support timely batch release. 
  • Coordinate with all Summit CMOs, testing laboratories and service providers to obtain missing documents and resolve release-related queries. 
  • Communicate batch status, risks, priorities and outstanding actions clearly to internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Support changes affecting batch documentation or release processes. 
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings concerning batch disposition, documentation, readiness, and supply continuity internally. 

 

  • Inspection Readiness and Continuous Improvement 
  • Maintain batch-release processes and supporting records in a continuous state of inspection of readiness. 
  • Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, internal audits, and supplier audits. 
  • Retrieve and present batch documentation and quality-system records during audits and inspections. 
  • Track batch-review metrics, recurring documentation issues, cycle times, and overdue actions. 
  • Analyse trends and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, right-first-time performance and compliance. 
  • Lead or contribute to Lean and process-optimization initiatives within the batch-release function. 
  • Support the implementation and enhancement of electronic quality, document management and reporting systems. 

Qualifications and Experience 

  • Essential 
  • Recognized qualification in Quality, Pharmaceutical Science, Life Sciences, Engineering or related discipline. 
  • Significant experience in Quality Assurance within a pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or similarly regulated manufacturing environment – preferably in Biologic manufacturing, Packaging and Labelling environments.  
  • Practical experience reviewing executed batch records and supporting batch disposition or QP certification activities. 
  • Knowledge of GMP, Good Documentation Practice, and data-integrity requirements. 
  • Experience working with deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and change controls. 
  • Experience using electronic quality, document management and other enterprise-systems - systems such as MasterControl, NetSuite, Veeva Vault, TrackWise, SAP or equivalent platforms. 
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple priorities and deliver against critical release timelines. 
  • Experience supporting the release of medicinal products or investigational medicinal products. 
  • Experience working with contract manufacturing organizations and external testing laboratories 

 

  • Key Competencies 
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy 
  • Sound quality and compliance judgement 
  • Leadership and team coordination 
  • Effective prioritization and workload management 
  • Problem-solving and risk-based decision-making 
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management 
  • Audit and inspection readiness 
  • Data integrity and information governance 
  • Process improvement and operational efficiency 
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment 

 

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems. Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems. Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader. Languages : English. German is a big plus. Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products. Availability : 100%, as soon as possible. Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position. Preferred: Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means. Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. Frontend: React and TypeScript. Mindset: Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself. Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you. Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter. Benefits Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work. Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company. Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days. Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out. The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one. Sounds like you? Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points: About you: A short description of yourself. Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences. Startup: Why do you fit a startup? Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together. Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description: About Papers Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it. Your portfolio includes: Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones. Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks. Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets. As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges. Your role We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline. Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking. If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics. 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows. 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput. Core Responsibilities 1. Storytelling That Converts Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy. Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth. Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion. Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct. 2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment. Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices. Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency. 4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties. Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments. Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth. Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments. What We Are Looking For Essential Experience & Qualifications 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines. Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality. Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts. Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools. Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably. CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho. title: Hardware Test Engineer
description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines. You develop and execute hardware tests at board and sub-system level, identifying potential issues early and helping our engineers deliver robust, production-ready solutions. Combining hands-on hardware engineering with test automation, you build test setups, analyze results, support prototype development, and help transfer testing processes from R&D to production. Design and maintain test setups, fixtures, and jigs for functional, electrical, and optical testing. Perform environmental, stability, and robustness testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, and EMC/ESD pre-compliance. Develop Python-based test automation for instrument control, data logging, and analysis. Document test procedures, results, and findings, ensuring clear traceability and reproducibility. Develop and improve production and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) setups, procedures, and test jigs. Support troubleshooting, repairs, and root-cause investigations during development and production. Maintain an organized, safe, and well-equipped R&D laboratory, including equipment calibration and materials management. Technical Analysis & Continuous Improvement Analyze test results to evaluate hardware performance, identify risks, and support engineering decisions. Identify opportunities to improve test methods, automation, and product reliability. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Electronics, Photonics, Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, IVVQ, and production teams. Support the handover of tested hardware and documentation to integration, validation, and production teams. Independently plan and execute assigned activities, communicating progress, risks, and dependencies. Share technical knowledge, contribute to design reviews, and support continuous improvement across the team. What we offer Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups. Qualifications BSc (HBO) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. 2+ years of relevant experience in hardware testing, test engineering, prototyping, or lab work on electronic or electro-optical products. Hands-on experience with laboratory instruments such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, and data loggers; experience with optical power meters is an advantage. Experience executing test plans and procedures, logging and analyzing measurement data, and documenting results in clear test reports. Good soldering and rework skills for through-hole and SMD components, including building custom cables and harnesses, and the ability to read schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams, and assembly drawings. Experience with or good understanding of environmental testing (e.g. temperature, thermal cycling, vibration) and of EMC/ESD principles. Python skills for test automation, instrument control, and data analysis; experience with LabVIEW, embedded Linux or similar tools is advantageous. Awareness of ESD-safe working practices and lab safety, including laser safety, or willingness to be trained. A structured, practical, and hands-on working style, and real enjoyment of testing, finding problems, and getting hardware to work. Good communication skills in English and a collaborative working style. Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance. Savings for old age: we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary. Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave! Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. title: AI platform engineer
description: Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van cloud, platform engineering en AI? Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe platformfunctionaliteiten. Het doorontwikkelen van onze centrale dashboard- en beheeromgeving. Het bouwen van AI-agents, agentic workflows, API's en integraties. Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van Terraform-modules en andere automatiseringen. Het inrichten van human-in-the-loop-processen, approvals en guardrails. Het analyseren en automatiseren van terugkerende operationele werkzaamheden. Het ondersteunen bij incidenten, troubleshooting en wijzigingen wanneer dat nodig is. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelf verbeterkansen te signaleren, ideeën uit te werken en oplossingen te realiseren. Daarbij willen we AI en automation een steeds grotere rol geven, zodat onze engineers minder tijd kwijt zijn aan repetitieve werkzaamheden en meer ruimte hebben voor complexe vraagstukken en innovatie. title: Senior MLOps Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer domain's Data Science teams build and iterate on our most critical ML systems—like ranking, retrieval, and recommendations—that serve millions of users. As our ambition and the complexity of these models grow, we are scaling our MLOps capabilities to match: 

We are hiring an MLOps Engineer to solve this. This is a high-impact "bridge" role, not to build new platforms, but to be the expert user of our existing platforms (GCP/Vertex AI, Vespa, Triton). Your mission is to take our Data Science team's work, rectify the current ad-hoc solutions, and build the robust, automated, and high-quality "path-to-production" our advanced models require.

Also by joining Vinted, you’ll become part of an active community of engineers who are keen on sharing knowledge, organizing learning workshops and so much more!

In this position, you’ll 

  • Productionise ML models: be responsible for migrating all existing model training code from experimental or proof-of-concept stages to robust and automated pipelines.
  • Build continuous training (CT) pipelines: design, build, and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, model training, and batch scoring.
  • Automate model serving & integration: package and deploy traditional ML models (e.g., in ONNX format) to our existing serving infrastructure, primarily Vespa and/or Triton.
  • Close the deployment loop: automate model deployments where they are still manual. For example, building a GitHub Action that deploys a new model to Vespa, triggered by a webhook from a successful Vertex AI training pipeline.
  • Build the missing quality gates: build the automated quality and evaluation gates that our pipelines lack today. This includes:
  • Establish and uphold ML Model Lifecycle Standards: Take ownership of and continuously improve the standards, quality, and governance of the complete ML model lifecycle.

About you 

  • We are looking for an "ML-literate" Software Engineer, not a Data Scientist. You are a builder and an automator with a strong service mindset.
  • Must-have technical skills: deep expertise in GCP/Vertex AI (or equivalents like SageMaker), Kubernetes, and Docker.
  • Automation expertise: proven experience building robust CI/CD and automation pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).
  • ML-Literate: you understand ML workflows and concepts (training, evaluation, inference) well enough to debug pipelines and build meaningful quality gates.
  • Soft skills: a strong "service mindset," excellent communication, and the ability to act as a bridge between the highly technical worlds of Data Science and Infrastructure. You are pragmatic and driven to get high-quality work into production.
  • Bonus Points: familiarity with ML serving platforms like Vespa search engine or NVIDIA Triton and model formats like ONNX.
  • Willingness to learn and master new technologies and concepts.
  • We value pragmatism, big-picture thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving skills.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • A daily lunch allowance
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • An NS mobility card
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:
€89.000—€121.400 EUR

title: Mission Critical Security Engineer – Threat Hunting
description:
Help protect what truly matters in our customers' most critical environments by proactively identifying threats and improving how they are detected and addressed.

As a Mission Critical Security Engineer with a focus on Threat Hunting, you will be part of a dedicated customer team responsible for securing and continuously improving a complex, mission-critical application landscape.

Working alongside other engineers and security specialists, you will help ensure the environment remains as secure and resilient as possible. You combine a strong engineering foundation with a security mindset, taking ownership of security improvements and understanding how systems, applications, and infrastructure behave.

Your specific focus will be on threat hunting and detection engineering. Using your in-depth knowledge of the customer's technology stack and application landscape, you will fine-tune existing detection use cases and develop new ones tailored to the environment. You will use our custom SIEM/SOAR-based Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform to turn emerging threats and technical insights into actionable detection capabilities.

This role bridges security engineering, detection engineering, and threat intelligence. You don't simply follow predefined playbooks. You understand system behavior, identify gaps, and develop practical solutions that strengthen the security of the customer's environment.

/ What you will do

Threat intelligence & continuous improvement

  • Actively follow security developments, vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence and translate these into relevant hunts and detections.

  • Identify security risks and gaps in detection coverage and proactively propose improvements.

  • Use your knowledge of the customer's application and infrastructure landscape to continuously strengthen its security posture.

  • Contribute to the evolution of the team's security monitoring and detection strategy.

Communication & advisory

  • Translate findings into clear, actionable communication for engineers, customer stakeholders, and security specialists.

  • Contribute to security advisories and share relevant threats across the customer team and wider organization.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand system behavior and validate detection strategies.

  • Collaborate with the customer's Security Operations Center (SOC) to align security monitoring, threat detection, and response activities.

  • Help establish and improve integrations with the customer's SIEM/SOAR platform, including the forwarding of relevant logs and security telemetry.

Detection engineering & threat hunting

  • Develop and continuously improve detection use cases based on emerging threats and observed behavior.

  • Translate threat scenarios and security insights into actionable detection logic tailored to the customer's environment.

  • Proactively perform threat hunting across the application and infrastructure landscape to identify abnormal or suspicious patterns.

  • Analyze logs and telemetry data to uncover behaviors that are not yet covered by existing detections.

  • Use your understanding of the customer's technology stack to distinguish normal from potentially malicious behavior.

Use case development & response design

  • Define what should happen when detections trigger, including response actions, automation, and escalation paths.

  • Continuously refine detection logic to improve quality, relevance, and signal-to-noise ratio.

  • Build and fine-tune custom detection scenarios based on the specific characteristics and security requirements of the customer's environment.

Platform collaboration

  • Leverage our custom SIEM/SOAR-based MDR platform to implement detections and analyze data.

  • Collaborate with platform and automation engineers to improve integrations and detection capabilities.

  • Apply engineering and automation practices to ensure detection solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

/ What you bring

We are looking for someone who combines solid engineering fundamentals with a strong interest in security and is motivated to move towards or deepen their expertise in threat hunting and detection engineering.

You don't necessarily need to be an experienced threat hunter already. What matters is your ability to understand complex systems, recognize unusual behavior, and translate technical insights into practical security improvements.

Must-have skills

  • Solid engineering fundamentals, including Linux, networking, and infrastructure behavior.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with CI/CD, Git, and configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Strong automation mindset and the ability to translate problems into scalable solutions.

  • Experience working with logs and telemetry to analyze system behavior and investigate technical issues.

  • Experience with Python and/or Bash scripting.

  • Familiarity with SIEM or log analytics platforms such as OpenSearch, Elastic, Splunk, or Microsoft Sentinel.

  • Strong understanding of security principles, including threat detection and response.

  • Ability to distinguish normal from abnormal system behavior.

  • Analytical, curious, and driven to understand how systems and threats behave.

  • Ownership mindset, with responsibility for security quality and continuous improvement.

  • Strong communication skills to translate technical findings into actionable insights.

  • Ability to connect business and customer context to technical security solutions.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Hands-on experience with threat hunting, detection engineering, or advanced SOC operations.

  • Experience developing or improving detection use cases and security monitoring rules.

  • Experience with SOAR or security automation.

  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and other Microsoft cloud services.

  • Familiarity with threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Experience integrating SIEM/SOAR platforms or forwarding security telemetry between different environments.

/ Who are you?

You are an engineer with a strong interest in security, driven to understand how systems behave and how threats manifest.

You don't follow playbooks blindly. You want to understand why detections exist, how systems interact, and where security can be improved.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy working with complex applications, infrastructure, and data. You are curious, proactive, and take ownership of the quality of your work.

You also enjoy being part of a customer team where security is a shared responsibility. You work closely with fellow engineers and security specialists, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute to keeping the entire environment secure.

title: Project Engineer

title: Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Planning, Decision & Intercept
description: Building autonomous supremacy systems in Berlin Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. We design tightly integrated autonomy stacks in Europe to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces, focusing on defensive and counter-system capabilities including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions. We are looking for a Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer to build the intelligence that turns mission objectives, target information and vehicle state into executable autonomous behaviour. Your mission with us Build the autonomy layer of our high-speed aerial robotic systems. Convert mission objectives, target state and vehicle state into real-time actions and trajectories. Develop algorithms for dynamic rendezvous, pursuit, interception and terminal approach. Build target-motion prediction and intercept-point estimation for moving airborne targets. Develop real-time path planning, trajectory generation and replanning under uncertainty. Account for aircraft capabilities, energy, maneuverability, sensing uncertainty and changing target behaviour. Build decision and behaviour logic that allows the system to adapt continuously during a mission. Combine classical robotics, optimization, MPC and learned approaches where appropriate. Explore reinforcement learning, imitation learning and policy-based autonomy where they provide meaningful advantages. Work closely with perception, estimation and control engineers to close the autonomy loop. Take algorithms from simulation into real aircraft and validate them through repeated flight testing. Your contribution to the team (required) Strong robotics or autonomous-systems background with significant real-world deployment experience. Strong experience with motion planning, trajectory generation or autonomous decision-making. Deep understanding of kinematics, dynamics and optimization. Experience with dynamic environments and moving-target problems. Experience with trajectory optimization, optimal control, MPC or comparable approaches. Strong C++ skills and good Python skills. Experience deploying autonomy algorithms onto real robotic systems. Strong understanding of uncertainty and its implications for decision-making and planning. Ability to design algorithms that operate under real-time compute constraints. Hands-on attitude and willingness to participate directly in flight testing and system debugging. Big plus UAV / fixed-wing autonomy. High-speed aerial robotics. Rendezvous, pursuit or intercept problems. Target-motion prediction. Aggressive flight. Reinforcement learning on real robots. Imitation learning / learned policies. PX4. ROS2. Optimal control and trajectory optimization. Aviation, defence or space systems. Even if you don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply - we’d love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion
description: About Promethion Industries Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. Our focus is defensive and counter-system capabilities, including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions. We are looking for a Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion to build the estimation backbone that allows our aircraft to understand their own motion without depending on GNSS. Your mission with us Build the state-estimation and sensor-fusion backbone of our autonomous aerial systems. Develop robust vehicle-state estimation for high-dynamic flight and GNSS-degraded or GNSS-denied environments. Fuse IMUs, cameras, optical flow, airspeed, GNSS, barometers and other sensors into reliable low-latency estimates. Develop, integrate and deploy VIO, visual odometry, ego-motion optical flow and inertial-estimation approaches. Own temporal calibration, sensor synchronisation, coordinate frames and estimator consistency. Diagnose drift, bias, observability and timing problems from first principles. Work directly with real flight logs and hardware to reproduce estimator failures and rapidly improve performance. Build graceful degradation when individual sensors become unreliable or unavailable. Quantify estimator uncertainty and expose meaningful confidence and health information to downstream autonomy and control systems. Evaluate alternative estimation architectures including direct velocity estimation and continuous-time approaches where they provide advantages at high dynamics. Your contribution to the team (required) Strong practical experience in robotics state estimation, localization or inertial estimation. Deep understanding of IMU-based estimation and multi-sensor fusion. Strong experience with EKF, error-state filtering or comparable nonlinear-estimation techniques. Practical experience with VIO, visual odometry, optical flow or closely related systems. Strong understanding of rigid-body transformations and coordinate frames. Strong C++ skills. Experience deploying estimators onto real robots or vehicles. Strong understanding of sensor calibration and time synchronization. Experience analyzing raw sensor data, logs and estimator performance. Ability to work with high-rate, noisy and imperfect real-world measurements. Big plus High-speed UAV or fixed-wing experience. GNSS-denied flight. PX4 estimator experience. ROS2. GTSAM / Ceres / Eigen. Event-camera VIO or optical flow. Continuous-time estimation. Radar-aided or RF-aided estimation. Air-data integration. description: Über die Rolle Du gestaltest digitale Produkte für Web und Mobile, die Menschen wirklich verstehen und gern benutzen? Kenntnisse in Barrierefreiheit (WCAG) und technisches Grundverständnis für Frontend und Mobile Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, Jira und Confluence Erfahrung mit Nutzerforschung, Usability-Tests und Designsystemen Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gutes Deutsch (C1+) für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Partnern Gutes Englisch (B2+) in Wort und Schrift Was wir dir bieten Gestaltung mit Wirkung: Deine Designs werden in der medizinischen Diagnostik eingesetzt, und du hast spürbaren Einfluss auf ihre Richtung. title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)
description: Über Buena Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden. Über die Rolle Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht. Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing. Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um. Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache. Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment. Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen. Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst, und misst es sauber. Du passt, wenn du 3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz. Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal. Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise: Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung. Marketing-Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen und Kampagnen ist ein klares Plus. Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1). Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen. Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland. Deine Benefits Ein Vertical, das du von Anfang an prägst, mit 70.000 Einheiten als Basis und voller Rückendeckung vom Leadership-Team. Ein Inside-Sales-Team, auf das du zugreifen kannst: Es übernimmt Anrufe und die Bearbeitung deiner Kampagnen, damit du dich auf den Aufbau der Akquise-Engine konzentrieren kannst. Einen direkten Weg zur Verantwortung: Wenn Brokerage funktioniert, skalierst du es weiter. Top-Vergütung inklusive virtueller Aktienoptionen und 500 € Wohnzuschuss pro Monat in der Nähe unseres Büros. 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat, täglich Frühstück und Spezialitäten-Kaffee im Office. 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr. Warum jetzt einsteigen Du baust unsere Akquise-Engine von null auf. Du entwickelst die Signale, Sequenzen und Workflows, mit denen wir verkaufswillige Eigentümer in über 70.000 verwalteten Einheiten finden und bis zur Übergabe an unsere Makler begleiten. Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt aufs Geschäft. Du hast Zugriff auf Daten, die sonst niemand hat: jedes Ticket, jede Interaktion, jedes transkribierte Telefonat. Jedes Signal, das funktioniert, wird zu messbarem Umsatz im Brokerage. Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitenden im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden. Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. title: Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
description:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients.

 

What you will do:

  • Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation.
  • Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL or Python remains a plus, but the ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery is what we value most.
  • Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions.
  • Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant.
  • Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development.
  • Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact’s growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position.

 

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. 

  • Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects.
  • Education: A completed university degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Data & AI Fluency: You possess a strong affinity for data management and modern AI technologies. You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking.
  • Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected.
  • Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists).
  • Personal attributes: You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong client focus and stakeholder understanding. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German and English are required - you will participate in client workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and write deliverables in both languages. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

 

Why ARTEFACT?

  • Impactful client work: Work on challenging projects with leading national and international clients across data, digitalisation, and advanced data strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities: We believe in performance over tenure. Your growth is driven by your impact, not your length of service, with clear opportunities to progress and diverse career prospects.
  • Competitive rewards: A strong compensation package including a performance-based bonus, which is paid out half-yearly.
  • Learning & development: Join a team of passionate Data Consultants who actively support each other. You'll learn through diverse projects, collaboration, and exposure to leading experts in the field - including international work.
  • Flexibility & time off: Hybrid working model, 28 days of annual leave, plus your birthday as well as Christmas & New Year's Eve off.

 

This position is based in Berlin or Munich.

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!
