title: Tech Lead (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We are hiring a backend-leaning Tech Lead to lead a team of 3-4 engineers and own the tech for a part of Superchat’s product.

This is a hands-on leadership role: You’ll spend roughly half your time designing and building software and the other half enabling your team to perform at its best. Work directly on architecture, development and important projects while creating the clarity, feedback and environment your engineers need to deliver an excellent product

Who We Want

A strong, current backend engineer.
You bring 3+ years of experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer and remain deeply involved in software development. You are comfortable owning, designing and building crucial parts of production systems.

Experienced with the JVM ecosystem.
You have substantial experience with Java or another JVM language. Kotlin and AWS experience are a plus, since our backend runs on Kotlin/Quarkus.

Ready to lead people.
You may already have worked in a hybrid Tech Lead role, have been an Engineering manager for a short time or be taking your first steps in people leadership after successfully owning projects and architecture. What matters is that you genuiely want to help people grow

Strong at delivery.
You know how to turn product goals into reality. You are used to work in fast-paced startups and are a driver to increase velocity.

Product-minded.
You care about solving the customers problem. You engage with product decisions, challenge assumptions constructivly and find pragmatic solutions to build things in a lean way.

Clear communicator.
You are able to explain complex technical things in details to Engineers and in an understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. You create alignment and motivate people 

Excited about AI-assisted development.
You are already using AI in your development workflow and are eager to explore how it can improve engineering speed, quality and the way teams work.

Who We Don’t Want

Pure people manager.
You no longer want to work directly on software. This role requires meaningful, ongoing involvement in architecture, implementation, code review, and technical problem-solving.

Hero engineer.
You want to make every important technical decision yourself or become the bottleneck for the team. Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems.

Pure delivery manager.
You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We need engineering leaders, not project coordinators.

Remote-only operator.
You prefer fully remote work and don’t want to actively build relationships and culture in person with the team. We believe strong engineering leadership requires regular in-person collaboration and presence in Berlin.

Your Day To Day

  • Spend approximately 50% of your time contributing directly to architecture, development, code reviews, and important technical projects.
  • Lead a team of 3-4 engineers and take responsibility for its effectiveness, technical quality, and delivery.
  • Work closely with your Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape solutions, scope projects, and set priorities.
  • Establish clear technical direction while enabling engineers to own decisions and develop their judgment.
  • Run regular 1:1s, give actionable feedback, and support each engineer’s development and performance.
  • Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and help the team identify delivery risks early.
  • Improve engineering practices and explore effective uses of AI throughout the software-development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to hiring through technical interviews, structured feedback, and candidate conversations.

Stakeholders

Director of Engineering: Your manager and partner on people development, calibration, processes.
Direct Reports: Engineers in your team; you own their development, performance and growth

title: Senior Director, System Software
description:
About the job

Lead the system software organisation that turns complex hardware platforms into reliable Graphcore systems. As Director of System Software, you will report to the VP of Software and turn software strategy into clear priorities, plans and outcomes. You will lead the teams delivering firmware, drivers, OpenBMC and system software QA. Your work will shape platform bring-up, production release and long-term support across Graphcore systems. You will align technical decisions with business priorities, delivery milestones and product readiness. You will build a strong engineering organisation, developing managers, technical leaders and engineers. You will own execution, quality and cross-functional delivery across hardware, silicon, software and product teams.

This is a role for a leader who can think big, act fast and take responsibility for complex system outcomes.

The team and culture

System Software works close to the hardware, where small decisions can shape product reliability at scale. The team operates through clear ownership, evidence-based planning and direct technical debate. You will lead managers and specialists across firmware, drivers, OpenBMC and QA. Decisions are made through engineering judgement, clear trade-offs and a strong focus on delivery impact. You will be expected to speak up, challenge assumptions and help resolve issues across hardware and software boundaries. Pace matters, but so do maintainability, security and long term quality.

What we’re looking for

· A strong track record leading system software teams across closely coupled hardware and software programmes.
· Experience managing managers or multiple technical teams, with clear ownership of delivery outcomes.
· Proven ability to build, coach and develop engineering leaders through change and technical uncertainty.

You're also expected to start contributing meaningfully in code review — catching real bugs, not just style nits.

What You'll Do
  • Implement new ingestion sources end-to-end against a senior engineer's design — connector code, DAG, schema, monitoring, and catalog registration — extending the team's existing framework where a new source needs a pattern it doesn't yet support
  • Investigate pipeline failures independently, recognize known classes of issues, and ship the documented fix without needing to escalate
  • Before shipping a new pipeline, identify downstream consumers and what would break if data were late or wrong, and flag gaps like this during spec review — before writing code
  • Write clear handovers when escalating a genuinely unresolved issue — what you tried, what you ruled out, and where things diverge — so a senior can pick up without re-discovery
  • Review peers' pipeline PRs and catch non-obvious issues (e.g., missing idempotency checks, race conditions) that could cause incorrect downstream data
  • Turn ambiguous "why is this data wrong?" questions into structured investigations — tracing data lineage from source to warehouse and communicating back what you found
  • Surface concerns in spec review as specific, well-reasoned questions rather than staying silent or blocking progress
  • Support data security and governance work (e.g., PII masking, access controls) and contribute to data delivery work, including reverse ETL integrations

  • Mentor DE2s on their first significant projects — pairing on tricky decisions and helping them apply team conventions

  • Exposure to reverse ETL tools or patterns, PII masking, or data access governance (RBAC)

Experience planning and carrying out technical testing, production cutovers, and transition to customer or partner operations. Ability to facilitate technical discovery and design workshops, explain trade-offs clearly, and adapt recommendations to customer constraints and desired outcomes. Experience with source control, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and automated testing for repeatable IAM deployments. title: Senior Product Engineer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. About the role Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up. You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them. You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build.   What you’ll be doing Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production. Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it. Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight. Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it. Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control. Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship. Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it. Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you.   What you’ll need to have done Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language. Judgement in architecture and system design: a feel for what to build now, what to defer, and what will hurt in two years. Evidence of shipping software that solved a real customer or business problem, ideally something you owned end to end. A self-starting approach. You find the highest-value problem rather than waiting for a ticket. Clear communication. You can hold the same conversation with an underwriter, an executive, and an engineer, and adjust for each. Genuine appetite for problems with no known answer, and comfort working without a precedent to copy. Confident, responsible use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output. Receptiveness to feedback. We give it directly and often, and we expect you to give it back.   Helpful, not required Experience in insurance, underwriting, or another complex regulated domain. We will teach you the domain. We cannot teach curiosity about it. Experience across both backend and frontend. Experience building workflow, decision-support, or agent-assisted products. Experience working directly with enterprise clients.   You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.   Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. This team builds the systems that power how Hudl understands sport at scale. From identifying players and teams across thousands of leagues to processing the moments that become highlights, stats and analysis, our services sit at the centre of Hudl’s platform.

You’ll work on the Global Sports Library (GSL), the backbone that connects identities, metadata and game context across Hudl products. That means designing APIs, distributed services and large-scale data pipelines that help ensure every product at Hudl is operating from the same understanding of the game.

The work is backend-heavy and deeply technical: data modeling, entity resolution, ingestion pipelines, consistency challenges, scalability and platform design. The systems you build won’t just support one product or one sport, they’ll become shared capabilities used across the company.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll:

  • Collaborate across disciplines. You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team of engineers, quality analysts, product managers and designers to build foundational data tools for the best of the best in sports.
  • Deliver backend-heavy features. Your team has the autonomy to build and maintain the GSL, ensuring market teams have access to reliable, comprehensive data infrastructure. We iterate rapidly and deploy changes to our products hundreds of times a day.
  • Propose new solutions. You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges within the Core Data domain and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
  • Thrive on the front lines. You’ll build pipelines and libraries that power every feature delivered to coaches and athletes, getting firsthand experience with how our data impacts the game.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

  • Strong technical proficiency. You have at least three years of experience in engineering, specifically within backend-heavy or data-heavy environments.

About the Role

As a Solutions Engineer, you will design innovative, scalable and commercially viable warehouse and fulfilment solutions for THG Fulfil’s enterprise clients.

Working closely with customers, commercial teams, operations, engineering and technology specialists, you will translate complex operational requirements into practical warehouse designs that optimise capacity, throughput, productivity and cost efficiency.

You will develop end-to-end solutions incorporating warehouse layouts, material flows, storage strategies, automation technologies and systems integration. The role will support both third-party automation opportunities and wider 3PL proposals, including the transition of enterprise customers into THG Fulfil facilities.

Key Responsibilities

Warehouse Solution Design

  • Design end-to-end warehouse and fulfilment solutions for complex enterprise customers, from initial concept through to detailed proposals.
  • Develop warehouse layouts, storage strategies, material flows, picking methodologies and operational processes.
  • Evaluate and incorporate automation technologies, including AutoStore, Libiao and Geek+ robotics, based on customer requirements.
  • Assess capacity, throughput, labour requirements and operational constraints to ensure solutions are scalable and deliverable.

Customer Engagement & Requirements

  • Work with enterprise customers to understand operational requirements, order profiles, volumes, growth plans and service-level expectations.
  • Lead site visits, operational assessments and discovery workshops to gather requirements and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate customer needs into clear technical specifications and tailored fulfilment solutions.

Modelling & Commercial Analysis

  • Develop capacity plans, throughput models and operational resource requirements using customer data.
  • Support solution simulations, cost modelling and ROI analysis to demonstrate the benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Work with commercial teams to ensure designs are technically feasible, cost-effective and commercially viable.

Proposals & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Produce technical solution proposals incorporating warehouse layouts, process flows, automation configurations and supporting financial analysis.
  • Present solutions to customer stakeholders and support tenders, RFPs and complex sales processes.
  • Collaborate with operations, engineering, software and implementation teams to validate designs and ensure successful delivery.
  • Define integration requirements across THG Fulfil’s WMS/WCS/OMS platforms and automated warehouse equipment.

Skills & Experience Required

  • Proven experience in warehouse solutions design, logistics engineering, intralogistics, automation engineering or supply chain solutions.
  • Experience designing warehouse or fulfilment solutions for large-scale or complex operations.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse processes, including storage, replenishment, picking, packing, sortation and dispatch.
  • Knowledge of warehouse automation, including robotics, automated storage and retrieval systems, conveyors or goods-to-person solutions.
  • Experience with warehouse layouts, capacity planning, throughput modelling and operational analysis.
  • Commercial awareness, including experience supporting cost models, ROI calculations and customer proposals.
  • Understanding of WMS, WCS and OMS platforms and their integration with warehouse automation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to present complex solutions clearly to technical and commercial stakeholders.

Desirable: Experience within 3PL, contract logistics or e-commerce fulfilment, with exposure to AutoStore, Libiao, Geek+ or warehouse design and simulation tools.

As a Senior Strategist, you'll be an important strategic voice within the team, working closely with Client Services, Creative, Data, Media and other specialist disciplines to turn business and customer challenges into clear, effective solutions.

You'll work on one of our major Pan-European automotive accounts, helping develop strategy across the customer journey — from brand consideration and lead generation through to lifecycle CRM, digital experiences and retail activations.

You'll be involved from brief through to delivery, using customer understanding, data, research and cultural insight to develop strong strategic thinking and give creative teams a clear direction. You'll also help ensure the work remains connected to the client's wider commercial objectives.

title: Director of Product Design
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers. Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars. We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses. That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve.   WHAT YOU'LL DO Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years. Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger. Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience. Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it. Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers. Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems. Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better. Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself. You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple. You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both. You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better. Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference. We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real. Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most. The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers. Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without. WHY CARWOW? Genuine scale and impact: your work is used by millions of car buyers and sellers An AI-forward culture where new tools and workflows are embraced, not resisted — with access to the best tooling available A senior, supportive design team that takes craft seriously Hybrid working, competitive salary and equity, private healthcare, enhanced parental leave, and a car-buying perk you'd expect from us   WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays 28 days annual leave 1 day for your wedding 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work! For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year Work from abroad for a month Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. title: Ingénieur.e de recherche : Analyse de la chaine d'epuration de syngaz (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel. Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables. GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets. Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires. Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source. Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont : · La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature. · Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration. · L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques. · Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé. · L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations. · La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion. · La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation. CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES : Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus. Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste. PROFIL RECHERCHE : · Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? : · cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha · 49 jours de congés par an · restauration administrative sur place · aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail · action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles) INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES : Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 18 mois À usage interne : Catégorie du poste et métier de référence : Catégorie II, Métier R – Ingénieur de recherche Localisation du poste : IMT Mines Albi Date limite de candidature : 26/11/2026 Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 01/01/2027 La rémunération est fixée selon le profil du candidat (métier, âge, filière d'emploi, durée de garantie salariale), en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l'Institut Mines Télécom Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de catégorie A de la fonction publique et/ou aux personnes contractuelles Contacts : o Sur le contenu du poste : F. title: Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals, you will own a book of existing customer accounts and drive both renewal retention and expansion revenue within them. This is a growth-first role where renewal is the floor, not the goal: you will protect the base by keeping renewals healthy and on time, and grow it by uncovering whitespace, running consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations, and turning satisfied customers into expanding ones. Working closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Engineers, you will build account plans and get ahead of risk before it reaches the forecast. If you are driven to outgrow a base you know well, own your numbers, and earn a path to strategic accounts or AE-track roles through expansion results, this role is for you.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own a portfolio of existing accounts carrying a dual quota of renewal retention and expansion bookings, identifying whitespace across the SentinelOne portfolio and leading consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations built around customer use cases and outcomes rather than just quotes.
  • Spot expansion triggers early, such as new use cases, organizational growth, underutilized licenses, and competitive displacement openings, and build repeatable account plans with your CSM and SE partners that map multi-year growth rather than just the next renewal.
  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close, handling commercial negotiations including multi-year commitments and keeping timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book.
  • Identify churn and downgrade risk early by monitoring deployment health, usage, support signals, and sentiment, running save motions on at-risk accounts with CSM, Support, and leadership, and getting ahead of overdeployment and downgrade exposure before it hits the renewal.
  • Own an accurate, transparent forecast across renewal and expansion pipeline, keep Salesforce and CPQ tools current, and partner with CSMs, AEs, SEs, and Channel/MSSP partners on account coverage and growth while bringing the customer’s voice back to Product and the broader team.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 3–5 years in renewals, account management, or a customer-facing sales role with upsell and cross-sell closing experience, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota, including driving net revenue retention above 100% on your own book, with expansion outpacing churn rather than renewal completion alone.
  • Proven experience running consultative upsell and cross-sell motions, identifying and closing whitespace within an existing customer base, and negotiating confidently with senior and economic buyers across multi-stakeholder conversations.
  • A risk-aware instinct for spotting early signals of churn or downgrade, combined with strong forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, and hands-on experience with Salesforce and CPQ or quoting tools.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, curiosity about customer use cases and the product, and a habit of opening expansion conversations unprompted, with comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Exposure to Channel/MSSP or 2-tier GTM models is a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Competitive leave benefits
  • Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical and insurance benefits
  • Disability insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Global home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement
  • Work-from-home allowance

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right. Storage is at the very center of everything we do. Whatever needs to be persisted eventually uses our Storage infrastructure.   • Develop and maintain automation tools to enhance deployment processes, configuration management, and service reliability

  • Collaborate with product and security teams to implement best practices for privacy and data protection at every layer of the stack

  • Document back-end capabilities and their proper use
  • Join the oncall rotation to operate the Storage service

Job requirements: 

  • Experience building complex production systems
  • Operational experience, demonstrating the ability to diagnose and troubleshoot complex problems for critical systems
  • Experience with software development
  • Solid understanding of security best practices

title: Senior Documentation Specialist
description: About this position As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement. Your tasks: Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system. Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements. Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks. Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure. Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions. Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working. Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance. Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks. Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices. Role requirements Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline. Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment. Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model. Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight. Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions. Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions. Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions. Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. Work permit Candidate needs to hold a Swiss work permit or be an EU citizen eligible to work in Switzerland Your path forward If you meet most of these requirements and bring a strong dedication to technical documentation, we encourage you to apply. You will contribute directly to our mission of advancing new medicines for patients. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Control & Flight Test Engineer
description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving the lives of thousands? You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? Join us at CDDS to bring next-generation of control, state-estimation and computer cision algorithms into high-speed kinetic interceptor drones. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your Mission We are looking for an exceptional Control & Flight Test Engineer to drive the control, vision, hardware and operational stack of our interceptor drone platform to the next level. You will test, tune and develop state-estimation, control and vision algorithms that directly determine successful target interception. You will act as the eyes and ears of the R&D team on customer demos and field tests abroad. You will gain a big insights in all our systems as you have to make sure that they are working such that it can be deployed to a user. You will work closely with all teams, meaning control, vison, software and hardware experts — ensuring your and the teams algorithms translate directly into field performance. Core Responsibilities Designing and validate low-latency guidance and control strategies Help to push our multi-sensor fusion algorithms for state estimation Verify and test new computer vision approaches Test and Validate Low-Level Control Software and Hardware Changes Raise risks and issues you see on the field to the R&D team Analyse data, evaluate performance and failure modes of our full tactical unit while doing intercepts Requirements We are looking for people who thrive on mathematical depth , rapid iteration, and hands-on flight testing. You take full ownership of field test — Aligning with the R&D team and your Safety Pilot. Your Profile PhD or MSc in Robotics, Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering or similar field with strong academic record (from ETH Zürich or equivalent) Strong analytical mindset with the ability to derive, evaluate, and validate a complex system Good understanding of classical & optimal control, Kalman filtering, state estimation, and linear algebra (rotations and transformations in SE(3)) Proficiency in Python and Linux Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership environments with long hours when the mission demands it Openness to travel often Nice-to-Have ROS2, PX4, Ardupilot and real-time robotics software Fast-moving object interception / high-dynamics control Experience with Simulation Frameworks like Gazebo or Isaac Sim Background in drone flight testing or competitive robotics Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission‑critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape Fast‑moving startup environment with high ownership Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands‑on team Real‑world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations Attractive compensation Details Location: Zürich Hardbrücke, on‑site Start date: ASAP Environment: High‑impact deep‑tech startup working on real deployments If your interested in the position please apply via this form. title: Procurement Specialist
description: Over NovoServe NovoServe levert hosted dedicated servers vanuit meerdere datacenters in Nederland. We zijn een snelgroeiend bedrijf met een informele sfeer en internationale ambities. Onze netwerkinfrastructuur is verspreid over 8 datacenters op twee continenten, wat zorgt voor een hoge beschikbaarheid, veerkracht en een wereldwijd bereik. Je onderhoudt en versterkt duurzame relaties met onze belangrijkste leveranciers en blijft op de hoogte van nieuwe, opkomende spelers. title: Tender Manager
description: Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them? Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. Your responsibilities include: Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities; Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process; Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy; Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process; Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders; Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process; Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission; Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders; Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO; Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements; Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk; Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective; Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation; In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself. As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together. You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer That distinction is important. At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders. Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered. You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time. You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority. Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation. Building the Tender Desk In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon. A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined. Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management. A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process. What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events. What do you bring to the table? You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself. Ideally, you bring: A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities. Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment; Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority; The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective; Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage; Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling; Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working; Who are you? You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you. You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid. You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough. At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ----- to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first. title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals: Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten; Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren); Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie; Hartkleplijden. Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend. De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie. Over ons: onze zorg klopt! We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog. Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk. Wie ben jij? Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie; Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen); Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op. Wat bieden we jou? Bij CCN krijg je een salaris conform CAO Zelfstandige Klinieken Nederland (ZKN), een fulltime dienstverband bestaat uit een 40-urige werkweek. title: Triage audicien - Beek, Limburg

Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied. Wat bieden wij jou? Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past. Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen? description: Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. Hierbij schroom je niet om te benoemen wat je ziet en hoort, durf je kritische vragen te stellen, altijd met het doel om tot oplossingen en mogelijkheden voor inzetbaarheid te komen en altijd met respect voor de ander. Een Twents familiebedrijf met ruim 11.000 collega’s dat groot is geworden met en dankzij hun vakmensen op de werkvloer. ADG zet zich in voor vakmensen met waardering en ondersteuning. Bij Koersmakers geloven ze in gelijke kansen voor iedereen en in een open organisatie waar iedereen zich prettig voelt. Zij willen dan ook een diverse en inclusieve werkgever zijn. Inclusie zorgt ervoor dat werknemers, ongeacht hun achtergrond, overtuigingen, voorkeuren etc, zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en betrokken voelen. title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
description: Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it. We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany. The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch. You will report to our Marketing Lead. Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives. Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief. Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you. Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see. Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly. In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it. Requirements Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken. Enrolled in a relevant study, and available full time for at least four months. Organised and accurate, with several requests and deadlines running at once. Comfortable writing to restaurants and creators yourself, and confident enough to ask when something falls outside the guidelines. At home on social platforms, and comfortable with Google Drive and simple spreadsheets. Available for selected Sunday events. They are always planned in advance. Nice to have, not essential Filming or editing for social; Canva, Notion or Meta Business Suite. Experience in a customer-facing job in hospitality or retail. A real interest in food and restaurants counts for more with us than a perfect CV. If you recognise yourself in most of the above, apply. Benefits A monthly internship allowance Hybrid, with agreed office days Lunch with the team A close view of how content gets made across three markets, from the brief through sourcing, capture, approval and publishing A seat at the restaurants on our lineups. title: Production Planner
description: At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities. Taken The opportunity Harvey Performance Company manufactures consumable precision cutting tools for industrial customers. We are seeking an experienced Production Planner to own production scheduling and material planning across our manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for translating demand forecasts and customer orders into achievable production schedules, ensuring material and capacity availability through disciplined use of SAP/Epicor ERP and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and driving on-time delivery in a fast-paced, high-volume parts production environment In this role, you will be responsible for Develop, publish, and maintain detailed production schedules across manufacturing cells/lines to meet customer demand, on-time delivery targets, and inventory objectives. Own and execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) within SAP/Epicor ERP, reviewing planned orders, exception messages, and net requirements to ensure timely material availability. Maintain accuracy of SAP planning master data, including planning parameters, lead times, lot sizes, safety stock levels, BOMs, routings, etc. Balance production capacity against demand forecasts and customer orders, adjusting schedules for a high-volume, high-mix precision manufacturing environment. Partner with Purchasing/Supply Chain to resolve material shortages, expedite critical components, and manage supplier lead times. Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Customer Service/Sales to resolve scheduling conflicts and support new product introductions. Monitor work-in-process (WIP), backlog, and finished goods inventory; identify and drive inventory optimization opportunities. Participate in and support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, providing planning input and capacity analysis. Track and report key planning KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, machine/labor utilization, inventory turns) to operations leadership. Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to planning processes, systems, and data integrity (Lean/Six Sigma principles). Support daily production meetings and escalating schedule risks proactively. Vereisten You’ll bring: Minimum 5 years of production planning/scheduling experience in a high-volume parts manufacturing environment (required). Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP ERP (PP and MM modules) and Epicor for production planning and material management (required). Highly competent in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) concepts, execution, and troubleshooting (required). Experience in precision manufacturing, cutting tools, metalworking, or a related consumable parts industry is strongly preferred. Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports. Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced knowledge of MRP logic, demand planning, and capacity planning principles. Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven, root-cause approach. Ability to read and interpret BOMs, routings, and production schedules. Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Benefits What Harvey provides: Do you want to get the very best out of yourself? So do we! That’s why, in addition to great colleagues and a cutting-edge high-tech environment, we offer a competitive, market-based salary of €55.000,- to €65.000,- a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities to learn an in-house fitness center 26 vacation days several fun company outings and parties each year Occasional travel to other group/ divisional manufacturing sites Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Goede beheersing van Microsoft Office-applicaties, met name Outlook, Excel en PowerPoint. Talen Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Benefits Wat bieden wij? Een collegiale en internationale HR-werkomgeving. Well-being programma's, Colleague Resource Groups en andere aantrekkelijke DEI-initiatieven. title: Business Developer B2B & Retail
description: Bij de meeste salesbanen stopt je werk bij de afspraak. Bij MarketLeap begint het daar pas. Ik ben Luc, mede-oprichter van MarketLeap. Wij zijn het externe salesteam van online gepositioneerde merken met een fysiek product. Onze klanten verkopen o.a. stoomreinigers, elektrische scooters, spark machines, pilates-reformers, stoelviltdoppen en autopoetsmiddelen. Wij zorgen dat die producten bij grote retailketens, groothandels en distributeurs terechtkomen, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Niet met alleen een lijst aan leads of een ingeplande afspraak, maar met een getekende deal en een product in het schap. Onze merken vind je terug bij de Makro, Coolblue, Albert Heijn, Decathlon, Praxis, Karwei, Bouwmaat, Welkoop, Intratuin, MediaMarkt, Intersport, Sport2000, en we zitten aan tafel met grote internationale distribiteurs. Dat zijn dus niet alleen logo's op onze site, dat zijn concrete deals die ons team heeft gerealiseerd. We bestaan sinds 2023, hebben ruim 140 klanttrajecten gedraaid en zijn winstgevend. We zoeken per direct versterking van één a twee business developers voor ons team van zes business developers en twee founders in Utrecht. Taken Je bent de business developer van vijf tot zes merken tegelijk. Voor elk merk maak je een projectplan met heldere targets, zoek je de juiste afnemers, vindt je de beslissers, belt, mailt, plant de afspraak, voert het gesprek, maakt het voorstel en onderhandelt tot de handtekening. Daarna blijf jij het aanspreekpunt, want de herhaalorders zijn waar het geld zit, voor de klant en voor jou. Zo ziet dit er in de praktijk uit. Zelf heb ik voor een van ons klanten een stoomreiniger bij Makro in het assortiment geplaatst, en de tweede,derde en vierde bestelling volgde. Een collega bouwde bij Decathlon een relatie op waar de orders sindsdien blijven doorlopen. In de eerste 30 dagen zorgde dit al voor tienduizenden euro's extra omzet voor onze klant. Elke week bel je zo'n 80 tot 100 keer, ongeveer twee uur per dag. De rest van je tijd gaat naar het uitdenken van de strategie, klant management, voeren van warme gesprekken, voorstellen uitwerken, op afspraak gaan en het bijhouden van je pijplijn. Elke maandag stuur je de ondernemer achter het merk je weekplan en elke vrijdag je evaluatie. Het repeterende werk, zoals leadlijsten bouwen, research op een keten en de eerste opzet van een pitchdeck, hebben we in Claude Cowork geautomatiseerd met eigen skills. Jij werkt met HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo, Lusha, Notion en Claude, zodat je tijd gaat naar het voeren van gesprekken en closen van deals. Hoe je start: In je eerste maand krijg je één of twee eigen klanten. We doen niet aan een meeloopperiode van een kwartaal. Vanaf dag één heb je direct een klant waar jij verantwoordelijk voor bent. Zo leer je accountmanagement, sales en relatiebeheer op de enige manier die werkt, door het te doen. Je doet dat niet alleen. Week 1 zit je in het inwerkprogramma. Hierin neem je onze SOP's door, leer je de systemen kennen en kijk je mee bij een collega op een lopende deal. Daarna heb je een ervaren buddy die je eerste mails valideert en na je eerste gesprekken met je terugkijkt. Wekelijks krijg je salestraining en heb je een 1-op-1 met mij. Dagelijks kun je bij mij en de buddy terecht. Vereisten 2 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in een commerciële rol. Je hebt al deals geclosed en kunt dit aantonen. Je hebt ook geleerd waarom een deal niet doorging en wist dit vervolgens snel te implementeren. Je woont binnen een uur van Utrecht en bent drie dagen per week op kantoor. Rijbewijs en een eigen auto zijn een must. Je gaat naar onze klanten en potentiële afnemers toe. Vloeiend Nederlands, in spraak en op papier. 40 uur per week beschikbaar, in loondienst. Je neemt eigenaarschap over je pijplijn en je resultaten. Je krijgt energie van targets, deals en een product dat door jou uiteindelijk in het schap terug te vinden is. Benefits Basissalaris 3.200 tot 3.700 euro per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring. De helft van de commissie die wij factureren over deals die jij sluit. Ook over elke herhaalorder, twee tot drie jaar lang. Geen plafond. Extra bonussen bij grote wins. Kilometervergoeding van €0,23,-per kilometer. 25 vakantiedagen Interne salestraining en dagelijks aan het werk met de nieuwste AI-tooling, ingericht voor dit werk. Een hecht team van zes business developers en twee founders, 28 lopende klant trajecten, winstgevend en groeiend. Hybride: drie dagen kantoor in Utrecht, twee dagen thuis. Regelmatige leuke teamuitjes en sportieve activiteiten zoals padel. Herken je jezelf hierin? Stuur je CV en drie regels over een deal waar je het meest trots op bent. Binnen twee werkdagen hoor je van mij. Daarna plannen we een belafspraak in van 20 a 30 minuten, gevolgd door een gesprek op kantoor in Utrecht met mij en een van de business developers. Bij een match vanuit beide kanten ontvang je een concreet aanbod. Van sollicitatie tot handtekening duurt zo'n twee weken en eventueel sneller als het kan. Luc Broos, mede-oprichter MarketLeap Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. We are looking for a Senior Seeker Systems Engineer (EO/IR & Radar) to define and develop the sensing capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems. Develop sensor fusion, target detection, tracking, and classification algorithms . Specify sensor performance requirements, including range, field of view, stabilization, and SWaP constraints. Drive integration of sensors into gimbals, payloads, and autonomy systems. Conduct trade studies, system performance analyses, and supplier evaluations. Support in ground testing, validation, and flight trials. Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Mechatronics, or similar. Experience in missile seekers, guided weapons, EO/IR payloads, targeting systems, gimbals, ISR sensors, or defense electronics. Strong knowledge of: Electro-optical (EO) cameras Thermal / IR imaging systems Radar and RF sensing Sensor fusion and target tracking Experience translating mission requirements into sensor architectures and payload designs. Hands-on mindset with the ability to take ownership of critical technical decisions. Ideal Candidate? You have worked on missile programs, loitering munitions, ISR payloads, targeting systems, or stabilized gimbals and understand how to answer key questions such as: What sensor suite is required for the mission? EO, thermal, radar, or multi-mode seeker? How should sensors be integrated into the autonomy stack? How can detection performance be maximized within strict size, weight, and power constraints?
