title: Senior Partner Manager - DACH
description: About the Role As our Senior Partner Manager DACH , you'll own and grow Tellent's partner ecosystem across the DACH market. You'll inherit an established network of reseller and referral partners, including a group of key strategic partners with significant growth potential — and your role is to turn that foundation into a stronger, more predictable source of pipeline and revenue. You'll build trusted relationships with key partners, create joint growth plans, identify whitespace opportunities across their customer base, and hold partners accountable for execution. At the same time, you'll identify and recruit new high-potential partners, particularly within the HR ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll operate with significant ownership, treating the DACH partner business almost like your own business and bringing a clear point of view on where the market can grow. You will report to the VP Partnerships . Your 12-Month Journey During the first 3 months: You build a strong understanding of the DACH partner ecosystem, establish relationships with key partners and Sales stakeholders, and define a clear plan for where to focus your time and investment. Within 6 months: You're independently managing the partner portfolio, driving joint business plans with key partners, generating quality pipeline, and identifying new partner opportunities. After 1 year: You're driving predictable partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across DACH, growing the strategic partner portfolio, and expanding the ecosystem with new partners that contribute meaningful business. What You'll Be Doing Strategic Partner Management: Own and grow Tellent's most impactful DACH partner relationships, building long-term relationships and joint business plans focused on mutual growth. Partner Performance: Monitor partner health, pipeline and revenue performance, identify risks early, and hold partners accountable to agreed activities and results. Commercial Growth: Generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, improve opportunity quality and conversion, and ensure strong collaboration with Sales throughout the deal cycle. Account & Whitespace Planning: Work side by side with strategic partners to analyse their customer base, identify whitespace opportunities and build plans to generate new business together. Partner Acquisition: Identify, qualify and recruit high-potential new partners, particularly across the HR ecosystem, assessing them based on strategic fit and revenue potential. Activation & Enablement: Ensure new and existing partners are effectively enabled on Tellent, our products, ICP and sales approach, and turn partnerships into active commercial relationships. Market Development: Bring a strong point of view on the DACH market, identifying opportunities beyond the existing partner ecosystem and translating ideas into concrete execution. Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, particularly the DACH Sales team, as well as Marketing and other Partnerships colleagues to improve deal execution, campaigns, enablement and pipeline quality. Operational Excellence: Identify recurring friction in the partner GTM motion and contribute to improving playbooks, cadences, partner planning and ways of working across the wider Partnerships team. What You Bring Partnership Experience: Several years of experience in a partner, channel or business development role, with a proven track record of building and growing strategic partner relationships. DACH Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the German market and ideally an established network of relevant DACH partners. SaaS Experience: Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within HR tech or an adjacent mid-market/SMB environment. Commercial Skill: Strong understanding of pipeline generation, forecasting, partner planning and commercial performance, with experience in reseller and/or referral models. Strategic Thinking: Able to assess a partner portfolio, identify where the biggest opportunities are, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources. Execution: You don't just have ideas — you turn them into structured plans, actions and measurable results. Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take ownership of the DACH partner business as if it were your own, proactively looking for opportunities and challenging existing assumptions. Relationship Building: Strong at building trusted relationships while also being comfortable setting expectations, challenging partners and addressing underperformance. Self-Management: Highly organised and able to manage a broad portfolio, prioritising time effectively across partners, Sales and new opportunities. Communication: Professional fluency in German and English, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and operating across cross-functional teams. Travel: Comfortable travelling regularly across Germany to build and maintain strong in-person partner relationships. What We Offer Flexible working in the Cologne area as we continue building our local team presence Diverse and international team environment €1,500 annual learning budget Pension scheme & wellness/fitness benefits Country-specific holiday policies apply Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed Home office budget and allowance About Tellent Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System ( Tellent Recruitee ), an intuitive HRIS ( Tellent HR ), and powerful Performance Management software ( Tellent Grow ). With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started. AI in our recruitment process We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement , check our Privacy Policy , or chat with us at If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description: Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! B. vom SDR zum Account Executive Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Minerva software team develops our overarching command, control, and edge autonomy software across multiple domain platforms and handheld ground stations. We are a geographically distributed, multi-disciplinary engineering group bridging high-level decision-making software with physical vehicle control and sensor payloads. In this role, you will work within the Minerva product organisation and report directly to the Lead Product Manager to ensure seamless cross-platform functionality and multi-sensor integration across all operational deployments.

YOUR MISSION

You will support the product strategy for integrating our core Minerva software architecture—spanning C2 systems to Edge stacks—across diverse uncrewed platforms and sensor payloads. Reporting directly to the Lead Product Manager, you will translate complex multi-domain operational requirements and hardware constraints into structured, actionable engineering roadmaps. Success looks like unified cross-platform releases, advanced AI capabilities delivered on edge assets, robust sensor integration cycles, and reliable platform software performance across all deployment domains.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Specify Concepts of Operation, system and subsystem product requirements, and acceptance criteria 
  • Incorporate customer requirements, operator and customer feedback, and the wider STARK product vision into scalable Minerva versions across different uncrewed platforms and handheld control systems
  • Establish metrics and acceptance criteria for cross-platform software stability, data latency, and sensor fusion reliability
  • Define expectations and priorities for AI systems running within edge constraints 
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Product Manager, Product Owners and Technical Product Managers, and Engineering Leads to evaluate technical trade-offs across edge computing and C2 capabilities
  • Collaborate with system engineers and hardware teams across different hardware platforms to ensure Minerva edge software delivers maximum performance
  • Work directly with engineering leads and product colleagues to track sprint progress and remove blockers
  • Support integration compliance with military communication standards and protocols (e.g., SAPIENT, TAK, SitaWare)
  • Ensure the Minerva stack and development processes respect industry audit requirements (e.g. AQAP) 
  • Anticipate tests and validations and collaborate with IV&V, Product Safety, InfoSec, Configuration Management colleagues to ensure fast release turnarounds without compromising on safety and security  

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 3+ years of technical product management or product ownership experience software-heavy or complex systems environment
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex software integration projects across hardware devices, sensors, or edge computing stacks
  • Strong technical literacy in software architecture, APIs, and data integration patterns
  • Experience with foundational AI systems (e.g. in computer vision, localisation) 
  • Proven track record of defining product specifications, backlog grooming, and user stories for agile engineering teams
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge hardware, software, and operational perspectives
  • Fluent English verbal and written communication skills

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with defence tech, C2 systems, robotics, or autonomous unmanned vehicles
  • Familiarity with sensor integration (Radar, EO/IR, LiDAR) and defence protocols (TAK, SAPIENT)
  • Experience with software products designed for degraded or offline tactical network conditions
  • Experience with hardware/software integrations

description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision.   • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Flight Control Systems team at Stark is responsible for safety-critical architectures, control laws, and integrated flight software across autonomous defense platforms. Working closely with systems engineering, aerodynamics, and software teams, we bridge theoretical control theory and field-tested hardware deployment. Our mission is to ensure robust, high-performance, and resilient flight behavior in highly dynamic and contested environments.

YOUR MISSION

As Director of Flight Control Systems (FCS), reporting directly to our VP of Hardware, you will lead the end-to-end development, verification, and qualification of next-generation flight control architectures. You will define the technical roadmap, build and mentor an elite team of control and software engineers, and oversee safety-critical flight law implementation from initial modeling to flight testing.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Lead and scale the Flight Control Systems team, setting engineering standards, performance goals, and development roadmaps.
  • Drive the architectural design of fly-by-wire flight control software, sensor fusion algorithms, and actuation control loops.
  • Oversee Model-in-the-Loop (MIL), Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing and verification frameworks.
  • Collaborate with systems engineering and flight test crews to validate control system performance during flight test campaigns.
  • Ensure compliance with safety-critical aerospace and defense standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, or military flight clearance frameworks).
  • Interface with internal cross-functional leadership and external partners to align system requirements with platform capabilities.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Theory, or a related technical field.
  • Proven leadership experience managing engineering teams in flight control systems or safety-critical aerospace development.
  • Deep expertise in flight dynamics, control laws development (PID, LQR, H-infinity, adaptive control), and MATLAB/Simulink modeling.
  • Hands-on background in auto-code generation, embedded C/C++ development, and flight software integration.
  • Track record of taking flight control systems from initial concept through ground and flight testing.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with autonomous defense platforms or unmanned aerial systems (UAS).
  • Familiarity with military certification processes and flight test safety protocols.
  • Knowledge of modern software development practices (CI/CD, automated testing, Git).

title: Chief of Staff (m/f/d)
description:
Mission Brief

Support our CTO and help us keep Europe's launch capability on track! As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you will act as the CTO's deputy in the internal programme and product forums, sitting in the rooms where technical decisions are made on their behalf. You will understand how our programmes actually run, spot bottlenecks before they materialise, and drive the teams that hit them back onto a credible path.

This is an engineering role first. You are not a representative of the CTO externally — you are the person who covers for them internally when they cannot be in the room, and who makes things happen in their place.

Your role in our space mission

  • Deputise for the CTO in product and programme meetings, reviews and decision forums, and carry the outcome back with a clear view of what was decided and what it means
  • Build a deep, current understanding of how each programme runs — dependencies, critical paths, interfaces between engineering, production, quality and AIT — rather than relying on status reporting
  • Identify bottlenecks early, before they turn into schedule or cost problems, and drive their resolution with the responsible teams
  • Take ownership of programmes that have drifted, define the corrective path and get them back on track
  • Provide the CTO with a technically grounded, unfiltered view of programme health and the risks that are not yet visible in the plans

description:
The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. Engineering Deliverables

  • Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.

description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop. Core Responsibilities Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better. Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter. Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems. Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves. Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge. Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers. What We Value Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science. A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools. Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems. Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users. Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision. Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but may vary by team and location. What We Require Fluency in German Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process , please and let us know how we can help. Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) . description:
Position Overview

Agile Robots SE is seeking a Network Architect / Network Specialist to define and operate our global on‑premise network across multiple geographies and regional offices. You will lead the design and lifecycle of our campus, branch, and data‑center networks—including high‑performance NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics that power AI/HPC workloads—while ensuring our controls meet TISAX expectations and internal ISMS requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1) Global Architecture & Standards (On‑Prem Only)

  • Design and document end‑to‑end on‑prem architectures (core/distribution/access/WLAN; DC leaf‑spine).
  • Establish and maintain global standards: IP addressing & IPAM (NetBox), routing policy, QoS, naming, security baselines, and change control (HLD/LLD, MOP/SOP, rollback).
  • Define network zoning & segmentation (VLAN/VRF; optional EVPN/VXLAN where justified) across Officeand DMZ networks with clear trust boundaries.

2) Routing, Switching, WLAN & Regional Sites

  • Engineer BGP/OSPF for WAN & DC; deliver redundancy/failover across carriers and sites.
  • Own Aruba campus/branch switching and WLAN (coverage, capacity planning, RF hygiene, roaming, WPA2/3‑Enterprise).
  • Plan and execute site builds/moves/expansions (circuits, last‑mile, demarc, handoffs, cutovers) with measurable downtime windows.

3) Security, Remote Access & Identity

  • Lead FortiGate policy architecture (zones, NAT, segmentation, IDS/IPS) and FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL) for site‑to‑site and remote access, including HA and posture checks.
  • Implement 802.1X NAC (e.g., Aruba ClearPass) with RADIUS/Active Directory integration; enforce device posture and guest segmentation.
  • Operate DMZ patterns (reverse proxying, jump hosts, constrained admin planes) and align with TISAX/ISMSrequirements.

4) High‑Performance Networking for AI/HPC

  • Design, deploy, and maintain NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics (topology, cabling/optics, partitioning), including subnet managers (UFM/opensm), congestion control, and path optimization.
  • Coordinate with compute/storage teams (e.g., DGX/HPC clusters) on throughput, latency, and scale; plan upgrades and fabric expansions.

5) Reliability, Observability & Automation

  • Deliver high availability (fast convergence, dual‑homing, link aggregation/MLAG/VLT) and tested DR/failover.
  • Implement proactive monitoring/alerting (e.g., Zabbix), telemetry/SNMP, and capacity trends; maintain RCAs and SLOs.
  • Centralize logging with rsyslog and FortiAnalyzer; enforce retention and integrity for audits.
  • Use NetBox, Ansible/Python, and Git‑based workflows for configuration management, drift control, and repeatable changes.

6) Compliance, Risk & Vendor Management (TISAX Focus)

  • Map network controls to TISAX expectations (ISMS governance, secure remote access, logging, supplier access, data protection).
  • Partner with ISMS owner/CISO on risk assessments, controls testing, and evidence preparation for audits (policies, diagrams, logs, change records).
  • Manage carriers and vendors (Fortinet, Aruba, Dell; integrators); lead RFPs, SLAs, and lifecycle planning.
  • Mentor regional IT; act as L3 escalation for incidents and major changes.

Core Technologies @ Agile Robots SE

  • Security & Remote Access: FortiGate NGFW, FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL), FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer.
  • Campus/Branch & WLAN: Aruba CX/AOS switching, controllers/APs, ClearPass (802.1X), AirWave (on‑prem mgmt).
  • Data Center & Fabric: Dell PowerSwitch (OS10), VLT/MLAG; NVIDIA InfiniBand (UFM/opensm).
  • Foundational Services: VLAN/VRF, BGP/OSPF, QoS; DHCP/DNS, Active Directory, RADIUS; NetBox(IPAM/DCIM).
  • Observability & Automation: Zabbix, rsyslog (retention policy), NetFlow/sFlow; Ansible/Python, Git.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years in enterprise on‑prem networking across multi‑site/multi‑region environments.
  • Deep hands‑on with FortiGate, Aruba (switching/WLAN), Dell data‑center switching, and NVIDIA InfiniBand basics.
  • Strong routing/switching (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRF), segmentation, and DMZ design; HA and fast convergence patterns.
  • Proven delivery of secure remote access, 802.1X NAC, and logging/monitoring at scale (rsyslog, analyzers, NMS).

  • Excellent documentation (HLD/LLD, diagrams) and stakeholder communication.

 

Preferred

  • ClearPass NAC depth, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer, Aruba AirWave; EVPN/VXLAN familiarity.
  • Exposure to RADIUS/AD integration and FreeRADIUS stack.
  • Familiarity with Zabbix tuning, syslog retention strategies, and ITSM/change tooling.
  • Experience segmenting AI/HPC clusters and integrating with storage/compute pipelines.

  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.

title: Director, Product-Led Growth
description:
About Upsun

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It’s built for hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and people focus on the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale with confidence, without wrestling with backend infrastructure.

Upsun Dispatch, our newest offering, brings that same idea to the whole team. It’s the platform for governed collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional humans. Agents handle the volume in isolated sandboxes. People make the decisions that matter, with every approval and every cost on the record.

We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. “Up” stands for uptime, reliability, and acceleration. “Sun” reflects our follow-the-sun support: a 24x7, globally distributed team keeping the lights on while you rest. We believe software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global team, and we thrive in a multicultural one. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment, and our people span the whole experience spectrum. What ties us together is curiosity, a thirst for knowledge, and an eagerness for new ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together when the environment frees you to do your best work.

Our values:
🌿 We make a positive impact.
✨ We aim for the stars.
💚 We care for each other.

Impact of a Director, Product-Led Growth

As Director, PLG, you’ll lead the strategy, execution, and commercial success of Upsun’s product-led revenue engine. Upsun is expanding its portfolio with Upsun Dispatch, a strategic new offer that joins Upsun Cloud, and this role will turn that expansion into measurable growth. 

Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own the revenue target for product-led experiences, building a scalable engine across developer recruitment, freemium conversion, and customer retention. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering, you will bridge technical platform capabilities with market-driven execution to scale Upsun’s global footprint. 

What to expect

  • Own product-led revenue: Be accountable for ARR from self-serve experiences, from first signup through conversion, expansion, and retention. 

  • Drive growth goals: Build and execute PLG programs to achieve clear top-line ARR milestones and hit aggressive user acquisition targets with specific focus in Europe and North America.  

  • Connect growth and product: Partner closely with the Head of Growth (Marketing), Head of User Acquisition and Conversion (Marketing)  and Upsun Dispatch Product Managers (Product/Engineering) to translate product strategy into measurable customer and business outcomes.  

  • Optimize the funnel: Define in-product monetization levers, optimize self-service funnels, and partner with Sales to refine Product-Led Sales (PLS) handoffs for enterprise accounts.  

  • Build tight feedback loops: Analyze intent data, user behavior, and churn metrics to continuously iterate on user onboarding, NPS, and lifetime value.  

What you bring

  • PLG and growth leadership: A track record as a Senior Product Manager or Director with growth and commercial revenue responsibilities at a developer-focused, SaaS, or cloud platform company driven primarily by a PLG model.  

  • Strategic judgment: Ability to turn complex developer platform capabilities into intuitive self-service user experiences that drive clear, measurable business value.  

  • Cross-functional execution: A record of leading cross-functional growth initiatives across Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering.

  • Data-driven approach: Hands-on depth in growth analytics, conversion funnels, freemium-to-paid activation, and retention.

  • Developer and AI fluency: Practical understanding of modern developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and how AI-assisted development tools are reshaping user expectations.  

Bonus points

  • Dual-funnel experience: Running both self-serve funnels (PLG) and enterprise sales handoffs (PLS).

  • Platform background: Cloud infrastructure, PaaS, DevOps, or developer platforms.

  • Global scale: Scaling product-led revenue across remote-first, international teams.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. 

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.   

You can expect 5 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Chief Marketing Officer)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (IC)
  4. 60 Minutes with Team (Head of Growth)
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

You’ll join our customer project teams as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. You’ll work hands-on across the full integration toolkit: deploying our out-of-the-box extractors, building custom API connectors in a low-code environment, writing code for push-based ingestion, connecting Celonis to customer lakehouses and LLMs, and configuring writebacks, SSO, and user provisioning. Part implementation consultant, part integration engineer, part trusted technical advisor, this role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to enterprise architecture and modern data and AI integration patterns.

The work you’ll do:

Data integration and ingestion:

  • Implement standard extractors. Install, configure, and troubleshoot Celonis out-of-the-box extractors in customer landscapes, including SAP (ECC and S/4HANA), JDBC-based databases, and cloud applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and others.
  • Build custom API connectors. Design and build custom connectors with Celonis Extractor Builder for source systems that expose data through REST or SOAP APIs, handling authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, certificates), pagination, rate limits, and incremental (delta) loads.
  • Enable push-based ingestion. Help customers design and develop scripts and pipelines (typically in Python) that push data to Celonis via the Data Ingestion API, and advise on file formats, scheduling, and error handling.
  • Connect to the lakehouse. Set up zero-copy data sharing between Celonis and customer lakehouses such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Sharing configuration, access controls, and data freshness.
  • Unblock infrastructure. Work through on-premise agent deployments, networking, proxies, firewall and IP allowlisting, certificates, and service-account permissions with customer IT and infrastructure teams.
  • Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, monitor pipeline health, and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

Actions, AI, and platform connectivity:

  • Close the loop with writebacks. Configure Action Flows and other integration patterns that write back to customer systems (for example, updating records in SAP, Salesforce, or ticketing tools) so Celonis insights turn into action.
  • Connect Celonis to AI. Help customers connect Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP (Model Context Protocol), covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

Identity, security, and governance:

  • Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
  • Be the security translator. Support customer security, privacy, and compliance reviews, explain the Celonis architecture and data flows, and advise on topics like data minimization, pseudonymization, and least-privilege access.

Customer and team impact:

  • Scope with confidence. Run technical discovery, document integration architectures and requirements, and estimate effort so projects start on solid footing.
  • Partner across teams. Serve as a technical point of contact for customer IT, data, and security stakeholders, and work closely with Value Engineers, Data Engineers, Project Managers, Partners, Support, and Product & Engineering.
  • Be the voice of the field. Escalate product gaps and bugs with clear, reproducible detail, and share field feedback that shapes our integration roadmap.
  • Build reusable assets. Contribute reusable connector templates, scripts, runbooks, and best-practice documentation that scale across customers and partners.

The qualifications you need:

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as solutions engineering, integration or implementation consulting, data engineering, or technical consulting.
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and common authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, tokens); comfort using tools like Postman to explore and test APIs.
  • Solid programming skills in Python (or a similar language) and strong SQL skills.
  • Working knowledge of data pipelines and ETL/ELT concepts, including incremental loads, scheduling, and handling large data volumes.
  • Familiarity with identity and access management concepts such as SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning.
  • A basic understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TLS and certificates, proxies, firewalls, VPNs).
  • The ability to explain technical topics clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders, and to manage your own workstreams across multiple customer projects.
  • Curiosity, ownership, and a bias toward solving problems hands-on.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SAP data structures, tables, or extraction (for example, RFC, ODP, or S/4HANA).
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or lakehouse platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Snowflake.
  • Exposure to iPaaS or low-code integration tools (for example, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
  • Experience with Docker or Linux server administration.
  • Relevant certifications (for example, Celonis, cloud, or SAP certifications).

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you’ll be doing

You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We’re determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you’ll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

  • Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.
  • Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.
  • Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.
  • Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.
  • Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.
  • Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.
  • Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.
  • Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

  • Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.
  • Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.
  • A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.
  • Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

  • Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.
  • Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.
  • Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.
  • Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

You’ll bring strong mechanical engineering ability and enthusiasm to the role. You will deliver high-quality work on client projects, to specification and to timelines. You will be responsible for delivering the tasks you’re assigned, and for defining tasks for yourself and often for others.

  • An excellent undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering (or a related subject such as Biomedical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Mechatronics) or equivalent experience
  • Design engineering industry experience, for example (but not limited to) high proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), design analysis, structural analysis, rapid prototyping, technical drawings, design for manufacture and design for assembly
  • A proven track record of working in a diverse team and of successful delivery
  • A creative and analytical approach to problem-solving and concept generation
  • Strong written and verbal communication

In addition, experience in any of the following would be advantageous (but is not essential):

  • Experience in a consulting environment
  • Experience in medical device development, or other regulated product development
  • Familiarity with analysis tools such as Python/MATLAB, CFD and FEA
  • An interest in applying engineering to the biomedical field

Cambridge Consultants is one of the world’s leading product development and technology consultancies, with a reputation for cutting-edge design, development and value creation for a global client base. We develop breakthrough technology for some of the most exciting companies on the planet. Our people, facilities and work make us unique. Our medical technology division develops some of the most novel products, with tangible and often life-changing benefits for users and patients.

  • Medical insurance and group income protection

At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. title: Director, Development Cost Management & Capital Planning EMEA
description:
Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning (EMEA) 

Location: London, hybrid, with regular travel to project locations across EMEA

About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. 

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation. 

Nscale is working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company scaling globally with a key focus in the EMEA region.

The Role

The Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning is accountable for establishing cost certainty, capital planning, development risk and commercial viability across Nscale's EMEA Development portfolio from site identification (Gate 0) through due diligence (Gate 1) to development sanction and ‘shovel-ready’ transition into Delivery (Gate 2).

The role owns L0 Indicative Estimates, L1 Estimated Budgets and L2 Schematic Design Budget for every EMEA opportunity, consolidating the development, energy, design, construction, procurement and AI infrastructure workstream budgets into a single Total Development Cost (TDC) providing the commercial and financial foundation for site selection, land and lease acquisitions, Colocation leases, underwriting business cases, investment committee approvals and project approvals.

Operating as an individual contributor at first, the role will personally prepare estimates, cost models, risk registers, benchmarking and investment-grade business cases while establishing the systems, governance and processes required for future growth. The role will develop to manage a high performing team supporting the Development function as it expands across the EMEA region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Development Cost Planning & Estimating - Own L0, L1 and L2 estimates across the EMEA portfolio, maintaining the Total Development Cost (TDC), proforma and development cost baseline through Gate 2. Where early stage budgets have missing elements, propose and agree estimates and placeholders with the project team.
  • Investment Underwriting & Business Case Development - Provide CAPEX, contingency, cash flow and cost-risk inputs to support acquisitions, business cases and Investment Committee approvals.
  • Development Risk Management and Contingency Planning - Maintain project risk registers and govern contingency in accordance with Nscale policy.
  • Site Selection & Land Acquisition Support - Support site screening, due diligence and acquisition decisions through cost, risk and abnormality assessments.
  • Power, Utilities & Infrastructure Assessment - Integrate power, utility and enabling infrastructure costs and schedules into the overall development budget.
  • Procurement & Strategic Supply Chain Integration - Work with Procurement and Strategic Sourcing to incorporate market capacity, procurement strategy, long-lead items and supply chain risks into estimates.
  • Cost Benchmarking - Maintain EMEA cost benchmarks, escalation assumptions and market intelligence across key jurisdictions.
  • Contract / Lease Support - Support the Development team in all areas of land / power acquisition and Colocation leasing and contracting, providing cost annexes in the agreed contract form.
  • Market Intelligence - Retain current market benchmark costs and reintegrate as-built costs of developments into pre-development modelling and estimates.
  • Portfolio Capital Planning & Forecasting - Lead portfolio CAPEX forecasting, cashflow planning and variance reporting for all pre-sanction opportunities.
  • Development Governance & Gateway Approvals - Own cost deliverables, assurance and reporting for Gate 0-2 approvals.
  • Global WBS Alignment and Handover into Delivery - Structure all estimates to the Global WBS and lead commercial transition to Delivery at Gate 2.
  • Lessons Learned and Estimating Accuracy Improvement - Improve estimate accuracy, benchmarking and contingency calibration through estimate-to-outturn analysis.
  • Functional Leadership and Future Team Development - Act as EMEA lead for development cost planning, establishing standards, tools and governance with responsibility for building and leading the team as the portfolio scales.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in quantity surveying, cost management, estimating, commercial management or capital planning.
  • Proven experience within hyperscale data centres, mission critical facilities, major infrastructure, energy or industrial developments. 
  • The ability to build experienced based cost plans and budgets when limited information exists.
  • Strong understanding of the full data centre development lifecycle from site origination, early stage development, planning, permitting through construction mobilisation.
  • Experience preparing the cost basis for investment-grade business cases and underwriting budgets.
  • Experience developing risk registers, contingency models and portfolio capital plans.
  • Strong understanding of contractor markets, procurement strategies and supply chain dynamics.
  • Experience working with developers, investors, lenders, consultants and contractors.
  • Demonstrated ability to present to Executive Committees, Investment Committees and Board stakeholders.
  • Fluency in data centre cost benchmarking (€/MW, €/m², cost per IT load) and the development cost drivers of power, cooling and AI-ready infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of EMEA contract forms and procurement routes (e.g. FIDIC, NEC and local equivalents) and their cost and risk implications.
  • Proficiency with estimating and cost management tools and advanced Excel-based cost and cash flow modelling.
  • Right to work [UK / EU] and willingness to travel across EMEA.

Preferred:

  • Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, Commercial Management, Engineering or related discipline.
  • MRICS, CICES, ACostE or equivalent professional accreditation preferred but not essential.
  • Experience across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.
  • Experience supporting large-scale AI, cloud, hyperscale or mission-critical developments.

Desirable

The Solutions Architect will bring hands-on expertise in Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC.  Partner Technical Planning

  • Incorporate Securiti.ai technical priorities into existing Veeam partner plans and quarterly business reviews.

 Solution Architecture and Practice Enablement 

  • Recruit, train and certify partner solution engineers, architects and services teams on Securiti.ai.

  • Create and maintain technical assets, including demo environments, reference architectures, solution briefs, discovery guides and competitive technical positioning.

  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations and proofs of value with partners for priority customer opportunities. 
  • Align Veeam, Securiti.ai and partner technical teams around priority customers, supporting opportunities from technical qualification through close. 
  • Respond to technical requirements, RFPs and security questionnaires, and address architecture, integration and compliance questions from customer stakeholders. 
  • Support a smooth transition from sale to implementation, ensuring partner delivery teams are prepared for successful deployment and adoption. 

 Measures of Success 

  • Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue influenced through partner technical engagement. 
  • Number of partner engineers trained and certified on Securiti.ai and partners able to independently demonstrate, sell and deliver solutions. 
  • Technical win rate and conversion of proofs of value into closed business. 
  • Number of joint solutions, reference architectures and partner-led assessments and services brought to market. 
  • Customer deployment success, partner satisfaction and strength of alignment with Veeam channel and technical teams.

title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
description:
The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog's security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog's security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.

 

We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.

 

The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? How do you make a small model's outputs clear enough that the detection engineers and analysts who rely on it can trust what it reports? If these are the problems you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.

 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 

What You'll Do:

 

  • Design and build custom mid-size models for high-throughput stream processing, and train them at scale.

 

  • Optimize these models from start to finish, working across both the mathematics and the systems, often by finding mathematical reformulations that fit the hardware and software constraints better.

 

  • Build the training data pipelines the work depends on when they do not already exist, from the raw stream to a training-ready dataset.

 

  • Work with engineering to integrate models into production, with a clear focus on GPU utilization, latency, and cost per record on live traffic.

 

  • Plan the roadmap of model and system improvements, based on a solid understanding of the product and of what matters most to users.

 

  • Build an agentic layer on top of the models to analyze, validate, and act on their outputs.

 

  • Build lightweight interpretability tools that make model behavior easier to explain to the people who rely on it.

 

  • Maintain and monitor the models, services, and infrastructure your team owns, and take part in your team's on-call rotation.

 

Who You Are:

 

  • You have a BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related scientific field, or equivalent experience.

 

  • You have hands-on experience training and fine-tuning models at scale, and deploying them into production systems with real throughput and cost constraints.

 

  • You have a working knowledge of how GPUs work, and a track record of making models run efficiently within real hardware constraints.

 

  • You have strong applied-mathematics fundamentals and reach for them naturally when designing and optimizing models.

 

  • You have a real passion for applied mathematics, software design, and implementation. This role sits at the intersection of the three, and it is a requirement for the position.

 

  • You care about code simplicity and performance, and you can build the data pipelines and the surrounding production code, in addition to the models themselves.

title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
description:
AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog's AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog's shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time.

Specifically, you'll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog's agents learn in. GenSim doesn't replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog's own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against.

The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That's the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? How do you make injected problems genuinely hard, and how do you even measure difficulty? How do you define and control the quality of post-training data when correctness, representativeness and difficulty pull in different directions? How do you evaluate an agent end to end when the trajectory is non-deterministic? Creating simulated agent environments for monitoring and SRE work is not well solved in open source or in published research, and Datadog is the leading company in this field. If those are the problems you want to spend your time on, come build this with us.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the applied science direction for GenSim: set the methodology and the forward-looking technical calls on how simulated environments and post-training data should be built, on a team where that decision-making does not exist yet.
  • Define, measure and raise the quality of post-training data — basic correctness, representativeness against the real distribution of customer systems and production telemetry, and difficulty — and make those measures something the team can act on release over release.
  • Close the realism gap. Simulated environments today are too clean and the injected problems are not yet hard enough; you'll drive the research and the engineering that make them look like real, imperfect production systems.
  • Build scalable, production-grade systems rather than research scripts. The output is not just a dataset — it is a system of synthetic environments that must be reliable and invokable inside a training loop.
  • Determine how this data is best applied, in LLM post-training and in evaluation, and own the agent and LLM application evaluation approaches for these environments.
  • Work cross-functionally with the engineers and applied scientists on adjacent teams — Bits AI SRE, the model training effort, and the wider evaluation and experimentation pillar — so that what you learn moves freely in both directions.

Who You Are:

  • You have a PhD, MS or equivalent research experience in a scientific field, with strong applied mathematics grounding.
  • 6+ years of relevant applied science or ML engineering experience, including setting technical direction for others.
  • You have hands-on experience with LLM and agent post-training data: how it is created, managed, and how training-data quality is controlled. This is the requirement that matters most.
  • You have real domain expertise in LLMs and agentic applications — not classical ML fine-tuning. Fine-tuning classifiers or traditional models is a different problem from the one this team is solving.
  • You have evaluated agents or LLM applications, and can define what 'good' means before you measure it.
  • You are a strong programmer and production software engineer. Python at minimum, plus the ability to ship scalable production systems and work with distributed systems.
  • You collaborate well across engineering and science teams, and you're comfortable being the domain expert who decides what comes next.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and can make sound technical calls when the path isn't yet defined.

Bonus Points:

  • Hands-on LLM fine-tuning, post-training or model training experience.
  • Background in statistics, experiment design and data analysis.
  • Experience deploying production-level ML infrastructure.
  • Observability or monitoring systems background.
  • Architecture-level understanding of LLMs.

Depending on your interests, you can further grow towards strategic client ownership, technical depth or mentoring responsibilities – always with the freedom to shape your own path. Fluent in Dutch and English Located in The Netherlands Benefits What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
description: What is Anori Tech doing? The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work. As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development. We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry. We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years. Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market. Our Motivation At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg. About the Role A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers. Start date : from January 1, 2027 What You'll Do Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud What You Bring Must have Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed) Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms Strongly preferred Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data Nice to have Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper) You don't tick every box?
