We matchen talenten met de juiste klanten, waar ze een passende rol kunnen vervullen. Wij bieden een uniek Talent Development Programma waarin je wordt opgeleid tot een specialist met expertise in AI, data en business binnen de financiële sector. Je leert niet alleen hoe AI-technologieën en data-analyse bedrijfsprocessen verbeteren, maar ook hoe regelgeving zoals de AI Act impact heeft op AI-implementaties en organisaties. Het bedrijf is gebouwd op de solide fundamenten van twee succesvolle organisaties die hun waarde in de financiële sector al ruimschoots hebben bewezen. Dit garandeert een high-end ontwikkelingsprogramma dat jou als Young Professional voorziet van alle benodigde tools, trainingen en persoonlijke begeleiding. Zo kun je snel uitgroeien tot een succesvolle professional en toekomstige specialist die het verschil maakt in een wereld waar AI, technologie en regelgeving steeds meer met elkaar verweven zijn. Taken Wat kun je verwachten? Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformeert de financiële sector, maar de komst van de AI Act en strengere regelgeving zorgen voor nieuwe uitdagingen. Hoe zorg je ervoor dat AI niet alleen efficiënt wordt ingezet, maar ook middels verantwoord beleid? Welke AI-use cases leveren de meeste waarde op en hoe breng je naar de praktijk? En hoe versterk je AI-literacy binnen organisaties om technologie optimaal te benutten? Als AI Business & Data Expert werk je op het snijvlak van AI, data en business en ben jij de schakel tussen techniek, data en business. Je helpt financiële instellingen bij het identificeren en implementeren van AI-oplossingen die bedrijfsprocessen verbeteren en tegelijkertijd voldoen aan regelgeving. Je ontwikkelt AI-use cases, analyseert data en vertaalt complexe AI-technologie naar concrete toepassingen. Daarnaast speel je een cruciale rol in AI Literacy binnen organisaties: je helpt teams beter te begrijpen hoe AI werkt, welke risico’s en mogelijkheden er zijn en hoe ze AI verantwoord kunnen inzetten. Je werkt nauw samen met IT, Risk en Compliance en zorgt ervoor dat AI-oplossingen niet alleen technisch kloppen, maar ook bijdragen aan strategische doelstellingen. Met jouw kennis van AI, data-analyse en regelgeving maak je innovatie praktisch toepasbaar en zorg je ervoor dat AI-oplossingen realistisch, schaalbaar en effectief worden geïntegreerd binnen de organisatie. Mogelijke rollen AI Business Analyst AI & Data Consultant AI Risk & Compliance Specialist Responsible AI Officer AI Model Risk Manager Vereisten Wat maakt jou een Risketeer? Wij zijn op zoek naar proactieve, enthousiaste talenten die klaar zijn om zichzelf te ontwikkelen binnen het vakgebied ‘ AI Business & Data Expertise ’ . Je hebt de ambitie om een succesvolle carrière op te bouwen en bent geïnteresseerd in hoe Artificial Intelligence (AI) de financiële dienstverlening transformeert. Bovendien ben je klaar om jouw analytische en technische vaardigheden in te zetten om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen met behulp van AI-technologieën. Je hebt een relevante HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond, zoals Econometrie, Finance, Risk Management, Business Administration/Economics of een gerelateerd vakgebied. Hoewel kennis van AI en Machine Learning een vereiste is, is deze rol specifiek voor professionals met een business-, financiële- of economische achtergrond, en niet voor kandidaten met uitsluitend een technische AI-opleiding. Daarnaast heb je een sterke affiniteit met AI-governance, financiële regelgeving en risicomanagement, en beschik je over kennis van AI-modellen, data-analyse en machine learning. Waarom kiezen voor Risketeers? Werk in een omgeving die je ondersteunt met training en mentorschap van de beste experts in het veld, met een sterke focus op de integratie van Artificial Intelligence (AI) in jouw werkzaamheden. Leer hoe je AI-tools en -technieken effectief en verantwoord kunt inzetten om complexe uitdagingen in de financiële sector op te lossen. Profiteer van een unieke aanpak die niet alleen jouw vakinhoudelijke expertise versterkt, maar je ook voorbereidt op een toekomst waarin technologie en data-analyse centraal staan. Van business analyse, AI wet- en regelgeving tot datamanagement en -modelleren: je krijgt alle middelen om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Volg een gepersonaliseerd leertraject dat speciaal is ontworpen om jouw skills en carrière-ambities te ondersteunen. Dit traject helpt je niet alleen om mee te groeien met de huidige trends, maar ook om deze trends te sturen. Benefits Wat bieden wij jou? title: AI Solutions Engineer
description: Waarom deze rol bestaat De meeste AI-projecten halen productie nooit. Zes maanden verder, budget verdubbeld, scope gehalveerd, en wat er ligt is een presentatie in plaats van software die eindgebruikers omarmen. Wij doen het anders. Een werkende POC in zeven dagen, op echte data van de klant. Daarna in weken naar productie. Die belofte houdt alleen stand als de mensen die hem waarmaken scherp zijn. Met agentic coding tools zoals Claude Code en Codex komt er sneller iets werkends uit dan ooit. Daardoor verschuift het werk van bouwen naar regie voeren. De vraag achterhalen, de juiste oplossing ontwerpen, AI en engineering slim inzetten, en de kwaliteit bewaken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die tussen developer en consultant in zit. Technisch sterk genoeg om zelf te bouwen en te beoordelen of iets deugt, sterk genoeg aan de voorkant om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden, en verantwoordelijk tot het live staat en live blijft. AI schrijft bij ons veel. Verantwoordelijkheid kun je niet uitbesteden. Alles wat jouw naam draagt, heb je zelf gelezen, gecontroleerd en begrepen voordat het de deur uitgaat. Taken Er zijn twee manieren waarop onze klanten bij ons bouwen, en jij doet ze allebei. Wij bouwen Een klant stapt binnen met een proof of concept. Zeven dagen, een scherp gekaderde scope. Jij ownt die POC. Jij vraagt uit wat er echt nodig is, jij bepaalt wat er wel en niet in gaat, jij bouwt hem op hun echte data, en jij neemt de klant stap voor stap mee in de demo. Daarna bouw je het in weken uit tot MVP. Vanaf dat moment doe je het niet meer alleen. Je haalt je team erbij, neemt ze mee in wat het moet worden en bouwt samen verder. Vervolgens maak je het productieklaar, met auth, monitoring en CI/CD. Jij blijft er eigenaar van. De klant bouwt, wij borgen Bij een groeiend deel van onze klanten bouwt hun eigen team met Claude Code, Codex en Cursor. Wij reviewen elke pull request, tekenen elke release en zetten de productieomgeving op, volgens onze standaarden en zonder dat ze erop hoeven wachten. Daar is je rol anders. Je zit bij hun product owners, delivery lead en developers aan tafel, je kijkt kritisch mee met wat ze maken, en jij borgt dat het veilig en productiewaardig live komt. title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Great AI doesn’t start with a great model. It starts with a great platform.

The success of an AI initiative is rarely determined by the model alone. More often, it depends on the quality of the platform underneath it.

As a Platform Engineer in our central Data & AI team, you’ll build the foundations that let engineers develop, deploy and operate AI workloads safely and efficiently. You’ll work on the infrastructure, automation and platform capabilities that allow teams to innovate without compromising reliability, and you’ll bridge the gap between promising technology and production reality.

Think Kubernetes platforms, deployment automation, observability, security and developer experience. Think AI workloads built around Large Language Models, retrieval systems, graph technologies and modern data platforms. Think creating an environment where engineers focus on solving problems rather than fighting infrastructure.

What you will work on

  • Designing self-service platform capabilities using Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps principles
  • Operationalizing graph and vector databases, and enabling model serving workloads
  • Improving the observability of AI systems running in production
  • Integrating OpenAI or Anthropic-based services into our platform
  • Operationalizing LangGraph workloads on Kubernetes
  • Enabling GraphRAG architectures powered by Neo4j
  • Designing deployment patterns so AI services meet the same standards as any other production workload

You’ll spend less time tuning models and more time making sure AI capabilities can be trusted, operated and continuously improved. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, software engineering and AI.

At Schuberg Philis we don’t believe in throwing solutions over the fence. The engineers building systems are responsible for running them too, and that ownership extends to AI just as much as every other technology we work with. Your impact won’t be measured by the number of clusters you manage, but by how much autonomy and confidence other engineers gain from the platform you’ve built.

We’d love to meet you if

  • You care deeply about building platforms that other engineers love to use, and you’re happiest when automation replaces repetitive work
  • You have a strong background in Platform Engineering, SRE, infrastructure or distributed systems
  • You have extensive experience building and operating Kubernetes-based and cloud-native environments, with infrastructure automation at scale
  • You’ve built and operated production environments using tools such as Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions or similar
  • You understand what it takes to operationalize AI workloads in production, and technologies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Neo4j, GraphRAG, vector databases or LangGraph are familiar territory
  • You believe observability, reliability and security belong in every design conversation
  • You enjoy improving developer experience through automation and self-service
  • You see the gap between a successful proof of concept and a production-ready system and immediately start figuring out how to close it
  • You take ownership of the result
  • You get satisfaction from enabling other engineers to move faster and safer
  • You are currently based in the Netherlands.

title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We’re looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You’ll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You’ll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

  • Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
  • Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.
  • Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.
  • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You’ll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications

  • Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master’s degree program.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.
  • Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.
  • An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.
  • Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You’ll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

title: Senior Architekt:in (m/w/d)  LP2 - LP4
description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

Über die Rolle

Als Senior Architekt:in mit Schwerpunkt in den Leistungsphasen 2–4 bist du Teil unseres interdisziplinären Planungsteams bei GROPYUS und arbeitest aktiv an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Wohngebäude mit.

Du begleitest unsere Projekte von der Entwurfsplanung bis zur Genehmigungsplanung und arbeitest dabei eng mit internen Fachplaner:innen, Projektleitungen sowie unserem Building System Team zusammen. Durch deine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise trägst du dazu bei, hochwertige, effiziente und nachhaltige Wohngebäude zu realisieren.

In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung für die planerische Ausarbeitung von Projekten, koordinierst Schnittstellen innerhalb des Planungsteams und bringst deine Erfahrung im Wohnungsbau sicher in die Projektarbeit ein. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf einer qualitativ hochwertigen Planung, einer engen interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit sowie der digitalen Planung in Revit.

Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Entwurfs-, Genehmigungs- und Ausführungsgrundlagen in Revit
  • Entwicklung architektonischer Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung technischer, funktionaler und wirtschaftlicher Anforderungen
  • Abstimmung und Koordination mit internen Fachplaner:innen sowie externen Projektbeteiligten
  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Planungskonzepten und Genehmigungsunterlagen
  • Sicherstellung der Planungsqualität sowie Einhaltung projektbezogener Standards und Prozesse
  • Mitwirkung an der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unseres digitalen und seriellen Planungssystems
  • Unterstützung der Projekt- und Planungsleitung bei organisatorischen und planerischen Aufgaben

Über dich

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Architektur und Eintragung in die Architektenkammer
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Planung von Wohnungsbauprojekten, idealerweise Erfahrung in der Projektleitung
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Leistungsphasen LP2–LP4 nach HOAI
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Revit und eine hohe Affinität zu digitaler Planung
  • Erfahrung im mehrgeschossigen Wohnungsbau
  • Erfahrung im Holzbau ist ein Plus
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir bieten:

  • Einen befristeten Vertrag (bis Juli 2027) mit 30 Urlaubstagen.
  • Flexible Arbeitsweise: Wir legen großen Wert auf regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Büro, und bieten auch die Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie die Option, bis zu 40 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Wir bieten eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sprachkurse (Englisch/Deutsch) und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Dich unsere externen Partner im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, um Deine psychische Gesundheit durch anonyme Einzel- oder Gruppensitzungen zu stärken.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du kannst wirklich etwas bewirken – auf allen Ebenen unserer Organisation. Finde Lösungen, treibe sie voran, teste und implementiere sie.

  • Ein vielfältiges und bereicherndes Arbeitsumfeld: Werde ein geschätztes Mitglied eines wunderbar vielfältigen Teams von Menschen aus über 50 Ländern. Bei GROPYUS legen wir großen Wert auf Inklusion und sorgen dafür, dass sich jeder – unabhängig von seinem Hintergrund – als Teil der Gemeinschaft fühlt. So werden unsere Unterschiede zu Stärken, die uns als Team weiterbringen. 

Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.

We can't wait to get to know you.

title: Founder & CEO (Vico Lead) mit SAP-Fokus
description: As Founder & CEO build your own €10M+ SAP services company, at zero financial risk, and join us in disrupting the industry (Offices: Berlin, Frankfurt, Barcelona, Seville) Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies - “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing. Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e.g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies. Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Roland Berger. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market. Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization. Why we are looking for founders & CEOs of new Vicos with SAP focus The founders & CEOs of Vicos we call Vico Leads. They are the key players, growing their Vicos. An important focus of our growth lies in SAP services which offer much growth potential for disruption. Therefore, we look for proven leaders in SAP services to become successful Vico Leads with our backing and support. Thereby, you grow your Vico beyond 10M+ € in revenue and 6-7-digit personal income. Some great leaders in SAP consulting have the ambition to become entrepreneurs. Few, however, act on it because the classic way to start a business is expensive and risky. Vícoland gives you the opportunity to (a) avoid the expenses and risk and (b) offer clients the unique benefits of services delivered by Vicos. Your opportunity: cross the €10 million € revenue line within two years We are looking for founders who want to take their Vico to €10 million in revenue and more, within about two years. Vicos can grow to multi-million € revenue already within 12 months. • Your business: Your clients, your offer, your positioning. You decide what you build and how fast you grow. • Your team: You build your team from freelancers and SMEs and can bind key people to your Vico by contract. • Your profit & asset: Your Vico's profit is yours. You or a personal company of yours is general contractor of the Vico. Which means you can also sell the business you build as your Vico. What Vicoland offers We provide extensive support and backing to enable and accelerate your business building: • Infrastructure: Our certified platform covers marketing, finance, legal and organization, so you can run your Vico end-to-end without overhead. • Market access: You can use Vicoland GmbH’s listing with major corporations to make business with them immediately. • Sales support: We provide leads from our enterprise pipeline and support in acquisition. • Sourcing: You get access to thousands of experts, with a strong focus on SAP, and support in finding the right people for your team anywhere in the world. • Financial services: We provide insurance and factoring. • Mentoring: You get guidance from experienced Vicoland professionals. • Transition: If you are moving from employment, we give you financial security for the transition. What you do You run your Vico as its founder & CEO, that is Vico Lead. You: • Win clients from your own network and build your own pipeline. Leads from Vicoland add to it, they do not replace it. • Pitch, close deals and grow your client relationships. • Define your focus, for example S/4HANA, BTP, FI/CO, MM, SD, SuccessFactors or AI. • Recruit your team from your own network and from Vicoland's network of experts. • Lead delivery and answer to your clients for its quality. • Set the standards and playbooks your Vico scales with. • Build your visibility through content, events and your community. Who you are • You have won clients: you have pitched, closed deals and kept clients. • You have led and grew something: a team, a unit, a practice or a business line, ideally with revenue responsibility. • You know enterprise technology and bring a network of clients and experts. SAP is the natural fit, because our expert network is strongest there. Strong experience in other enterprise technologies works as well. • You want to build a company, not try out self-employment. • You have not taken the step yet, but you are ready for it. • You speak German and English fluently. You do not need to be a finished entrepreneur yet. You do need the ambition to become one. Ready to build your own company? Then let's talk. We start with a conversation, not a formal application. description: Über Aever Clinics Aever Clinics gehört zu einer wachsenden europäischen Klinikgruppe im Bereich Beauty, Hautgesundheit und ästhetische Behandlungen. Du baust durch deine freundliche Art und deine fachliche Kompetenz langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Du empfiehlst passende Behandlungspläne und Pakete auf Grundlage der individuellen Kundenbedürfnisse. Du trägst durch guten Service und kompetente Beratung zur Kundenzufriedenheit, Kundenbindung und zum Erfolg der Klinik bei. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Clinic Manager und dem gesamten Team zusammen und unterstützt einen reibungslosen Klinikalltag. Das bringst du mit Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannte Kosmetiker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Kosmetik, Hautpflege oder Ästhetik. Eine gültige NiSV-Fachkunde für die Anwendung nichtionisierender Strahlung zu kosmetischen Zwecken ist erforderlich. Idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit Laser-Haarentfernung sowie weiteren apparativen oder ästhetischen Behandlungen. Interesse an moderner Hautpflege, innovativen Behandlungstechnologien und ästhetischen Dienstleistungen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Ein professionelles, freundliches Auftreten und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen. Eine sorgfältige, zuverlässige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise. Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und die Motivation, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Das bieten wir dir Attraktives Bonussystem und die Möglichkeit, aktiv zum Erfolg der Klinik beizutragen. Kostenlose Behandlungen und Mitarbeiterrabatte. Regelmäßige Schulungen sowie Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung. Die Chance, mit modernen Geräten und innovativen Behandlungstechnologien zu arbeiten. Ein motiviertes Team und ein internationales, wachsendes Unternehmen. Perspektiven für deine berufliche Entwicklung innerhalb von Aever Clinics. title: Data Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom
description:
Data Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom

 

 

Location: Remote (UK)
Type of contract: Freelance
Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Role
Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting data engineers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a data engineer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant
  • Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective
  • Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part

What you’ll bring

  • Residence in the UK
  • Fluent English
  • A device with a working microphone
  • No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.

Why join this project?
This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

SUMMARY 

OneStream Software delivers a unified Corporate Performance Management (CPM) platform designed to meet the complex financial, operational, and analytical needs of large enterprises. OneStream operates at enterprise scale, supporting mission-critical workloads for the Office of the CFO across highly regulated industries. 

The OneStream platform is built on a sophisticated technology stack that includes distributed, multi-threaded services, OLAP and multidimensional data models, modern web frameworks, SQL-based persistence, and increasingly cloud-native, SaaS-oriented architecture on Microsoft Azure. 

 

The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software components within OneStream, building high-quality features using established design patterns and best practices. This role owns assigned features through the full software development lifecycle, collaborates with senior engineers, Product, and Quality Assurance, and develops user interfaces, APIs, and data access logic. The Software Engineer participates in code reviews and assists in diagnosing and resolving defects and production issues to ensure reliable, high-performing solutions and positive customer experience. Success in this role is measured by code quality, reliability, learning velocity, and the ability to deliver well‑scoped features safely and predictably. 

 

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software components within OneStream solutions. 
  • Implement features using established design patterns and best practices under guidance from senior engineers. 
  • Contribute to UI development using modern UI frameworks including Angular, React, and Blazor. 
  • Develop and integrate APIs and services following RESTful standards and practices. 
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code with appropriate unit test coverage. 
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development, refactoring, test creation, and documentation, while validating AI-generated output for correctness, security, and architectural alignment. 
  • Participate in peer code reviews to improve code quality and consistency. 
  • Assist in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving software defects across development and test environments. 
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and other engineering team members to deliver features that meet functional and quality expectations. 
  • Follow established SDLC, security, and compliance protocols

 

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 2–4 years of professional software development experience. 
  • Experience with object-oriented programming and the Microsoft technology stack, including C#, .NET, and ASP.NET. 
  • Basic experience with modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, Blazor, and WPF. 
  • Familiarity with data formats and markup languages such as JSON and XML. 
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL fundamentals. 
  • Experience using source control systems (Git) and participating in CI/CD workflows. 
  • Ability to write and review unit tests to validate functionality. 

 

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Experience building enterprise or platform-oriented applications. 
  • Familiarity with cloud‑hosted or SaaS‑based systems. 
  • Introductory experience with automated testing practices. 
  • Azure Fundamentals or entry-level Azure certification. 
  • Familiarity with Cursor, Claude Code, etc. 

 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES 

  • Solid understanding of software development fundamentals and object-oriented design. 
  • Ability to learn new technologies and frameworks quickly. 
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. 
  • Attention to detail and commitment to code quality. 

 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

There are no supervisory responsibilities required for this role. 

 

TRAVEL 

Travel Requirement: Regular travel is not expected for this position 

 

#LI-Remote #LI-KA1

 

Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job-related criteria. Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply.

Gross annual base salary
€49.000—€64.000 EUR

 

All candidates must be legally authorized to work for any company in the country where this position is located without sponsorship.

 
OneStream Software is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and merchants every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s (& Doordash’s) growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Event Streaming Systems team. This is a hybrid role.

In this role, you’ll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You’ll help define the long-term direction of our messaging and streaming platforms, lead high-impact technical initiatives across teams, and raise the reliability, scalability and operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.

These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.
  • Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.
  • Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.
  • Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.
  • Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.
  • Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:

  • Significant experience building, operating and evolving distributed systems in production, ideally for platform or infrastructure teams supporting critical workloads.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.
  • Strong technical leadership skills, with a track record of defining technical direction, shaping roadmaps and leading multi-engineer or cross-team initiatives.
  • Ability to make and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations, using data, operational signals, customer needs and long-term system health to guide tradeoffs.
  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.
  • Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.
  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale, including incident leadership and post-incident improvement programs.
  • Experience with database reliability, storage systems, data platforms or DBRE practices in addition to event streaming.
  • Experience using automation or AI-assisted operational tooling to improve reliability, developer experience or incident response quality.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo (Doordash), you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.

Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale. Work on complex, always-on infrastructure that impacts millions every day.
  • 🌱 See your impact, fast. Shape the direction of foundational platforms used by teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership. Lead ambiguous, high-impact technical problems with strong support from peers and leaders.
  • 🌎 A culture built for builders. High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  • 💰 Share in the success you help create. Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3–4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

#LI-LW1

title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. The role sits within Platform Engineering and is based primarily at the production site, dispositioning nonconformances and Material Review Board (MRB) actions for electrical systems and sub-assemblies, resolving design questions in real time, and closing the loop between production and design so that issues get root caused and fixed at the source. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues.

Key Responsibilities

Production Floor Engineering Support

  • Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines
  • Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity
  • Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries
  • Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions
  • Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions
  • Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments)

Electrical Design Contribution

  • Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor
  • Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions
  • Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle

Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support

  • Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites
  • Support the stand-up and ramp of production at new or expanding manufacturing sites, ensuring electrical design engineering knowledge transfers effectively
  • Raise and implement engineering changes to correct production issues that originate in the electrical design, through the Anduril configuration management and change process
  • Feed production observations, failure modes and DFM/DFA opportunities back into Platform Electrical design work through structured feedback, prioritised using data

Design to Production Interface

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering on work instruction (WI) development, tooling validation, and First Article Inspection (FAI) activities for electrical assemblies, communicating the design intent and acceptance criteria
  • Own the resolution of EBOM discrepancies found in production for electrical assemblies, and give engineering input to Configuration Management and Manufacturing Engineering on PLM workflows, BOM reconciliation and work instruction tooling
  • Identify patterns across electrical nonconformances, test failures and build issues, and lead engineering root cause analysis and design corrective action implementation
  • Collaborate on the improvement of key tool and functional interfaces (PLM workflows, digital work instructions, BOM reconciliation) that impact design-to-production efficiency
  • Support the development of scalable frameworks for multi-site production: configuration management alignment, site-specific work instruction adaptation, and cross-site lesson-learned sharing
  • Build repeatable playbooks for standing up production of new product variants, reducing ramp time and first-unit defects at each additional site

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Metrics

  • Maintain strong working relationships with Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Management to ensure aligned priorities and rapid issue resolution
  • Collate and drive corrective actions on design-originated production issues, providing data-backed prioritisation to core Design Engineering teams
  • Participate in Production readiness reviews, design reviews (P&DFMEA, DFM/A/T) and engineering change assessments

Key Competencies & Attributes

  • Engineering Judgement: Technical depth in electrical and power systems combined with production pragmatism - able to make sound engineering decisions under time pressure without over-engineering solutions
  • Design Authority Integrity: You protect product safety and integrity under schedule pressure, understand the limits of your delegated authority and escalate when you should
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Credibility with both design engineers and production operators; able to speak both languages and bridge communication gaps
  • Autonomy & Initiative: Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities in a fast-moving production environment; able to self-direct and prioritise without constant direction
  • Systems Thinking: Thinks beyond individual issue resolution to identify patterns, root causes, and scalable solutions that prevent recurrence across sites and variants
  • Communication: Clear, concise technical communication - written dispositions, engineering reports, and presentations to leadership

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Proven experience in a senior role within defence, tech or any fast-paced environment, driving successful electrical engineering projects from concept to market launch
  • Expertise in electrical engineering principles, techniques, and technologies, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions
  • Proficiency in using industry-standard electrical design and simulation software
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor junior engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation
  • Strong time management and organisational abilities, with a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time and within budget
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and adapt to diverse and evolving challenges
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with fast paced environment best practices, including agility, adaptability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 Australian Government Security Clearance
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience working on or directly supporting a production floor
  • Understanding of Material Review Board (MRB) processes, nonconformance management, and engineering disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return to vendor)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing electrical and power systems for unmanned vehicles
  • Experience in the subsea or maritime domain
  • Experience working on defence programs and familiarity with current Defence standards
  • Previous experience as a Product, Sustaining, Liaison or Production Support Engineer with delegated design or disposition authority
  • Experience with first article inspection (e.g. AS9102) and production test development
  • Familiarity with IPC/WHMA-A-620 and/or IPC-A-610

title: Senior Manager, AI Architect
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

 

Our Solutions & AI Lab (SAIL) practice are looking for an experienced AI Architect to join the team. 

Our Solutions & AI Labs practice helps clients control their data, turn it into actionable insight, and better leverage it through AI and Machine Learning solutions embedded directly into business processes. We support clients across a range of industries and offer deep expertise in AI/ML, Cloud, Platform Engineering and Managed Solutions. 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager to serve as an AI Architect — someone who can design the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI platforms, lead consultancy engagements, and grow our AI & Solutions Engineering capability. 

The AI Architect role owns the technical blueprint for AI-enabled solutions delivered in and around our clients’ environments, combining deep architectural specialism with the commercial and leadership skills to shape and grow our practice. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of client advisory, AI platform architecture and hands-on delivery leadership — and who has a genuine passion for bringing AI systems to production at scale. 

What you will be doing

As a Senior Manager and AI Architect, you will own and lead the architecture of complex AI programmes end-to-end — from shaping the opportunity and winning the work, through solution design, delivery governance and team leadership. You will bring SME-level depth in enterprise AI architecture and apply it to create real, lasting value for our clients. 

Although we do not expect you to be an expert in every technology listed below simultaneously, our team consists of people who can advise clients as well as bring deep technical knowledge when needed. Key responsibilities span the following areas. 

Engagement & delivery leadership 

  • Own and lead the architecture of complex AI and data transformation engagements, taking accountability for solution design, quality, technical risk and client outcomes. 
  • Lead and resource multi-disciplinary delivery teams — architects, engineers, data scientists and consultants — providing clear direction, technical oversight and people development. 
  • Manage engagement resourcing: forecast team requirements, work with practice leadership to staff engagements, and develop the talent pipeline through mentoring of junior practitioners. 
  • Proactively identify and manage delivery and architectural risks in complex stakeholder environments, escalating appropriately and maintaining client confidence throughout. 
  • Communicate clearly to both technical teams and senior client stakeholders, translating architectural complexity into actionable insight and decisive recommendation. 
  • Conduct rigorous architecture and design reviews and uphold engineering standards across every engagement you lead. 

Stakeholder management & advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to client architects, CTOs, CDAOs and engineering leads, earning trust through depth of knowledge and a demonstrable delivery track record. 
  • Build and maintain strong, senior client relationships, navigating competing priorities across business, technology and risk functions. 
  • Facilitate architecture workshops and decision forums, driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and securing buy-in for target-state designs. 
  • Translate business strategy into architectural roadmaps, sequencing investment and change in a way that balances ambition with deliverability. 

Business development & bid support 

  • Play a leading role in business development: identifying new opportunities, shaping propositions, and supporting or leading bids and tender responses for AI and technology engagements. 
  • Contribute to proposal writing, articulating our capabilities and differentiators, including authoring technical and architecture sections of bid responses to client tenders and RFPs. 
  • Support practice-level growth initiatives, including account planning, capability development, and go-to-market positioning for AI architecture and solutions engineering services.  

Technical architecture — what you will design 

You will be the design authority for enterprise AI platforms, able to reason across the full stack and make credible technology selections. We expect expert-level depth in several of the areas below and working knowledge across the rest. 

AI platform & cloud architecture 

  • Architect AI and Data Platforms using a mix of technologies including Databricks, Snowflake, Claude Enterprise and the native services of Azure, AWS and GCP - selecting the right tool for the workload rather than defaulting to a single vendor. 
  • Design for scalability, security, cost efficiency and multi-cloud / hybrid patterns, with a strong grasp of containerisation, infrastructure-as-code, event-driven architectures and CI/CD. 
  • Balance technical excellence with delivery pragmatism and commercial realities, championing the path from prototype to production. 

Enterprise AI ecosystem integration 

  • Bring awareness of the broader enterprise landscape and how AI integrates with core operational systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and other systems of record and engagement. 
  • Design integration patterns that let AI capabilities interoperate safely with enterprise data, identity, workflow and process automation platforms – including MCP and A2A and how these capabilities enable an enterprise Agent mesh.  
  • Understand the data, governance and change implications of embedding AI into mission-critical enterprise processes. 

Orchestration & control plane 

  • Architect the orchestration and control-plane layer that governs how AI capabilities are exposed, routed and managed across the enterprise. 
  • Design MCP, AI and LLM gateway layers for secure, observable and policy-controlled access to models and tools. 
  • Design agent and skills registries — including recommending suitable technologies and patterns — to enable discovery, reuse and governance of agentic capabilities. 
  • Define the control plane for routing, rate limiting, cost management, model selection and version control across multiple model providers. 

AI solution design 

  • Design retrieval and reasoning architectures including RAG, corrective RAG (CRAG), and agentic patterns, selecting the right approach for a given business problem. 
  • Architect agent harnesses and their components — planning, memory, tool use, state management and multi-agent coordination. 
  • Design prompt strategies, context management and grounding approaches for reliable, production-grade LLM behaviour. 

Evaluation, guardrails & responsible AI 

  • Design evaluation frameworks and guardrails that make AI systems safe, reliable and measurable — covering accuracy, safety, bias, and task success. 
  • Embed responsible-AI and governance controls aligned to emerging regulation and client risk appetites. 
  • Define human-in-the-loop and fallback strategies for high-stakes use cases. 

Observability & operations 

  • Architect logging, monitoring, tracing and cost-observability across the AI stack, including model, agent and platform telemetry. 
  • Design for drift detection, performance monitoring and continuous evaluation in production (LLMOps / MLOps). 
  • Establish operational patterns for reliability, incident response and lifecycle management of AI systems at scale. 

 
Your skills and experience  

We're seeking a technically credible, commercially aware leader who brings a rare combination of architectural depth, delivery accountability and client advisory skill — someone energised by the complexity of taking AI solutions to production at scale. 

  • 7+ years in technology consulting, architecture or AI/ML engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership or lead-architect role — including accountability for end-to-end solution design, resourcing and commercial outcomes. 
  • Proven ability to architect enterprise AI platforms across a mix of technologies (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, GCP) with strong design capability across cloud, data and AI domains. 
  • Working understanding of how AI integrates with major operational systems such as SAP, Salesforce and ServiceNow. 
  • Hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, LLM gateways, MCP, RAG/CRAG, agent harnesses, evaluations and guardrails, and AI observability. 
  • Demonstrable experience designing and leading data & AI transformation programmes, and building high-performing teams in complex stakeholder environments — engaging comfortably at CTO, CDAO or engineering-director level. 
  • Track record of supporting or leading bid and proposal activity, including writing technical and architecture sections of responses to tenders and RFPs. 
  • A clear, confident communicator able to make the complex accessible for technical and non-technical audiences alike. 
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent depth through relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional ML Engineer, Databricks / Azure / GCP architecture credentials). 

Industry experience 

We would particularly like to hear from people who have designed and led data & AI transformation programmes across one or more of the following sectors: 

  • Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) 
  • Retail 
  • Pharmaceuticals & Life Sciences 
  • Manufacturing 
  • Financial Services 
  • Government and Public Services  

Prior experience as an embedded or forward-deployed architect within a client environment, and exposure to regulated industries would be desired. 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

 

Join us

Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. title: Senior Supply Specialist - UK
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The UK Operations Team is responsible for delivering Waymo service across UK cities. This role works closely with Product, Operations Partnerships, Engineering, Global Operations, Ops Planning, Finance, Safety, Policy and business partners.

We are seeking a confident, decisive, and results-oriented leader to join our team as a Supply Operations Manager. This role demands an individual who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments, excels at managing cross-functional teams, and is committed to driving operational success and market excellence for our autonomous ride-hailing service. You'll foster strong partnerships, champion continuous improvement, and leverage data analytics to monitor market health, identify trends, and implement proactive strategies to balance demand and supply, ultimately driving innovation and long-term success.

In this hybrid role, you will report to the Country Lead within the European Market Operations Team.

You will:

  • Strategic Leadership (Partner Support/Management): Strategic and decisive leadership to manage and optimize daily partner operations, fostering a high-performance culture emphasizing collaboration and accountability, escalating product issues while supporting partner multi-facility operations (partner results) to ensure strict adherence to all safety, compliance, and regulatory protocols.
  • Commercialization: Primary liaison to support internal stakeholders in expanding the market by providing guidance and expertise, communicating with all stakeholders to ensure alignment, monitoring progress, identifying potential issues, and developing contingency plans to ensure the success and sustainability of the market scale.
  • Supply & Demand Planning: Manage Supply & Demand Planning by ensuring that staffing levels align with operational needs and in-service supply.
  • Continuous Improvement: Must be continuously monitoring and improving processes, systems, and performance metrics to drive efficiency and productivity, and reduce costs.
  • Co-Lead Market Expansion: Strategically expand the market by executing innovative initiatives with partners, leveraging data insights, and applying critical thinking to identify opportunities and resolve challenges effectively.
  • Build Collaborative Partnerships: Build and maintain strong partnerships across the company and with partners, ensuring alignment with organizational standards, goals, and a shared commitment to success.
  • Drive Sustainable Outcomes: Serve as a trusted leader with a continuous improvement mindset, consistently monitoring and enhancing processes, systems, and performance metrics to drive operational excellence, strengthen stakeholder alignment, and deliver measurable, sustainable results, all while boosting efficiency, productivity, and reducing costs.
  • Maximize Market Profitability: Manage departmental budgets, identifying and implementing cost-saving initiatives, and monitoring key performance indicators to effectively allocate resources and ensure all operational initiatives align with financial parameters and organizational goals.

You have:

  • 10+ years of experience in operations management, preferably managing daily operations in a fast-paced environment in fleet management, transportation, or logistics, with a deep understanding of safety.
  • Bachelor's degree, or in lieu of a degree, an additional 6+ years of work experience in a combination of program management, business operations, strategy consulting, planning, or equivalent fields.
  • Excellent leadership skills, including the ability to motivate & lead by influence partner teams, develop and execute strategies, and drive performance improvement.
  • Ability to deal with multiple conflicting priorities and stakeholder issues while driving towards pragmatic decisions/actions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and address performance issues proactively, preferably using data analytics tools and reporting software to track key metrics and performance trends.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills showcasing an ability to influence people to contribute to continuous improvement of operations.

We prefer:

Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results.
