The opportunity You’ll be the keeper of the player experience on our hybrid casual RPG. Combat, heroes, art, and features all come together in the levels you build, and you decide whether that adds up to something players want to come back to. You’ll join a small, AI-native game team on its way to launch. You’ll own the level design area completely: you set the roadmap, make the calls, and ship. A dedicated level editor and an AI-powered level generation pipeline will be ready on day one, so you spend your time on what matters: making every level fun. What you’ll do Build. Design, build, and tune levels directly in Unity, covering layouts, encounters, pacing and difficulty. Scale. Triple our level content by combining our AI pipeline with your own design judgment. Balance. Model how health, damage, and stat changes affect the numbers before anything ships. Polish. Bring existing levels to final quality and give them the feel and juice that make players stay. Own. Set the level design roadmap, make design calls, and question whether each choice fits the game. Specify. Write clear, detailed specs that developers can implement as written. Learn from players. Use playtests and player data to see what works and iterate quickly. AI. Use AI every day to generate layouts, prototype encounters, simulate balancing, and automate level work. Requirements Years of level design experience, with shipped levels on a hybrid casual, RPG or combat-based game. Hands-on balancing skills: you’re comfortable with stats, health and damage maths, and spreadsheets. Fluency in Unity: you build and iterate levels in the engine yourself. A strong sense of game feel: you know when a level is fun, and you can explain why. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink. The autonomy to build your own roadmap and make design decisions. A data-driven approach to level tuning. Feature design experience alongside level design. For this role, you’ll also bring Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke. Proactive. You don’t wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it. Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. Hungry and motivated. You’re ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Why Homa Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest. Real ownership. You own the player experience of a game, and you’ll see your levels move the metrics. The right tools from day one. A dedicated level editor and an AI level pipeline, so you focus on design. A high talent bar. Our teams are small and ambiti us, and the people around you will push you to grow. AI at the core. You’ll have access to the best AI tools, and you’ll help shape how level design works in an AI-first company. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values: Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow. Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality. Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention. Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher. Benefits Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate. 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals. 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely. title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
skills: LTDS - Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes
description: Contexte Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingé nierie@Lyon , propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux. Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique. Cas d’étude Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes. Profil recherché Le profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés. Type de contrat Le contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Product (M/F/X)
description:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner ! 

Notre ambition ?  Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s

HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses !

Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.

Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

L'opportunité:

HelloFresh France place le produit au cœur de sa croissance, et ce rôle en est le moteur. En tant que Directeur(rice) Produit, vous piloterez une équipe pluridisciplinaire couvrant le culinaire, le développement recettes, l'innovation produit et l'analytique, avec la responsabilité pleine et entière de ce qui se retrouve au menu chaque semaine : les ingrédients que nous sélectionnons, les concepts que nous créons, et les arbitrages commerciaux qui les sous-tendent. Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat. C'est un rôle concret et exigeant, à la croisée de l'alimentaire, de la stratégie et des opérations, là où la qualité du produit est ce qui fidélise nos clients. 

Vos missions:

  1. Construire et développer une équipe produit performante
  • Fédérer, inspirer et manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire — en posant une vision claire, en instaurant des rythmes de travail qui permettent d'avancer vite, et en investissant dans les personnes qui porteront le prochain chapitre de HelloFresh France.
  1. Définir et challenger la vision produit
  • Construire une vision claire et ambitieuse de ce que doit devenir notre produit physique — ancrée dans la connaissance client, rigoureuse sur le plan commercial, et suffisamment différenciante pour gagner. Développer un point de vue propre et indépendant, nourri des insights de l'équipe Produit globale, mais enraciné dans la réalité du marché français.
  • Garantir l'accès aux informations, analyses et données nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de développement produit, et traduire la vision en actions concrètes.
  • Pousser l'équipe et l'entreprise à aller au-delà de la feuille de route actuelle — en remettant en question les hypothèses, en interrogeant les arbitrages, et en s'assurant que nous travaillons toujours sur ce qui a le plus d'impact.
  1. Piloter la rétention client et la performance commerciale
  • Faire de la rétention client votre boussole. Construire une vision rigoureuse et fondée sur les données de ce qui la détermine, et mobiliser l'équipe autour des actions qui font vraiment la différence.
  • Prendre des décisions produit en ayant pleinement conscience de leurs implications financières. Prendre des risques calculés, mesurer les résultats honnêtement, et ajuster rapidement quand un pari ne fonctionne pas.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Opérations (Achats, Qualité, Production, etc.) pour assurer une approche coordonnée des initiatives produit, à l'échelle locale comme globale.
  1. Aligner produit et stratégie marketing
  • Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe brand & marketing pour que la feuille de route produit et la stratégie marketing soient pleinement synchronisées — ce que nous construisons, comment nous en parlons et comment nous le vendons doivent former une proposition cohérente.
  • Être la voix du produit au sein du comité de direction, en portant une vision convaincante de là où le produit doit aller et pourquoi.

Votre profil:

  • Expérience : 8 à 10 ans minimum dans le Produit, la Stratégie ou un rôle de leadership commercial similaire, idéalement dans l'alimentaire, le FMCG, les meal kits ou l'abonnement.
  • Outils : Maîtrise avancée d'Excel / Google Sheets et de PowerPoint / Google Slides ; curiosité et aisance avec l'IA indispensables.
  • Leadership : Au moins 3 ans de management d'équipes pluridisciplinaires à différents niveaux de carrière — avec un vrai sens du coaching, une direction claire et l'envie de faire grandir les gens
  • Un(e) leader qui passe à l'action. Vous donnez le cap, vous emmenez votre équipe avec vous, et vous mettez la main à la pâte pour que ça se concrétise.
  • Orienté(e) client et rigoureux(se) dans l'analyse. À l'aise pour interroger vos propres données et challenger vos hypothèses. Capable d'aller dans le détail, de faire le lien avec la vision d'ensemble, et de restituer les insights avec clarté.
  • Orienté(e) business. Vous comprenez comment les décisions produit se répercutent sur les coûts et les revenus — et vous vous tenez responsable des résultats, pas seulement des réalisations.
  • Fédérateur(rice) transversal(e). Vous installez rapidement la confiance, faites avancer les choses par l'influence, et savez inscrire les bonnes priorités dans les agendas des autres équipes.
  • Bon(ne) résolveur(se) de problèmes — à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté, déterminé(e) à trouver des solutions, avec un réflexe naturel pour l'action.
  • Excellent(e) communicant(e). Vous écrivez et présentez avec clarté et conviction — que ce soit pour un narratif stratégique, une mise à jour pour le leadership ou un brief produit.
  • Organisé(e) et structuré(e), avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité à tenir des délais serrés.
  • Passionné(e) de food, avec la capacité à transformer les tendances et les signaux marché en offres produit attractives.

Ce que nous t’offrons : 

  • Un environnement dynamique et international, avec une culture d'entreprise forte
  • Une courbe d’apprentissage rapide garantie ! 
  • Une équipe française bienveillante, passionnée, proactive et dynamique
  • Des bureaux au cœur de Paris, dans le 1er arrondissement
  • Nos avantages : de délicieuses réductions sur nos Box HelloFresh, tickets restaurant Swile, réduction sur le transport, un accès privilégié à Gymlib 

Le déroulé du processus de recrutement :

Nous examinons ton CV et ta lettre de motivation. Si c’est un match, nous t’invitons à une série d’entretiens et à réaliser un case study. Nous nous engageons à organiser rapidement les entretiens, afin de t’accueillir chez HelloFresh au plus vite !

Tes débuts chez HelloFresh : 

A ton arrivée, nous te concoctons des sessions d’onboarding qui te permettront de rencontrer chaque manager et de t’imprégner ainsi du fonctionnement de HelloFresh. Tu auras aussi du temps pour faire plus ample connaissance avec ton équipe avant de plonger dans le vif de tes missions !

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

For clarity and accessibility, we have chosen not to use gender-neutral or inclusive writing conventions in our communications. WPP Media is firmly committed to diversity: we value inclusion and equality, considering all candidates regardless of gender identity, ethnic origin, or religion. All our positions are also open to people with disabilities.

About WPP Media

WPP is a creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build a better future for our people, our planet, our clients, and our communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP's global media network. In a world where media is omnipresent, we bring together the best platform, the best talent, and the best partners to develop the most innovative solutions, delivering unparalleled growth for our clients. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It is through this synergy that we deliver truly exceptional experiences, for both our clients and our internal teams. To succeed in this role, it is crucial to embody the core values that unite WPP and WPP Media:

  • Be Extraordinary by fostering collective leadership that inspires truly transformative creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by finding the perfect balance between the fulfillment of our people and the satisfaction of our clients, all built on mutual trust.
  • Lead with Optimism by actively stimulating growth and development to mobilize our entire organization.

About EssenceMediacom

EssenceMediacom represents a new approach to the media agency. Our expertise is based on in-depth data analysis and a keen understanding of consumer behavior, combined with the most advanced technologies.

We are convinced that the strategic alliance between media and creativity can radically transform the performance of the biggest brands. Our role is to support our clients in understanding the complex challenges of contemporary marketing and to identify the levers of innovation that will enable them to create lasting connections with their consumers.

Our organizational structure reflects this modern vision: we combine intelligent data utilization with a human-centered approach, we cultivate diversity of perspectives and expertise, and we favor a continuous, large-scale experimentation and learning approach. Above all, we have integrated adaptability into our DNA to continuously evolve with market transformations.

The Role

The Performance & Analytics Manager – Europe will be a crucial member of our client-focused team for the Europe region, responsible for assisting in the planning, execution, and optimization of European digital acquisition campaigns and analyzing cross-media results on all European campaigns for our luxury sector client.

This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, advanced analytical prowess, and strong collaborative skills to evaluate multi-channel performance, ensure consistent brand adherence across European markets, and drive knowledge sharing across international teams. You will play a key role in measuring media efficiency, driving brand visibility, and optimizing customer acquisition across all media channels in Europe.

Key Responsibilities

  • European Campaign Planning & Execution: Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of regional digital acquisition campaigns (Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Programmatic, etc.) across European markets, ensuring strict alignment with the client's global strategy and European brand guidelines.
  • Cross-Media Analytics & Performance Reporting: Lead the comprehensive analysis and evaluation of cross-media results across all European campaigns (combining digital, offline, print, broadcast, and programmatic channels). Identify cross-channel synergies, key trends, and actionable data insights to maximize overall media ROI across the region.
  • Cross-Market Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Actively liaise with local European market teams to facilitate the exchange of performance insights, cross-media learnings, and best practices, fostering a connected and high-performing European network. Participate in regional and global team calls and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Quality Assurance & Analytics Governance: Support the implementation and adherence to European performance marketing and measurement guidelines, ensuring data integrity, tracking accuracy, and operational consistency across all regional campaign activities.
  • European Market Intelligence: Stay abreast of European media trends, cross-media measurement innovations, platform updates (e.g., Google, Meta, programmatic platforms, local European media networks), and regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ePrivacy directives), sharing relevant implications with regional and local teams.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Experience: 3–5 years of proven experience in media planning, buying, and cross-media performance analytics, either agency-side or client-side, with a strong focus on performance marketing. Experience working across European markets is highly desirable.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in French is essential, alongside business proficiency in English. Proficiency in other European languages is a significant advantage.
  • Technical Acumen: Demonstrated expertise across digital acquisition channels (Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Programmatic) and modern cross-media analytics platforms and tracking tools.
  • Analytical & Data Skills: Advanced ability to work with complex numerical datasets, analyze cross-media campaign performance, isolate channel impact, and distill complex data into clear, strategic recommendations.
  • Project Management: Capable of managing multiple European campaigns and analytics projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interpersonal & Communication: Dynamic with excellent communication and client service skills, capable of collaborating effectively across multi-cultural European teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving & Innovation: Proactive approach to identifying performance bottlenecks and an aptitude for leveraging media data to propose innovative cross-channel solutions.
  • Attitude: Enthusiastic, with a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and drive growth in the luxury sector.
  • Core Values: Exhibits strong team spirit, thoroughness, and attention to detail in all tasks.

Life at WPP Media and its Benefits

Our commitment to shaping the future of media is manifested by active support for the professional development of our talents, helping them reach their full potential. This approach is accompanied by a responsible vision in our media investment strategies, thus reflecting our dual priority: valuing our employees while adopting sustainable practices in our sector. WPP Media employees have privileged access to WPP Media's and WPP's international networks, allowing them to develop their passions, expand their professional network, and stay at the forefront of innovations in marketing and advertising.

We have vast and varied resources available to our employees; our company actively cultivates the inclusion of talents from all backgrounds. The successes and expertise of the teams are regularly highlighted during unifying events that also punctuate key moments of the year, thus strengthening our collaborative and diverse corporate culture.

Our benefits include:

  • Remote work: up to 2 days per week and 2 full weeks to be taken twice a year.
  • Two additional days off offered, including Whit Monday.
  • Additional leave days based on seniority in 5-year increments.
  • 5 additional remote work days per month for employees suffering from endometriosis.
  • Disability policy: 3 paid authorized absence days per year, access to Chèques Emploi Service Universel (CESU), and specific support for employees with a RQTH (Recognition of Disabled Worker Status).
  • Solidarity missions possible via the "We care and we act" program.

Recruitment Process

  1. Interview with the recruitment team: A first phone or video conference interview with a member of our recruitment team to review your background, discuss your experience with European campaign management and analytics, and address your questions.
  2. Operational interview: An interview with the Luxury Client Team lead to assess your technical, analytical, and management skills.
  3. Case study: A practical case study focused on cross-media campaign analysis and strategy within the European market, followed by a debriefing session.

We are committed to making this process as fast and efficient as possible, and to maintaining open and transparent communication throughout.

WPP Media guarantees equal opportunities and considers all candidates without discrimination or consideration of particular characteristics. We are committed to cultivating an environment of respect where everyone feels at home and benefits from the same opportunities for professional development.

Consult our privacy policy to learn all about the protection of your data. Although we review all applications received, we only contact those selected for an interview.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Senior Associate - Materials
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Strategy Associate, Materials & Circular Economy

Location: London preferred. Amsterdam also possible

Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to join our Materials & Circular Economy team. This role is suited to someone who combines strong strategic thinking with the intellectual curiosity to tackle complex sustainability challenges.

You will work on some of the most important questions facing companies, governments and wider society as they shift towards more circular and sustainable models. Projects can range from shaping corporate strategy and identifying new business opportunities to assessing value chains, developing policy recommendations and designing system-level interventions.

We are looking for someone who can bring the core toolkit and pace of a strong strategy consultant: structured problem-solving, analytical rigour, clear communication and sound judgement. Strategy consulting experience is one route to demonstrating this. We are equally interested in candidates from other demanding analytical environments who can show the same quality of thinking and ability to turn complexity into clear recommendations.

You will join small, senior-led project teams and take meaningful responsibility from the outset. You will structure problems, conduct analysis, develop insights and work directly with clients to translate those insights into practical strategic choices.

Responsibilities

You will:

  • Structure complex problems: break ambiguous questions into clear workstreams, hypotheses and analytical priorities.

  • Generate insights: conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, drawing conclusions from incomplete or complex information.

  • Shape recommendations: translate analysis into clear, concise and practical strategic recommendations.

  • Develop client materials: produce high-quality presentations, briefings and other client-ready outputs.

  • Engage with clients: work directly with senior stakeholders across businesses, governments, foundations and non-governmental organisations.

  • Contribute to project direction: help shape project approaches, hypotheses and emerging strategic conclusions.

  • Build trusted relationships: work effectively with clients, partners and stakeholders across multi-organisation initiatives.

About the team

You will be part of Systemiq's Materials & Circular Economy platform, led by Partner Ben Dixon.

Ben works across circular economy and energy topics and has advised organisations including the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, the United Nations International Resource Panel and multinational companies across packaging, chemicals and related sectors. He also leads Systemiq's work on plastics, focused on accelerating the transition towards a more circular and resource-efficient plastics system.

What we are looking for

Strategy and analytical capability

We are looking for candidates who already demonstrate, or can quickly operate with, the core toolkit expected in strategy consulting. You should be able to:

  • Structure complex and ambiguous problems into clear components, hypotheses and analytical questions.

  • Apply strong analytical judgement to qualitative and quantitative information.

  • Synthesize complex material into concise insights and decision-relevant recommendations.

  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including through high-quality presentation materials.

  • Work effectively at pace, managing changing priorities and imperfect information.

  • Move comfortably between detailed analysis and the broader strategic question.

Experience and background

You will typically bring:

  • At least two years of experience in strategy consulting, advisory or another analytically demanding environment.

  • Evidence of strong performance and increasing responsibility in your previous roles.

  • Experience contributing to strategy, investment, commercial or other decision-focused work.

  • Strong academic achievement, typically including a Master's degree or equivalent experience.

We particularly welcome candidates from strategy consulting, but relevant experience could also come from corporate strategy, investing, high-growth businesses, specialist advisory firms or other project-based environments where structured thinking and analytical rigour are central to the role.

Sector interest and understanding

You do not need to be a specialist across every part of the Materials & Circular Economy agenda. You should, however, bring:

  • An understanding of, or demonstrated ability to learn, complex industrial and consumer value chains.

  • Exposure to sectors such as plastics, petrochemicals, chemicals, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, energy or waste management.

  • A strong interest in sustainability, circular economy and the economic and strategic questions involved in system change.

Location

London is the preferred location for this role. We would also consider Amsterdam for candidates whose experience and capabilities are an especially strong match for the position.

Diversity & Inclusion
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description: As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life. You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product. Key Responsibilities: Develop and realize robust, manufacturable mechanical and structural solutions for the OptiArray system throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate product and system requirements into mechanical designs suitable for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation. Design and integrate structural components, interfaces, mounting features, lifting arrangements, and corrosion protection solutions into the overall product. Produce engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, interface documentation, and design records. Perform structural engineering analyses and testing, including lifting loads, fatigue, hydrodynamic behavior, environmental loads, and mechanical robustness. Develop and evaluate prototypes and engineering models to validate structural performance and manufacturability. Drive design improvements focused on manufacturability, assembly, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle performance. Support product integration, verification, qualification, FAT, and industrialization activities, resolving mechanical and structural issues where required. Perform engineering trade-offs considering structural integrity, weight, cost, manufacturability, corrosion resistance, offshore installation, and lifecycle performance. Work closely with fabrication suppliers, offshore contractors, and technical partners to ensure designs can be successfully manufactured, deployed, and operated. Identify technical risks, investigate root causes, and implement effective design improvements and mitigation measures. Provide technical guidance within the marine structures domain and collaborate across engineering disciplines to support sound technical decisions and successful product delivery. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 5 times / week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Naval Architecture, or related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing offshore, marine, mechanical, or structural systems. Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation. Experience designing marine products, offshore equipment, or subsea mechanical systems. Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design. Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners. Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams. Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design. Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings. Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects. Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Accountmanager (new business) in Zorg & ICT
description: Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen. Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? En geloof jij oprecht dat goede digitale zorg het verschil maakt voor patiënt en zorgprofessional? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen. Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer. Wat je gaat doen Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare . Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening : advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen. Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg. Wie jij bent Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder : iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort; Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering; Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij; Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego; Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur; Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg; Onze harde eisen voor deze functie Je bent meer een New Business Accountmanager dan een Key Acccountmanager Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening , zoals consultancy, interim of detachering; Je hebt minimaal twee jaar recente ervaring met het verkopen van dienstverlening op het snijvlak van Zorg en ICT; Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau; Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op: Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring; Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon; Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren; Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers; Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk; Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren; Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties; Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt; Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen; Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices. Voel jij een “ja”? title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core
description: At Channable , we're building the future of eCommerce automation - and at the core of that vision is a world-class engineering organization. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Core Group , where you'll play a key role in integrating eCommerce channels. 🚀 About the role: As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Core domain, you will lead an engineering department consisting of 3 team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~11 individual contributors. You’ll be responsible for delivering maximum impact in the Core domain. You will partner up with an experienced Product Lead, with whom you will define and carry out a department vision, strategy, and roadmap. Engaged team leads and individual contributors are top of mind for you. You can learn more about the Core domain and its scope here . 🛠 What you’ll do: Drive the Core roadmap by balancing the overall Channable strategy and the Core's specific opportunities Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs Improve and optimize processes that hamper productivity and can be more lean Build a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account 💡 What we’re looking for: Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers You have demonstrable experience in improving individual and team performance, as well as engagement You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt Some practical things we expect from you: You’re available for at least 32 hours per week You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands Note: the official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager. Important note : we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow. Who are we? Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities. Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn ! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read. What do we do? Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/ And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like. 🌟 Why Channable? At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other. What do we offer? Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success. Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary. Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth. 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave! Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources. Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads. Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more! Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. How can you introduce yourself to us? Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible! Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish. title: Productowner
description: Als Product Owner vertaal je visie naar concrete acties en zorg je dat multidisciplinaire (Business en IT) teams maximale waarde leveren voor klant en organisatie. Je ontwikkelt een krachtige productvisie die naadloos aansluit bij onze strategie en zorgt dat deze daadwerkelijkheid gerealiseerd wordt. Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Je bent het gezicht van de business, bouwt sterke relaties met interne en externe stakeholders en neemt beslissingen met mandaat. Je opereert op het snijvlak van Business en IT en stuurt een Agile Business Team aan dat vraagstukken vertaalt naar waardevolle Epics en Features. Onze strategie is gericht op continue verbetering van Operational Excellence, altijd vanuit klantwaarde, waarbij we processen expliciet koppelen aan de bovenliggende klantreis. Met jouw scherpe prioritering houd je de backlog overzichtelijk, definieer je features en stories en bewaak je de kwaliteit volgens de hoogste standaarden en de Definition of Done. Met jouw scherpe prioriteitenbeheer houd je de backlog overzichtelijk, definieer je features en stories en bewaak je de kwaliteit van opgeleverde producten, altijd volgens de hoogste standaarden en de Definition of Done. Binnen het team breng je focus, stimuleer je samenwerking en zorg je voor energie tijdens demo's en retrospectives. Je brengt focus in het team, stimuleert samenwerking en zorgt voor energie tijdens demo's en retrospectives. Tegelijk bewaak je de functionele (klantwaarde, wetgeving, processen) én technische integriteit van oplossingen. Je stuurt actief op KPI's en bent een aanjager van innovatie en optimalisatie. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat nieuwe vereisten en proposities tijdig en correct worden doorgevoerd in alle relevante systemen, van administratie tot klantcommunicatie, zodat de klantreis over alle kanalen consistent en effectief is ingericht. We werken in een professionele, resultaatgerichte omgeving met veel aandacht voor samenwerking, eigenaarschap en kwaliteit, en schakelen continu tussen business, IT en compliance. #LI-DNI Wat vragen we van jou? Hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau met analytisch vermogen om complexe processen snel te doorgronden Passie voor de Pensioen Business en affiniteit met domeinkennis (o.a. WTP en keuzebegeleiding is een pré) Ervaring met Agile/SAFe-principes en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams Sterke focus op klanttevredenheid en het vermogen om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar waardevolle oplossingen Organisatorisch talent: je bent aantoonbaar sterk in plannen, structureren en het aanbrengen van prioriteiten Communicatieve kracht: je onderhoudt relaties met stakeholders en weet te overtuigen op basis van argumenten en persoonlijkheid Je beweegt comfortabel op het snijvlak van business en IT en weet verschillende disciplines effectief te verbinden Probleemoplossend vermogen en besluitvaardigheid: je durft keuzes te maken en neemt verantwoordelijkheid Talenkennis: uitstekende beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels in woord en geschrift Het is een pré als je werkervaring hebt als Product Owner en in het bezit bent van WFT-certificaten (Basis, Vermogen, Pensioen) We zoeken iemand die niet alleen inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook persoonlijk leiderschap toont en écht verschil maakt. You generally need to be an excellent communicator and be comfortable speaking with a broad range of personas. You don’t mind getting your hands (literally) dirty to get the job done. A strong bias-to-action and getting-shit-done mentality with the required tenacity and speed. The emphasis of this role is execution, not analysis. You’re comfortable in a high-stress environment. Things constantly go wrong at construction sites, the stakes are high, and we’re introducing new technology with novel failure modes. Raw intellectual horsepower and eagerness to learn. We expect this role to have a steep learning curve whatever your background, and this role might in practice feel like a completely new job every 3-6 months. Strong operational and analytical skills. You can build a spreadsheet with a clear operational plan, or present a P&L and model various scenarios and drivers. You’re a strong project manager. title: Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician
description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards. This is a hands-on execution role . You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager , who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead , who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor; fridge loading is planned in close coordination with the measurement team. What you'll be doing Core Responsibilities Assemble quantum chips into their packaging , working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB. Make the electrical connections , wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering. Measure and test your work , performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on. Finish and close the package , including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location. Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured , mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields. Safeguard quality , handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip. Supporting Responsibilities Flag deviations early , stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix. Help improve how we work , giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing. Keep a safe, clean and organised workplace , applying 5S and HSE rules every day and making sure your bench, tooling and consumables are ready. Your Profile MBO-level technical education (level 3 or 4) or equivalent, for example in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electronics, fine-mechanical or precision engineering, or lab or instrument technology. 4+ years of hands-on experience assembling mechanical, electrical or mechatronic systems; relevant internships count. Able to read work instructions with photos and technical drawings, and comfortable with basic digital tools and production systems. Good with your hands at two scales: precision in assembly, handling of fine devices and connectors, and mechanical assembly such as bolting, cabling and fitting larger parts together. Precise and patient, with a genuine liking for detailed hands-on work done well, every time, and a practical approach to solving problems. Comfortable with structured, repeatable work, and disciplined about following instructions step by step and recording what you did. Comfortable in an environment that is still being built, where not every process is finished yet and priorities can shift. A team player in a young, driven team who communicates openly and speaks up when something isn't right. Good command of technical English. Bonus if you also bring: Experience with wirebonding, die attach or other chip-packaging / microelectronics assembly. Experience with measurements, diagnostics or troubleshooting. Experience in a lab, ESD-controlled or 5S production environment. Experience assembling, servicing or setting up complex equipment, instruments or machines. Familiarity with cryogenics or vacuum systems. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. title: Senior Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join Trust & Safety’s Actioning team, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The team owns critical mechanisms, including user reporting, moderation workflows, policy enforcement, and interventions against malicious users.

You will leverage your expertise in machine learning to research, design and implement new models for report and appeals prioritization, advanced sanctioning based on users' suspicions, and automation of moderation decisions. This involves working closely with our engineering teams to develop robust pipelines for data handling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and continuous improvement. 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will utilize advanced machine learning techniques to analyze text, images, and other data formats, tackling complex challenges to identify and address content that poses potential risks. You will champion best practices and methodologies, significantly enhancing the team's effectiveness and safeguarding Vinted. You will mentor others, influence the strategic direction for model development, and facilitate cross-functional collaborations to drive impactful results.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the research, development, and end-to-end lifecycle of production machine learning models that prioritize and automate actions on harmful marketplace entities at scale.
  • Play a crucial role in establishing and refining essential machine learning processes, such as data versioning, creating labeling pipelines, and ensuring high-quality data availability for effective model training.
  • Actively collaborate across teams, particularly with Data Infrastructure and backend engineers, to develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and scalability of deployed models.
  • Influence and contribute to the strategic roadmap for the Actioning team, collaborating with Decision Scientists to test, assess, and continuously improve new models.

About you 

  • Proven track record in data science (4+ years of experience), with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, or computational mathematics.
  • Proficiency in both classical and deep learning techniques, and an adeptness in leveraging the latest tools and methodologies to solve complex problems.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI applications or LLM-powered workflows that handle large traffic, balancing quality, latency, and cost efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of the challenges involved in deploying, maintaining, and scaling real-time ML models in production, with a proven ability to address these challenges effectively.
  • Proven capability to work with engineering teams, designing and implementing efficient data ingestion, feature engineering, and model training pipelines that support robust and reliable model deployment.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a commitment to staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning and data science, driving innovation and thought leadership within the team.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring that technical elements are properly understood and integrated to deliver business value.
  • Past experience with fraud detection, harmful content detection or any other adversarial domain would be considered an advantage. 

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€67.700—€91.500 EUR

title: Studio Director
description:
As Studio Director, you will lead the end-to-end operation of Suitsupply's photo studio, ensuring the efficient delivery of high-quality visual assets across every customer touchpoint. You will drive operational excellence through process optimization, resource planning, and technology enablement, partnering closely with Creative, Brand, Merchandising, Marketing, E-Commerce, and Production teams. This role calls for a strong operational mindset, balancing quality, speed, cost, and capacity while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and increase productivity. You will own the studio's technology roadmap, including AI-driven solutions, and lead a cross-functional network of photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers. Your leadership will directly shape the scalability, efficiency, and creative output of one of Suitsupply's core content production functions. 
What You Will Do 
  • Lead day-to-day studio operations — managing capacity, resource allocation, schedules, and workload planning — and ensure output is delivered on time, on budget, and to quality standards. 
  • Coordinate photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers, and establish KPIs and reporting to track throughput, turnaround, utilization, and quality. 
  • Own and continuously improve end-to-end studio workflows, using production data and bottleneck analysis to eliminate inefficiencies and drive scalable ways of working. 
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize technologies for production planning, asset management, and workflow automation, leveraging AI to accelerate content production and improve quality control. 
  • Build business cases for technology investments and drive adoption across the studio team, partnering with Technology and Digital teams. 
  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for studio matters across Creative, Brand, Marketing, Merchandising, Retail, E-commerce, and Production teams. 
  • Manage external partners — retouching, production, equipment, and technology vendors — negotiating contracts and rates to ensure cost-effective, high-quality service. 
  • Own the studio operating budget across external retouching, tooling, technology, equipment, and resources, monitoring productivity, utilization, and costs to optimize spend. 
  • Support strategic planning and future studio capability development. 
Who You Are 
  • 10+ years in studio operations, content production, or related operational leadership, with proven experience managing high-volume production in fashion, retail, e-commerce, or a comparable industry. 
  • Strong operational and analytical mindset, using data and metrics to improve workflows, simplify processes, and drive efficiency. 
  • Experience implementing new technologies, workflow management systems, and AI-enabled solutions; hands-on with platforms such as Creative Force, Photoshop, and Figma. 
  • Strong project, stakeholder, and resource management skills across competing priorities and deadlines. 
  • Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, vendors, and operational performance. 
  • Self-directed, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, with strong ownership and accountability. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Photography, Creative Production, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. 
What You Will Get 
  • Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off. 
  • Growth: We see your potential as a key asset. At Suitsupply, you'll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step. 
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization. 
  • Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products.
  • Compensation: We offer a competitive salary of based on relevant skills and experience.

title: Senior MLOps Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer domain's Data Science teams build and iterate on our most critical ML systems—like ranking, retrieval, and recommendations—that serve millions of users. As our ambition and the complexity of these models grow, we are scaling our MLOps capabilities to match: 

We are hiring an MLOps Engineer to solve this. This is a high-impact "bridge" role, not to build new platforms, but to be the expert user of our existing platforms (GCP/Vertex AI, Vespa, Triton). Your mission is to take our Data Science team's work, rectify the current ad-hoc solutions, and build the robust, automated, and high-quality "path-to-production" our advanced models require.

Also by joining Vinted, you’ll become part of an active community of engineers who are keen on sharing knowledge, organizing learning workshops and so much more!

In this position, you’ll 

  • Productionise ML models: be responsible for migrating all existing model training code from experimental or proof-of-concept stages to robust and automated pipelines.
  • Build continuous training (CT) pipelines: design, build, and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, model training, and batch scoring.
  • Automate model serving & integration: package and deploy traditional ML models (e.g., in ONNX format) to our existing serving infrastructure, primarily Vespa and/or Triton.
  • Close the deployment loop: automate model deployments where they are still manual. For example, building a GitHub Action that deploys a new model to Vespa, triggered by a webhook from a successful Vertex AI training pipeline.
  • Build the missing quality gates: build the automated quality and evaluation gates that our pipelines lack today. This includes:
  • Establish and uphold ML Model Lifecycle Standards: Take ownership of and continuously improve the standards, quality, and governance of the complete ML model lifecycle

About you 

  • We are looking for an "ML-literate" Software Engineer, not a Data Scientist. You are a builder and an automator with a strong service mindset.
  • Must-have technical skills: deep expertise in GCP/Vertex AI (or equivalents like SageMaker), Kubernetes, and Docker.
  • Automation expertise: proven experience building robust CI/CD and automation pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).
  • ML-Literate: you understand ML workflows and concepts (training, evaluation, inference) well enough to debug pipelines and build meaningful quality gates.
  • Soft skills: a strong "service mindset," excellent communication, and the ability to act as a bridge between the highly technical worlds of Data Science and Infrastructure. You are pragmatic and driven to get high-quality work into production.
  • Bonus Points: familiarity with ML serving platforms like Vespa search engine or NVIDIA Triton and model formats like ONNX.
  • Willingness to learn and master new technologies and concepts.
  • We value pragmatism, big-picture thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving skills.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:
€107.900—€145.900 EUR

title: (Senior) GEO Manager (m/w/d)
description: At idealo, we've built a strong SEO foundation. Now, we're looking to take the next step. As AI-powered search experiences such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini increasingly influence how people research products and make purchasing decisions, we want to ensure idealo becomes a trusted and frequently cited source within these new shopping journeys. As our GEO Manager , you'll take ownership of developing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an additional growth discipline alongside our established SEO activities. Combining your technical SEO expertise with hands-on experience in AI search optimization, you'll develop our GEO strategy, establish meaningful visibility monitoring, and drive experimentation to understand what makes content and data discoverable, relevant, and citable by generative AI systems. You'll work closely with our SEO team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Communications to turn emerging opportunities into scalable solutions. About your new role GEO Strategy & Development: You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You identify opportunities across generative search platforms and AI-assisted shopping journeys, translating emerging developments into actionable initiatives aligned with our broader SEO and business objectives. AI Visibility & Performance Monitoring: You establish and continuously improve a GEO monitoring framework covering platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders. Technical GEO Optimization: You leverage your technical SEO expertise to improve how generative AI systems discover, interpret, and reference idealo's content. This includes optimizing structured data ( Schema.org ), semantic relationships, product and offer information, and identifying technical opportunities to strengthen our visibility and accessibility across AI-powered search experiences. Experimentation & Competitive Analysis: You design, implement, and evaluate GEO experiments, analyze idealo's visibility against relevant competitors, and translate findings into concrete optimization measures. You continuously assess emerging GEO tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve our approach. AI Shopping & Content Optimization: You explore how idealo's product, pricing, and offer data can become a valuable information source for AI agents and agentic commerce. Together with Content Marketing, you assess existing content and develop answer-focused, well-structured formats that strengthen relevance, authority, and citation potential. Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: You connect technical SEO and GEO requirements with Product and Engineering initiatives and collaborate with Brand and Communications/PR on authority-building and digital PR opportunities. You actively share your expertise, communicate findings to stakeholders, and contribute insights from the evolving AI search landscape to idealo's long-term SEO strategy. Skills & Requirements 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with a clear focus on technical SEO.  Strong technical SEO fundamentals: site architecture, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, JavaScript SEO, and experience running full technical audits.  Practical understanding of how generative search systems retrieve, summarize, and cite content. Experience with data analysis, KPI definition, and translating data into recommendations.  Hands-on proficiency with core SEO tools (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar crawler).  Familiarity with structured data, semantic models, and entity-based SEO.  Experience with GEO/AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, AirOps, Rankscale, Peec AI, Otterly).  Strong AI mindset: willing to test new GEO tools and methods and share learnings with the team.  Excellent communication skills, able to present technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Content, Brand, and Communications/PR.  Experience in e-commerce, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL or reporting automation with tools such as n8n are a plus. description:

Driven by the rapid digital transformation of businesses across Europe, demand for high-capacity, reliable connectivity from Enterprise customers continues to grow. Thanks to our continued investment in the development of European fibre networks, euNetworks is a leader in Data Centre to Data Centre connectivity, supporting Hyperscale, Enterprise, Content and Wholesale customers across the region.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with the drive to identify opportunities and develop new relationships
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Experience managing complex sales cycles and multiple stakeholders
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
  • A self-starter who is comfortable prospecting and building opportunities from scratch
  • Good understanding of the European Telecoms and Enterprise connectivity market

title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)
description: Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht. Was du machst Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufs- oder Vermietungsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.
